  • Strategy & Visibility
    • Own the commodity strategy for your assigned critical mineral, with explicit focus on supply chain resilience, geopolitical risk mitigation (particularly PRC concentration in mining and refinement), cost, and quality
    • Build and maintain tiered supply chain mapping from Anduril end products down to the raw material, quantify revenue exposure and BOM impact to prioritize where deeper intervention is needed
  • Market Intelligence & Comms
    • Maintain expert-level market intelligence and deliver weekly updates on pricing, disruptions, and geopolitical signals
    • Host monthly cross-functional pod tag-ups, lead quarterly strategy reviews, and conduct regular executive briefings on market conditions and mitigation plans
  • Sourcing Execution
    • Lead RFI/RFQ/RFP processes across miners, refiners, processors, and component suppliers
    • Perform should-cost and TCO analysis; negotiate key agreements (offtake, pricing, capacity reservations, payment terms) suited to volatile, concentrated markets
    • Evaluate and recommend strategic interventions (stockpiling, prepayments, JVs, equity investments, vertical integration), partnering with CorpDev and Finance
  • Relationship Management
    • Build trusted relationships with suppliers, industry associations, and U.S./allied government bodies (DoD, DPA Title III, DLA, DOE); represent Anduril externally for your commodity
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Lead a cross-functional pod spanning product sourcing, parent commodity managers, Engineering, and CorpDev/Finance
    • Partner with Engineering to qualify alternates, influence specs, and design out single points of failure
  • Supplier & Performance Management
    • Own supplier performance (delivery, quality, cost, innovation), serving as primary escalation point and managing continuity of supply through NPI-to-MP transitions

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, or related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience in commodity management, strategic sourcing with direct exposure to critical minerals or their downstream products (e.g., rare earth magnets, germanium, gallium, tungsten, antimony, lithium, cobalt, nickel, manganese)

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Tactical Recon & Strike team at Anduril develops aerial small drones (Group 1-3) and all equipment to test, deploy and operate. The team is responsible for taking products like Ghost, Anvil, Bolt and Altius from concepts to operational systems. We work in close coordination with specialist teams to solve some of the hardest problems facing our customers. We are looking for software engineers, hardware engineers, roboticists, and front-end mobile developers who are excited about creating a powerful robotics platform that can be tasked and viewed in real-time through a variety of interfaces.
 
Within TRS, our GNC team is at the forefront of tackling the most challenging navigation problems, specializing in the ground-up development of resilient GPS-denied navigation solutions that empower our autonomous platforms to operate reliably in the most demanding, contested environments. We are a vertically integrated team, taking concepts from ideation to software loaded on a vehicle and into flight testing in the same week, sometimes even the same day.

ABOUT THE JOB

This is a senior role for an Algorithm Developer (Localization/GNC) who thrives on building cutting-edge technology from scratch and seeing their creations immediately deployed in the field. You will be a central architect in shaping Anduril's technical moat in GPS-denied navigation, driving the development of core vision-based navigation (VBN) and advanced sensor fusion algorithms. While core techniques like VBN and Terrain Contour Matching (TERCOM) exist, your role will involve pioneering novel approaches and advanced fusion methodologies that push their performance boundaries.
You will apply algorithmic creativity to explore and develop a diverse suite of advanced navigation solutions, including:

  • Robust vision-based navigation
  • Advanced map matching algorithms
  • Terrain contour matching (TERCOM)
  • Celestial navigation
  • High-fidelity state estimation using various Kalman filter types (Error-State, Invariant Filters)
  • Fusion of diverse sensor modalities (IMU, EO/IR, Baro, ToF, Radar Altimeter, Star Trackers)

You'll contribute directly to building capabilities that include collaborative navigation, precision landing on moving or maritime vessels, and developing a common, resilient navigation stack for platforms ranging from submarines and helicopters to boats and trucks. Join a close, collaborative team where your insights will directly translate into software loaded on vehicles, with rapid flight testing opportunities across diverse, exciting test sites – from captive flights on various vehicles to remote, cool locations. If you're passionate about making an immediate, tangible impact on national security by developing the most advanced navigation solutions for contested environments, this is your opportunity.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design, implement, and rigorously validate advanced GPS-denied navigation algorithms, including Vision-Based Navigation (VBN), advanced Map Matching, and high-fidelity sensor fusion for state estimation.
  • Drive ground-up algorithm development from theoretical concepts through high-fidelity simulation, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, and rapid flight validation on multiple physical hardware platforms.
  • Collaborate intimately with Computer Vision, Flight Software, and Simulation teams to define requirements, integrate solutions, and push the boundaries of autonomous navigation in contested environments.
  • Analyze extensive flight test data from diverse platforms (e.g., Altius, Ghost, manned aircraft) collected across varied, challenging environments to identify performance gaps, refine algorithms, and debug complex incidents.
  • Contribute strategically to the growth of Anduril's technical moat in navigation, including areas like collaborative navigation and precise terminal guidance for challenging operational scenarios.
  • Mentor junior engineers and champion best practices in algorithm design, validation, and continuous integration within a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field with a strong focus on dynamic systems, estimation, or control.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in GNC, localization, or advanced state estimation roles, preferably in demanding real-world applications (e.g., defense, aerospace, robotics).
  • Deep expertise in state estimation and sensor fusion, particularly with various Kalman filter types (e.g., EKF, ES-EKF, UKF, Invariant Filters) and their practical implementation.
  • Proficiency in C++ (preferred) and/or Python for algorithm development and real-time embedded systems implementation.
  • Extensive experience with vision-based navigation (VBN) techniques (e.g., VIO, VSLAM, feature tracking, optical flow) or robust map matching/geo-registration algorithms.
  • Proven ability to develop, test, and debug algorithms in real-time embedded environments on physical hardware.
  • Experience with modeling and simulation of dynamic systems and sensor phenomenology.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s Degree or PhD in a relevant technical field.
  • Experience with terrain contour matching (TERCOM) or other non-GPS absolute localization methods utilizing diverse sensor inputs (e.g., LRF, Radar Altimeters, Star Trackers/Celestial Navigation).
  • Familiarity with diverse sensor modalities for navigation (e.g., IMU, Baro, LRF, Radar Altimeters, EO/IR) and their specific noise characteristics and modeling.
  • Experience with distributed or collaborative navigation systems, leveraging inter-platform measurements.
  • Track record of successfully bringing complex algorithms from theoretical concepts through to deployed products on physical hardware.
  • Proficiency with modern software development practices (e.g., CI/CD, Git, automated testing frameworks).
  • Demonstrated ability to "wear many hats" and thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact, and highly collaborative startup environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer on Space Ground Software, you will own the architecture and deployment of software solutions that support customer missions for space operations and mission management.   • Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality

  • Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next-steps
  • Partner with end-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints

  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and detailed requirements
  • Capable of solving complex technical problems with little oversight
  • Clear communication and organizational skills including documentation and training material
  • Ideally 8+ years working with a variety of programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, Rust, Go, JavaScript, etc.
  • Experience with Space C2 software systems and spacecraft operations
  • A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with deployment tooling such as Kubernetes, OpenShift, or Helm
  • Previous exposure to space ground hardware like sensors, radars, telescopes

  • A desire to work on critical software in the space domain

ABOUT THE SITE

Anduril, a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1, its first hyper-scale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed at which autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America’s defense industrial base, strengthening America’s warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Senior Maintenance Supervisor to help stand up and lead the maintenance and reliability function at Arsenal-1. This is a ground-floor leadership role: you will build the maintenance organization from the ground up — hiring and developing the technician team, establishing preventive and predictive maintenance programs, standing up the CMMS and asset data, and partnering with facilities, controls, and production to keep a hyper-scale manufacturing operation running at high availability. You will own the reliability of the equipment and systems that our production depends on, set the standard for how maintenance is done at the site, and grow a team that keeps the line up as we ramp.

This is a highly dynamic, hands-on role that requires both frontline technical depth and people-leadership skills. You will be on the floor, solving problems with your team, while building the programs, discipline, and culture that make maintenance a competitive advantage for the site.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build, lead, coach, and mentor the Arsenal-1 maintenance technician team — from the first hires through a scaled, multi-shift organization — developing skills, cross-training, and a strong safety-first culture.
  • Stand up and own the preventive, predictive, and reactive maintenance programs for production equipment, tooling, and facility-critical systems, driving toward high equipment availability and uptime.
  • Establish and administer the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), including asset hierarchy, PM schedules, work-order workflows, and spare-parts/MRO inventory, and keep the data accurate as the single source of truth.
  • Direct daily maintenance operations — prioritize and assign work orders, clear blockers, and balance planned PM against emergent breakdowns to protect the production schedule.
  • Lead rapid troubleshooting and repair of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and controls issues on the floor, minimizing downtime and getting equipment back into production quickly.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action on recurring failures, tracking issues to closure and feeding improvements back into PM plans and standard work.
  • Ensure all maintenance work follows safety procedures, lockout/tagout, and standard work; proactively identify and drive safety improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with facilities, controls/automation, manufacturing engineering, production, supply chain, and EHS to support new equipment installation, commissioning, and readiness, and to design for maintainability up front.
  • Develop and manage spare-parts strategy, critical-spares inventory, and vendor/service relationships to support total cost of ownership.
  • Build and manage maintenance KPIs (uptime, MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance, backlog) and provide a regular report-out of reliability performance, blockers, risks, and needs.
  • Be an active participant in and champion of 5S and continuous improvement activities across the maintenance organization.
  • Support capital and equipment planning by providing reliability input, maintainability requirements, and lifecycle cost perspective.
  • Show up every day with extreme urgency and enthusiasm to keep the line running and get the job done.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years leading or supervising maintenance, reliability, or skilled-trades teams in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Demonstrated hands-on technical depth across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and/or controls systems, with proven equipment troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience building and executing preventive and predictive maintenance programs and driving measurable improvements in equipment availability and uptime.
  • Working knowledge of a CMMS / EAM system for work orders, PM scheduling, and asset/spares management.
  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis and corrective-action methodologies (e.g., 5-Why, FMEA).
  • Experience managing MRO / spare-parts inventory and vendor or service-provider relationships.
  • Solid grasp of workplace safety practices, lockout/tagout, and electrical safety.
  • Can interpret technical documentation — mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, P&IDs, equipment specs, and OEM manuals.
  • Willing and able to work on hardware hands-on and prefer to be on the production floor, adapting easily to a constantly changing environment.
  • Passion for employee development and the process of training and developing both new hires and veteran technicians.
  • Knowledge of 5S, Lean manufacturing, or Six Sigma principles.
  • Proficient with MS Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project).
  • Extremely reliable, organized, and detail-oriented with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • U.S. citizenship is required pursuant to contractual obligations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (engineering, industrial maintenance, or applied science), or equivalent trade/journeyman certification.
  • Experience standing up a maintenance organization or program from the ground up in a new or ramping facility.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certified.
  • Reliability certifications such as CMRP (Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional) or CRL.
  • Working knowledge of AS9100 standards and OSHA regulations.
  • Experience with industrial automation, robotics, PLCs, and controls maintenance.
  • Experience maintaining electrical and mechanical assembly and integration equipment.
  • Forklift and hoisting/rigging certification a plus.
  • Experience ramping low-volume manufacturing to high rate.
  • Extensive hiring and organizational design experience.

Anduril’s Manufacturing team seeks a Senior Manufacturing Engineer. This role encompasses the full manufacturing value-chain: Design for Manufacturability (DFM), specialized tooling, process optimization for precision mechanical, electrical, and electromechanical assembly, vendor management, quality planning, and comprehensive documentation for high-reliability hardware.

Ideal candidates demonstrate holistic ownership in solving complex technical challenges with creative, physical solutions, personally manufactured or overseen, within fast-paced, resource-limited settings.

As Senior Manufacturing Engineer, Core Technologies, you will drive the end-to-end manufacturing development and production of high-performance hardware across critical Core Technology domains, ensuring robust operation and reliability in challenging sea and air vehicle environments. This role requires deep expertise in DFM for complex mechanical, electrical, and electromechanical systems, precision assembly techniques, and rigorous test development for critical components. If you are a hands-on engineer who thrives on complex technical challenges, delivering elegant manufacturing solutions, and is passionate about mission-critical hardware, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Leverage expertise in New Product Introduction (NPI) to seamlessly transition complex electromechanical systems from prototype to scalable production, optimizing for manufacturability, performance, and supply chain robustness.
  • Collaborate intimately with Design Engineering teams early in the development process, providing critical feedback for Design For Manufacturability and Assembly (DFM/DFA) specifically for components and integrated systems
  • Design and develop novel tooling, jigs, and fixturing for precision assembly, alignment, and testing of complex Core Technology hardware.
  • Develop robust, repeatable process flows for complex assemblies, encompassing intricate operations specific to battery integration, actuation, or energetics (e.g., precision joining, component integration, system sealing/conditioning).
  • Define and implement Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOM) and Routings within MES and ERP systems
  • Write comprehensive manufacturing documentation, including detailed work instructions, quality control plans, inspection requirements, and environmental test procedures
  • Design and validate robust test methodologies and equipment for critical performance characteristics (e.g., power delivery, motion control, energy release) and environmental qualification (e.g., vibration, thermal, ingress protection) of Core Technology systems.
  • Work hands-on with technicians and other engineers, actively building, troubleshooting, and validating prototype and production Core Technology hardware.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of manufacturing or design engineering experience, specifically with high-reliability mechanical, electrical, or electromechanical components or systems (e.g., advanced battery packs, precision motor/gearbox assemblies, energetic devices).
  • Demonstrated ability to creatively deliver complex hardware solutions (e.g., advanced battery packs, precision actuators, energetic systems) in fast-paced, resource-constrained environments.
  • Demonstrated in-kind or direct team leadership skills, with backing examples of guiding projects or mentoring junior engineers.
  • Demonstrated ability to set up and optimize manufacturing environments, including MBOM creation, MES integration, and Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) for complex hardware production.
  • Proficient with Siemens NX for CAD and Teamcenter for PLM software.
  • Hands-on experience physically manufacturing hardware (e.g., precision machining, additive manufacturing, electromechanical assembly, battery cell integration, energetic material handling, fabrication). Personal projects in robotics or control systems a plus.
  • Strong interest in manufacturing high-performance defense hardware and a commitment to continuous technical mastery.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Hands-on experience with control systems, servo motors, or high-performance electromechanical components in aerospace, marine, or robotics; OR direct experience with high-power battery systems, energy storage, or power electronics; OR experience with energetic materials processing, handling, or device assembly.
  • Experience with harsh environment manufacturing considerations (e.g., sealing, corrosion prevention, vibration isolation, thermal management, chemical compatibility).
  • Familiarity with aerospace (e.g., DO-160, MIL-STD-810), marine, or specific battery/energetics qualification standards.
  • Software scripting (e.g., Python, MATLAB) for automation, data analysis, or testbed control.
  • Experience with advanced manufacturing processes like precision grinding, gear cutting, specialized surface treatments, battery tab welding, or energetic material pressing/filling.

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.

We are scaling at a historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.

The Test and Analysis team is responsible for ensuring that emerging products are ready for the harsh conditions of air, land, sea, and space environments.   • Prepare technical reports to present findings to internal teams, management, and external customers
  • Stay current with advancements in thermal analysis techniques, materials technology, and industry standards

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Network Administrator to join our Infrastructure Operations Team. Comprising network, systems, and GNOC analysts and administrators, this cross-functional team is pivotal in ensuring the seamless operation, continuous improvement, and robust maintenance of Anduril's critical infrastructure.

As a core member of this team, your primary focus will be supporting Anduril's corporate and production network environments, providing direct support to internal teams and business units. Your expertise will be instrumental in the deployment, maintenance, and resilient support of highly sophisticated network architectures that underpin our global operations and innovative technologies. You will navigate complex environments spanning on-premises data centers, corporate office environments, and leading cloud platforms, ensuring optimal performance, security, and reliability across our critical systems. This role requires a proactive administrator capable of identifying operational efficiencies and troubleshooting complex issues within critical network infrastructure, contributing significantly across four major functions: Monitoring and Incident Management, Deployment, Operations, and Tooling / Automation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Network Deployment & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, and maintain robust network infrastructure across Anduril's corporate and production environments, including new offices, data centers, and critical operational sites. Install, configure, and support a wide variety of multi-vendor network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, and proxy servers, ensuring highly available and compliant network operations.
  • Network Security & Optimization: Implement, manage, and optimize existing network solutions for corporate environments, focusing on security, performance, and reliability, including advanced routing protocols like BGP and modern datacenter architectures such as spine-leaf. Implement and maintain multi-site IPSec connectivity solutions for secure connections between remote sites and public cloud environments. Routinely audit, enforce, and maintain security policies and protocols for all network devices, including routers, switches, and firewalls, to meet security best practices and internal compliance requirements.
  • Network Operations & Performance: Maximize network performance through ongoing monitoring, proactive troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Investigate and resolve complex network faults, triage service requests from users, and respond to incident alerts, escalating to engineering teams when necessary. Ensure deployed network infrastructure adheres to configuration standards and maintain up-to-date firmware releases for all network equipment.
  • Monitoring & Incident Management (Network Focus): Operate and continuously refine network monitoring and alerting solutions, ensuring comprehensive visibility into overall network health. Contribute to the implementation of network incident management pipelines, participate in post-mortems for network outages, and assist in generating network incident metric data. Manage on-call solutions (e.g., PagerDuty) specifically for network-related issues.
  • Network Tooling & Automation: Utilize and support the development of automation scripts and tools (e.g., Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform) to streamline network operations, enforce configurations, and reduce manual effort. Contribute to building integrations between operational tools and evaluate platforms for monitoring, inventory, and ticketing, ensuring alignment with broader Infrastructure automation strategies.
  • Documentation & Inventory: Maintain and update comprehensive documentation of the network topology, infrastructure services, cabling diagrams, IP address allocations, IP routing/switching configurations, and all network infrastructure inventory. Create and update network-specific Technical Support Guides (TSGs) and runbooks.
  • Procurement & Collaboration: Procure network equipment, manage subcontractors involved with network installations, and collaborate with engineering and telecom/LV teams to scope and plan network hardware needs.
  • On-Call Support & Travel: Provide regular on-call support for network issues within a rotating schedule. Travel to remote site locations to evaluate requirements and perform network hardware installs and upgrades.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Network Administrator, Network Engineer, or equivalent role in a production environment.
  • Solid experience with vendor-agnostic network switching, routing, and wireless technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with network security technologies, including configuring and managing stateful firewalls (specifically Palo Alto Networks, and Panorama), ACLs, and basic traffic monitoring (Taps/SPAN).
  • Proficient technical knowledge of routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP), Layer 2/3 switching, VLANs, VRFs, DNS, and QoS, with familiarity with modern datacenter designs like spine-leaf.
  • Experience using network monitoring and packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark, SNMP, NetFlow) to maintain network health and troubleshoot issues.
  • Familiarity with network automation tools and basic scripting (e.g., Python or Bash) to assist with routine configuration and management tasks.
  • Familiarity with host-based networking configurations across Windows, MacOS, and Linux operating systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve common network issues.
  • Experience utilizing enterprise ticketing systems to manage and prioritize a personal ticket queue.
  • Good documentation skills and clear verbal and written communication skills for collaborating with technical team members and end-users.
  • Ability to travel for remote deployments when required, and participate in a weekly on-call rotation.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a US Secret Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP) in secure or isolated environments.
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, Palo Alto PCNSE, JNCIS, JNCIP).
  • Experience with a variety of network vendors (e.g., Cisco, Aruba, Arista, Juniper, PaloAlto).
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) for network configuration management.
  • Experience in a Zero Trust or BeyondCorp environment.
  • Competence with testing tools and procedures for voice and data circuits.
  • Experience with high-density wireless deployments and advanced RF optimization techniques (e.g., predictive modeling, site surveys, spectrum analysis).
  • Familiarity with enterprise-grade wireless security solutions including 802.1X authentication, Guest portals, and Network Access Control (NAC) integration for both wired and wireless devices.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Analytics team models Anduril’s internal data into reusable entities that describe how the company actually operates, in effect a digital twin of our operations. Those entities power the workflows, metrics and applications that help Anduril make better decisions faster. We believe the most valuable thing a unified data model can do is serve as the foundation for products people rely on every day.

ABOUT THE JOB

Most data work stops at the dashboard. For this role, that’s where the work begins.

As a Product Engineer on the Data team, you’ll build internal products on top of Anduril’s unified data model. These are tools that people across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, People and Sustainment use to run their part of the business, not just monitor it. You’ll own products end to end: talking to users, deciding what to build, designing the data underneath, shipping the interface on top and measuring whether it worked.

You’re an engineer who cares more about the problem than the tech. You know data modeling well enough to extend the foundation, and you’re comfortable across the stack when a product needs it. What drives you is taking a messy operational problem, figuring out what should exist and getting it into users’ hands quickly.

We care less about the stack you already know than about how you handle problems you haven’t solved before. Maybe you’ve built React frontends, or worked with optimization algorithms. If you used them to solve real problems for real users, great. We’re looking for people who see a hard problem and think, “I want to solve that, and I’ll learn whatever it takes.”

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own products from 0 to 1. Find a high-leverage problem, scope it, prototype it, get it in front of users and iterate until it’s something people depend on.
  • Treat operators as your customers. Spend time with the people doing the work, learn their domain in depth, and turn what they actually need (as opposed to what they first ask for) into software.
  • Build across the stack. Work across the data model, backend logic and user interface. Use whatever the problem needs: a frontend, an optimization model, a forecasting engine, an LLM-powered workflow or something we haven’t thought of yet.
  • Build on the ontology and extend it. Use Anduril’s unified data model as the base for your products, and push changes back into the model when a product reveals a gap.
  • Ship fast and measure impact. Favor small releases and tight feedback loops. Success means the business runs differently, not just that the feature went live.
  • Make product calls. Decide what’s worth building, what “good enough” looks like, what to cut and when to kill an idea.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Show the rest of Analytics what’s possible when data models become products.

OUR STACK

You don’t need to know all of this on day one. You’ll pick it up quickly, and you’ll probably add to it.

  • Databricks: our central foundation for data applications, visualization and large-scale analysis
  • dbt: SQL transformations with version control, testing and CI/CD
  • Dagster: asset-based, event-driven orchestration

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years building software or data products as a Product Engineer, Software Engineer, Data/Analytics Engineer, or technical consultant with a strong engineering background
  • A track record of shipping products from 0 to 1 that people actually used, whether at work, at a startup or on your own
  • Strong product sense: you can tell a real problem from a stated one, prioritize what to build first, and make trade-offs between scope, speed and quality
  • Strong data modeling fundamentals: you can design entities and relationships that generalize, and explain the trade-offs
  • Solid programming skills in Python and SQL, and comfort picking up new languages and frameworks when a product calls for it
  • Comfort working directly with users and non-technical stakeholders, and communicating clearly with them
  • Experience working with sensitive data and following security protocols

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Product Security Engineer, you will own the end-to-end security for assigned radar products. This includes deriving and decomposing security requirements from customer needs and threat intelligence, designing security architectures, and actively building, integrating, and testing security features throughout the product lifecycle. You will also be responsible for conducting security reviews, researching exploits, and collaborating with engineering teams to ensure robust security for radar systems. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Owns the development and maturation of security features for Anduril’s radar products.
  • Collaborates and builds solutions with engineering teams to meet and exceed industry-standard security goals for radar systems
  • Collaborate with security assessment teams to assess Anduril’s radar products and integrated components to uncover potential weaknesses
  • Collaborates with manufacturing and operations teams to develop secure handling and operational processes for radar systems
  • Engages with teams to remediate uncovered weakness in designs, implementations, integrations, and processes for radar systems
  • Implement security features and capabilities, develop and execute comprehensive security test strategies at multiple integration levels, and support major milestone deliveries (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, PRR)

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of experience and a Bachelors degree or equivalent education/work experience
  • Experience with one or more programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Golang, Rust, Python)
  • Experience assessing security of firmware, applications, network, IoT, or embedded systems
  • Experience developing features for and improving security of firmware, applications, network, or embedded systems
  • Experience building, testing, and delivering production-ready systems, especially for embedded and/or Linux systems
  • Familiarity with anti-tamper and reverse engineering mechanisms
  • Strong and professional communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Strong understanding of the "why" behind product, systems, and security design
  • Security clearance not required, but must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance

You will be the end to end owner of supply chain for the Anduril Intelligence & Space business line, responsible for engineering support, vendor onboarding & development, as well sourcing, pricing, and negotiating for the total Bill of Material (BOM)

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Deep dive into your engineering Bill of Material (BOM), working closely with engineering to ensure parts being designed can be sourced & procured at a reasonable target level
  • Conduct supplier selection for a specific product, leveraging our approved supplier list as well as working to onboard unique vendors to support the needs of the Space & Intelligence business team
  • Drive on time delivery utilizing unique solutions to break the mold of traditional Space industry lead-times and supply constraints
  • Partner with strategic suppliers to accelerate product development via activities such as:
    • Concept scoping to quickly solidify requirements
    • Feature trade-off/trade tables
    • Should cost/clean sheet models
    • Joint design development, via clear statements of work
    • Simulation of mechanical & electronics designs
  • Drive the development and consolidation of a manufacturing BOM, working with Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing, to ramp production internally and with our suppliers with high flexibility
  • Manage total cost of the program, including NPI & mass production  throughout NPI
  • Conduct value-stream mapping to optimize supply network lead time and flexibility
  • Complete the BOM risk assessment, include alternate component sourcing, etc.
  • Ensure completion of all component qualifications, ahead of production
  • Reduce complexity: commonality optimization & component/supplier rationalization
  • Lead all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle
  • Manage ad-hoc cost issues e.g., tariffs / import export cost, and cost inflation
  • Managing supply issues as they arise, ensuring on time delivery at or below target cost

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or other technical field 
  • 8+ years of experience in sourcing engineering, supplier engagement and development, or design of electronics and/or mechanical devices
  • Domain expertise of value/procurement engineering or TCO-related work at the component & product level
  • Active U.S. Secret or TS clearance and ability to maintain clearance
  • Ability to travel 10% - 40% of the time, variable based on program needs
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree or advanced technical degree
  • Deeper experience within:
    • Design & development of electronics and/or mechanical devices
    • Advanced sourcing activities, including stints as commodity/sourcing managers
    • Supplier development (technology, process, supply chain, etc.)
    • Early supplier engagement, ahead of product/engineering requirement realization
  • Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment
  • Exposure to working in a fast-pace, start-up environment
  • Direct experience in the Space industry
  • Experience negotiating and managing commercial subcontracts

ABOUT THE TEAM

Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) delivers autonomous aircraft, advanced effects, and mission autonomy software. Program Finance partners with Program Management, Engineering, Operations, and Contracts to ensure program execution translates into predictable financial outcomes—through disciplined forecasting, contract-compliant reporting, and decision-quality analytics as programs scale from development into production and sustainment.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Manager, Program Finance, you will own end-to-end financial leadership for a portfolio of complex Commercial and U.S. Government / DoD programs across multiple contract types (e.g., CPFF/FFP/T&M). You will set the operating cadence for program financial management—Product costing, Capital deployment, EAC rigor, funding/billing discipline, and executive-ready insights—and scale the processes, tooling, and talent needed to support rapid growth. There are multiple roles available and we are seeking the right fit for each portfolio. Development role typically require EVMS knowledge, Production role typically requires manufacturing finance experience, and sustainment role typically requires an expert in execution efficiency.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own program financial performance for a portfolio of complex commercial and government contracts across contract types; drive predictable outcomes from award through execution and closeout.
  • Lead EAC and forecast governance: set standards, build/maintain EACs, drive variance/root-cause analysis, and manage risk/opportunity tracking with mitigation actions.
  • Partner deeply with Program Management and Contracts on CLIN structure, funding, burn, billing/invoicing, contract modifications, and required program financial reporting.
  • Lead monthly FP&A forecasting process with a focus on understanding program changes that drive financial changes.
  • Drive production and unit-economics insights: margin and COGS analysis, inventory and working-capital impacts, production variances, and cost-reduction opportunities with Ops/Supply Chain.
  • Own planning deliverables (AOP/LRP) for your portfolio: consolidate bottoms-up program outlooks (revenue, cost, margin, working capital) and align to leadership commitments.
  • Operate performance management (EVM where applicable): support baseline management and interpret key variances (CV/SV/CPI/SPI); prepare content for internal/external reviews and audits.
  • Build scalable processes and tooling: standard templates, dashboards, models, and mechanisms that improve speed, accuracy, and governance as program volume increases.
  • Communicate clearly to leadership: deliver crisp narratives and decision memos for AD&S leadership and Corporate Finance.
  • Hire and develop talent: manage and mentor analysts; set standards for analytical quality, documentation, controls, and stakeholder management.
  • Ad-hoc analysis for Business Cases and other studies, with understanding of broader impacts to financial results

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • 8–12+ years of progressive experience in DoD/government contract finance or program finance, including ownership of large/complex programs.
  • Demonstrated ownership of EAC development and forecasting discipline, including proactive risk identification and corrective action follow-through.
  • Working knowledge of government contracting fundamentals (e.g., FAR/DFARS concepts) and strong partnership instincts with Contracts and Program Management.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing/production finance (COGS, inventory, variances, unit economics) in a hardware or production environment.
  • Advanced Excel/modeling skills; strong systems orientation (ERP + reporting/tooling).
  • Track record of leading cross-functional workstreams with Program, Engineering, Ops, and Contracts stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with full P&L management AND Program EAC finance
  • Scaling from an idea (IRAD) to full rate Production
  • FAR knowledge or DAU Financial Management certification and/or PMP.
  • Experience with EVM tools (e.g., Deltek Cobra) and program scheduling tools (e.g., Microsoft Project).
  • Experience scaling finance processes in a high-growth environment (templates, workflows, controls, and training).

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested war-fighting domain.

WHY WE’RE HERE

As a Propulsion Engineer for our Space team, you will contribute to the understanding and design of all satellite propulsion subsystems to include but not limited to chemical propulsion, electric propulsion, and hybrid systems. You will be responsible for possessing deep knowledge on state-of-the-art propulsion systems and their applicability towards different mission threads. You will assist with the successful implementation of the propulsion systems into the spacecraft system and become familiar with Anduril’s ground software enterprise and orbital flight software systems for operations. The propulsion team will work closely with related teams, such as the spacecraft design, GNC, ground, and flight software to help improve both the ground and satellite-based capabilities conducting highly complex missions with maneuvering capabilities but above all else will be responsible for the successful design, test and operations of the propulsion subsystem onboard Anduril’s fleet of spacecraft.

This role is directly tied to ongoing, funded programs within Anduril’s Space Business Line. The programs require building and fielding a resilient, software-defined spacecraft systems across numerous mission threads. We work with mission partners and customers to deploy reliable and robust capabilities on operationally-relevant fielding timelines to meet complex challenges across the DOD and IC.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Support the spacecraft propulsion subsystems for various spacecraft programs in all orbital regimes and work closely with bus providers for successful implementation
  • Develop modern, software-defined approaches to autonomous spacecraft operations with maneuvering capabilities to successfully accomplish mission objectives
  • Own the delta-V budgets and propulsion subsystem sizing to satisfy mission requirements
  • Develop appropriate test plans and procedures to validate the propulsion system during ground checkout, on-orbit calibration and commissioning and on-orbit operations
  • Develop the necessary fueling plans and procedures for the implemented propulsion system
  • Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality.
  • Coordinate with end-users, other operators and customers to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints.
  • Support challenging schedules during ground testing, launch windows and on-orbit operations of the spacecraft systems.
  • Work with other teams and government agencies to achieve the required licenses (DOT, etc) for transporting fully fueled or pressurized containers within the spacecraft to the appropriate test and launch facilities

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Orbital Mechanics or other engineering degree.
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and detailed requirements.
  • Experience with chemical, electrical and hybrid propulsion sub-subsystem design for spacecraft
  • Experience with managing propulsion vendors for successful delivery against mission and sub-system requirements
  • Experience conducting spacecraft operations and satellite command and control with an emphasis on system reliability and uptime.
  • Experience with orbital mechanics and resident space object tracking capabilities
  • Capable of solving complex technical problems with little oversight
  • Clear communication and organizational skills including documentation and training material
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Python, Go, C++ and/or Linux systems
  • A desire to work on critical software and hardware designs in the space domain.
  • Experience testing propulsion subsystems in laboratory environments that mimic the space environmental constraints
  • Experience with testing/validation leveraging FlatSats, Hardware-in-the-Loop testbeds and digital spacecraft simulators through nominal and fault scenarios
  • Exposure to US satellite operations policy and constraints for relevant mission threads in all orbits

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, our Electronic Warfare (EW) team is redefining how we dominate the electromagnetic spectrum. We’re moving away from slow, legacy defense hardware to build agile, software-defined EW systems that deploy real-time detection, geolocation, and defeat capabilities directly to the tactical edge.Based out of our Costa Mesa HQ, our team builds the hardware and software behind systems like Pulsar—tackling high-stakes mission sets like Counter-UAS, Electronic Countermeasures (ECM), Direction Finding, and cognitive RF sensing in contested environments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Senior Systems Integration & Test Engineer to drive the verification, automation, and operational deployment of our next-gen Electronic Warfare systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional hardware, software, firmware, and RF teams to lead integration testing across subassemblies and full systems. From designing robust automated test suites and analyzing system telemetry to rapid failure triage and root-cause diagnosis, you will be instrumental in ensuring system reliability. Additionally, you will serve as a technical liaison during system deployment, traveling to support internal and customer-facing flight tests and field demonstrations.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop and maintain system-level test strategies, procedures, and test plans for Anduril’s Electronic Warfare (EW) product lines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams (hardware, software, firmware, and RF) to integrate and test new and existing EW products.
  • Perform integration testing on subassemblies and full systems, spanning RF/digital hardware, firmware, embedded software, and application software layers.
  • Design and implement automated tests to increase test coverage, repeatability, and overall testing efficiency.
  • Triage and troubleshoot system-level failures observed during integration and characterization to rapidly identify root causes.
  • Analyze system telemetry and test data to reproduce issues, validate software/hardware fixes, and ensure system reliability.
  • Serve as a key technical liaison to deploy Anduril’s integrated hardware-software products, ensuring they meet customer and operational needs.
  • Travel to support flight tests and system demonstrations at both internal and customer-facing sites, validating Anduril’s EW capabilities in real-world operational environments.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience with a strong focus on hardware, software, and system-level verification and validation testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Highly proficient with RF test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and vector network analyzers.
  • Comfortable navigating Linux environments, utilizing command-line interfaces, executing shell scripts, and working with debugging utilities.
  • Experience using programming languages such as Python or MATLAB for data parsing, telemetry analysis, and test automation.
  • Strong root-cause analysis and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex, system-level issues.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% of the time to support testing, integration, and demonstrations at remote and outdoor field sites.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational and interpersonal abilities.
  • Currently hold and are able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience working with Software-Defined Radios (SDRs) and EW systems.
  • Familiarity with common wireless communication protocols and their associated test methodologies.
  • Understanding of military standards (such as MIL-STD-810 or MIL-STD-461) and spectrum regulatory test methods.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, highly autonomous environments and can execute effectively with minimal direction.
  • Experience using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Manufacturing Test Software Engineer within Warfighter Systems (Eagle Eye), you will be the technical anchor for the software infrastructure used to validate our most critical defense hardware. You will own the hands-on execution of migrating, refactoring, and bridging our existing LabVIEW test capabilities into modern Python environments. The software you write and deploy will directly impact the speed, yield, and reliability of the tactical systems we deliver to the warfighter. This is a highly collaborative, technical execution role. You will partner with Product Software/Firmware teams to embed testability into our products, and Centralized Test Software teams to integrate our factory floor with enterprise-level test runners, CI/CD pipelines, and data infrastructure.

WHAT YOU"LL DO

  • Deploy Solutions for the Warfighter: Ensure 100% mission readiness of our tactical hardware by deploying bulletproof, highly repeatable automated test software to the production floor.
  • Bridge the LabVIEW-to-Python Gap: Write the integration layers, wrappers, and APIs necessary to run and monitor legacy LabVIEW test sequences within modern, Python-based test runners and frameworks.
  • Drive Test Maturity with Centralized SW Teams: Partner with Anduril’s centralized software and test infrastructure organizations to adopt, co-develop, and deploy standardized test frameworks, unified database schemas, and modern deployment tools (Git, Docker, CI/CD) on the production floor.
  • Implement Real-Time Data Visualization & SPC: Build interactive test dashboards and integrate Statistical Process Control (SPC) engines to track test parameter drift, monitor process capability and proactively identify manufacturing anomalies and yield-killers before hardware escapes to the field.
  • Collaborate with Product SW & Firmware Teams: Engage directly with product software engineers during the design phase to define and implement test interfaces, diagnostic APIs, and built-in self-test (BIST) routines within the product firmware.
  • Architect Reusable Test Infrastructure: Develop and maintain core software libraries, instrument drivers, and test templates. Standardize how we interact with hardware (RF, power, digital signals) to ensure any engineer can quickly write a reliable, production-grade test script.
  • Deep-Dive Debugging: Own the software health of the production floor. When a complex test sequence fails or drifts, you will dig directly into the code, check memory leaks, analyze execution logs, and patch the codebase to keep the line moving.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Mission-Driven: You understand that a software bug on the test line can result in a hardware failure in the field. You take personal ownership of the quality of the code you ship.
  • B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 8+ years of professional experience writing, debugging, and deploying test automation software.
  • Proficiency in Python (developing applications, OOP, API integration) and LabVIEW (software architecture, debugging, actor framework or state machines).
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional software teams to integrate localized hardware scripts with centralized, enterprise software systems.
  • Proven experience writing driver software for laboratory/production equipment (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, DAQs, load banks).
  • Solid grasp of modern software engineering practices: Git, unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, and software release management.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFCATIONS

  • Experience working with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, or RESTful APIs for hardware-to-software communication.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and deploying software to edge computers on a factory floor.
  • Experience scaling hardware test suites from NPI (New Product Introduction) to high-rate production.
  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Robotics Data Foundation (RDF) team builds Anduril's vehicle telemetry backbone, from onboard systems to cloud. This includes onboard data recording and backhaul, ingestion into our cloud data platform, normalizing data across flight controllers and vehicle management systems, mission systems, and sensor payloads, and making it available to a range of downstream 1st and 3rd-party analysis tools. Our vehicle telemetry platform powers software and hardware development, T&E workflows, production incident response, and contractual customer reporting today, and underpins new product development, fleet-wide analysis, simulation, and machine learning workflows. Anduril sits on the world's largest defense robotics data asset, and the RDF team is working to operationalize that across the board.

ABOUT THE JOB

As an engineer on the Robotics Data Foundation team, you will design and build the Anduril-wide cloud systems that host our ingestion pipelines, storage systems, and tooling that carry vehicle telemetry from onboard systems to the cloud and make it discoverable, searchable, and analyzable across the fleet. You'll normalize data across flight controllers, vehicle management systems, mission systems, and sensor payloads, and expose it to downstream 1st- and 3rd-party analysis tools, and build infrastructure that supports large-scale batch ingestion of recorded telemetry, as well as low-latency streaming.

  • Build reliable and performant cloud data systems: Our software ingests high volumes of telemetry across Anduril, so the systems we ship must be high-availability and stable when processing high-scale vehicle telemetry.
  • Design extensible telemetry and data architectures: Robotics teams have diverse data sources that are often unique to a platform or sensor. Our architecture must enable easy integration of bespoke data sources into our standardized ingestion framework.
  • Enable data-driven engineering in real-time: We own the software that delivers live telemetry streams and recorded data to cloud destinations and analysis tools so engineers, operators, and test teams across locations can understand their systems in real-time.
  • Build and develop cloud-native systems that are also edge-compatible: While we are responsible for delivering an excellent cloud data platform experience for all teams across Anduril, we also deliver a subset of capabilities to edge nodes to facilitate telemetry capture in offline / air-gapped settings. You will also be responsible for fielding data systems to classified environments.
  • Eagerly engage with our customers: We partner closely with business line engineering teams to understand their specific data requirements and iteratively deliver solutions that meet their particular needs and constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with modern lakehouse architectures (Iceberg, Delta Lake), ETL systems (Flyte, Dagster, Airflow, Argo Workflows), and distributed data processing engines (Spark, Trino, etc.).
  • Experience developing and operating high-throughput streaming data pipelines (leveraging systems like Spark Streaming, Flink, Kafka).
  • Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Rust, and/or Go (the team predominantly uses Python & Rust for core backend services and pipelines).
  • Experience building and operating cloud systems, including common containerization and deployability technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps systems like FluxCD / ArgoCD).
  • U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data. Eligibility to obtain/maintain a US Top Secret clearance is also desirable.

Our autonomous systems are the cornerstone of these capabilities, and we continually strive to push the boundaries of the possible in terms of range, autonomy, and mission capability.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are hiring a Senior Strategic Finance Analyst to help drive strategic decisions for AD&S across a variety of areas, including investment analyses, long-range business case modeling, strategic transactions, product portfolio construction, and supporting Air Dominance & Strikes M&A activities.

This role is based in our Costa Mesa, CA. We are in office 5 days per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Support critical divisional finance processes, including reporting and evolving our long-term forecasting models to support decision-making around expansion and operational strategies.
  • Support strategic project work spanning transactions, critical investment trade-off analyses, market research, new business model evaluations, and other business critical initiatives.
  • Create high-quality presentations for communicating AD&S’s financial performance.
  • Distill our business and cost drivers into key metrics that underpin how we communicate financial performance, allocate resources, and plan for growth.
  • Identify areas of opportunity across our P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet.
  • Stay current on market trends and best-in-class financial performance benchmarks.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Program Engineering, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Finance teams to build fidelity into our financial models.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, private equity, consulting, or another highly analytical role.
  • A strong ability to critically evaluate opportunities and risks in financials.
  • Expert modeling and analytical skills.
  • An exemplary ability to distill complex financial information into actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication skills and “story telling” ability when presenting data insights.
  • An understanding of business models and metrics that are relevant to Anduril (i.e. software, manufacturing, and government contract structures).
  • Strong enthusiasm about technology, production, and artificial intelligence.
  • Best-in-class attention to detail and unwavering commitment to accuracy.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

Per Anduril's expansion plans, we anticipate this job will be based out of Long Beach, CA beginning late 2027.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager, PCB/PCBA is the domain expert for the PCB/PCBA commodities for Anduril Industries. This is a proactive, high-impact role in securing critical components, materials, and services that power our products. This role will be responsible for developing new supplier and new sourcing partnerships that can be incorporated into new products, as well as existing products to improve their technologies, cost, and quality. There is broad internal cross functional partnership to evaluate supplier opportunities, while ensuring commercial agreements, intellectual property, and statement of works are accurate and well established prior to pipelining.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop and execute commodity strategies for PCB/PCBA and subassemblies, focusing on cost reduction, quality improvement, and supply chain resilience
  • End-to-end responsibility for delivering quality parts, when needed, at the right cost
  • Act as the sourcing expert for PCB/PCBA and subassemblies manufacturing
  • Lead RFI/RFQ/RFP and strategic sourcing process for PCB/PCBA and subassemblies
  • Own the business relationship with external Contract Manufacturing and responsible for continuity of supply, risk management, cost negotiations, and NPI to MP operation execution
  • Partner with the Engineering team and Contract Manufacturers to influence technical design specs and customize product and manufacturing requirements
  • Perform detailed analysis of quote submissions based on cost breakdown from data. Deep dive into every element of the supply chain and make data-driven decisions based on TCO
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to support prototype requirements, execute against build milestones, and lead sourcing activities
  • Influence CM’s manufacturing processes and CapEx and technology decisions
  • Negotiate key agreements with suppliers to establish best-in-class pricing, quality, flexibility, delivery, payment, warranty, and service terms
  • Collaborate internally, negotiate the right tradeoffs, solicit cooperation and resolve problems, and advance new supplier or product offerings
  • Provide strong technical direction within the specific commodities, by evaluating and guiding product strategy throughout the product lifecycle
  • Manage and lead the operations effort of developing new and adaptations of existing technologies for Anduril
  • Develop & execute commercial agreements to properly reflect the expectations of project, which include fixed and variable costs, lead-times, schedules, manufacturing capacities, etc
  • Conduct regular technology reviews to Executive staff and management
  • Own the supplier performance management of their respective commodities, which includes key delivery, quality, cost, and innovation metrics
  • Act as the primary escalation for their respective commodity

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, or related technical field
  • 8+ years of experience in supply chain category management of printed circuit board assembly and electronics manufacturing, and/or sourcing engineering
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering
  • Previous experience in defense, aerospace, automotive, high tech, or related industry
  • Well-versed in TCO analysis to ensure data-driven analytics tied to component and supplier selection, in a product-based ecosystem
  • Strategic thinker, experienced putting together commodities strategy/roadmap with key engineering stakeholders
  • Proven leadership in driving and influencing other teams to a common goal. You know how to effectively communicate and collaborate cross functionally and with all levels within an organization
  • Can wear different hats and it a strong team player to help your team move forward.
  • You are fluent in other cross functional areas to fill gaps and remove roadblocks when needed
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance

ABOUT THE JOB

The Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow of Anduril’s critical supply base. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering, quality, supply chain and manufacturing departments as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. 

We're looking for a talented Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer to expedite the qualification and implementation of product designs with our suppliers, optimizing these designs for quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness from early development through the entire product lifecycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and manage the mechanical commodities/subcategories (machining, stamping, etc.) to execute supplier production (NPI to full production) strategies across Anduril’s business lines
  • Be a force multiplier for the Supply Chain team and overall commodity strategy, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership, proactivity, technical excellence, creativity, self-direction, and courage
  • Vet Suppliers' production capabilities, factory lay out, facilities, workforce for supplier inclusion in Anduril's Approved Supplier List
  • Support Supplier Quality Engineers (SQE) in ensuring Suppliers' understanding and adherence to the criteria for part quality set by SQE
  • Own manufacturing process development at Supplier locations & the initialization of new production lines & tooling at Supplier sites to ensure materials, processes, & tools are capable of meeting product performance, quality, and production rate requirements
  • Own the roadmap for capacity expansion, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp-up at Suppliers
  • Establish and drive performance via statistical process control (SPC) reviews at Supplier
  • Identify and drive product and process improvements, factory layout optimization at Supplier sites to lower part cost, reduce supply risk, eliminate potential defects, and improve cycle time over the product lifecycle
  • Support SQE with root cause task force at Anduril by working in tandem with the Supply Chain team, Suppliers, and be responsible for closing the loop of root cause corrective/preventative actions at Supplier

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, or related technical field
  • 6+ years of experience in supplier quality and industrialization within a manufacturing environment
  • Experience with specific category technical expertise, as applicable, composites and thermoplastics manufacturing, IPC standards, CAD, GD&T
  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Huntsville, AL
  • Ability to be eligible and maintain a U.S. clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or metallurgical/materials engineering, or related technical field
  • Previous experience in defense, aerospace, automotive, high tech, or another related industry
  • Strong understanding of quality systems, standards, and certifications
  • Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment
  • Exposure to working in a fast-pace, start-up environment
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

ABOUT THE JOB

The Senior Supplier Sourcing Engineer for Intelligence Systems (internally known at Anduril as Senior Product Sourcing Engineer) drives the strategic supply network development and cost management of Anduril’s product hardware across their lifecycles, by collaborating with suppliers and cross-functionally, including folks in engineering, quality, and manufacturing. You will be the end to end owner of supply chain for the Anduril Intelligence & Space business line, responsible for engineering support, vendor onboarding & development, as well sourcing, pricing, and negotiating for the total Bill of Material (BOM)

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Deep dive into your engineering Bill of Material (BOM), working closely with engineering to ensure parts being designed can be sourced & procured at a reasonable target level
  • Conduct supplier selection for a specific product, leveraging our approved supplier list as well as working to onboard unique vendors to support the needs of the Space & Intelligence business team
  • Drive on time delivery utilizing unique solutions to break the mold of traditional Space industry lead-times and supply constraints
  • Partner with strategic suppliers to accelerate product development via activities such as:
    • Concept scoping to quickly solidify requirements
    • Feature trade-off/trade tables
    • Should cost/clean sheet models
    • Joint design development, via clear statements of work
    • Simulation of mechanical & electronics designs
  • Drive the development and consolidation of a manufacturing BOM, working with Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing, to ramp production internally and with our suppliers with high flexibility
  • Manage total cost of the program, including NPI & mass production  throughout NPI
  • Conduct value-stream mapping to optimize supply network lead time and flexibility
  • Complete the BOM risk assessment, include alternate component sourcing, etc.
  • Ensure completion of all component qualifications, ahead of production
  • Reduce complexity: commonality optimization & component/supplier rationalization
  • Lead all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle
  • Manage ad-hoc cost issues e.g., tariffs / import export cost, and cost inflation
  • Managing supply issues as they arise, ensuring on time delivery at or below target cost

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or other technical field 
  • 6+ years of experience in sourcing engineering, supplier engagement and development, or design of electronics and/or mechanical devices
  • Domain expertise of value/procurement engineering or TCO-related work at the component & product level
  • Active U.S. Secret or TS clearance and ability to maintain clearance
  • Ability to travel 10% - 40% of the time, variable based on program needs
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Reston, VA

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master's degree or advanced technical degree
  • Deeper experience within:
    • Design & development of electronics and/or mechanical devices
    • Advanced sourcing activities, including stints as commodity/sourcing managers
    • Supplier development (technology, process, supply chain, etc.)
    • Early supplier engagement, ahead of product/engineering requirement realization
  • Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment
  • Exposure to working in a fast-pace, start-up environment
  • Direct experience in the Space industry
  • Experience negotiating and managing commercial subcontracts

We are looking for a Senior Thermal Engineer to join our rapidly growing analysis team in Boulder, CO. WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Execute hand calculations, spreadsheet, and MATLAB/Python first-order models to inform path forward before jumping into detailed analysis. Use first principles as a basis for every decision and discern the right level of analysis to apply based on state of hardware design and program goals

  • Prepare technical reports to present findings to internal teams, management, and external customers

In this role you’ll need to think creatively and continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics.

  • Develop applications for Windows and Linux desktop environments.

  • Partner with end-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS or MS in CS/CE/EE or equivalent industry experience.
  • Expertise in software development with Python.
  • Experience integrating or developing low-level code and device libraries or drivers.
  • Experience working in CI/CD and designing and delivering DevOps automation for app deployment and testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience working on multi-disciplinary projects, working closely with Electrical / Mechanical / Manufacturing Engineers.
  • Experience in automated unit, integration and system-level testing.
  • Expertise in version control using git.
  • Ability to travel to Costa Mesa Headquarters 25-50%  
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or industrial software.
  • Understanding of device communication protocols like USB, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS232, RS485, Ethernet, etc.
  • Expertise in desktop application development with WPF and C#.
  • Experience in embedded systems.
  • Experience in automated unit, integration and system-level testing for non-software products.
  • Proficient in RESTful services in AWS/Azure infrastructure.
  • Hands-on working knowledge of a major relational database (DB2, SQL Server etc.) and/or NoSql.
  • Pursuing a Master’s of Computer Science or related field.
  • Experience with test automation or cloud deployment tools.
