The Instrumentation and Test technology team architects and designs best-in-class, end-to-end test and measurements systems.
We are a collaborative group of creative and thoughtful people developing highly complex and sophisticated systems to validate the performance of sensors and other critical technologies in our world-class products.
This individual will play a key role in designing comprehensive test strategies, methodologies, and integrating the measurement systems to support new product introduction, characterization, ramp, and mass production. This includes everything from defining high level test plans to architecting the specific instruments required to execute them.

Description

You will play a key role in architecting, designing, and deploying the complete test solutions—including hardware, software, and algorithms—for our next-generation products. Partnering closely with a wide range of cross-functional teams, you will develop the critical test methodologies and instrumentation needed for system characterization, calibration, and validation in a fast-paced and collaborative product development environment.

Responsibilities

Architecting, designing, developing instrumentation hardware, software & firmware platforms required to test and calibrate sensors

Production instrumentation software creation and roll-out to suppliers

Authoring sensing technology instrumentation engineering requirements documents

Prototyping, bring-up, debug and characterization of instruments for new Apple products

Preparing and delivering technical presentations

Defect root cause analysis and resolution, including diligent bug database tracking

Supplier liaison, including supporting instrumentation bring up and qualification at engineering builds, usually in Asia.

May eventually lead an engineering team

Minimum Qualifications

Our ideal candidate has experience in test integration, implementation, and has a strong foundation in at least one of the following core areas: system or application-level test software or instrumentation hardware design.

Minimum of bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE) with 10 years of relevant industry experience in a hands-on technical role.

3+ years of experience in a programming language like C/C++ or Python

Preferred Qualifications

End-to-end Test Design: Experience creating and documenting comprehensive test plans, defining test cases and coverage, and developing validation methodologies for complex systems.

International Travel: This role requires international travel (up to 25%) to support our manufacturing partners during key product builds. This typically involves 2-4 trips per year at sites in Asia. Our team is committed to providing as much advance notice as possible to support your planning.

Curiosity and Adaptability: You are driven by curiosity, energized by solving novel problems, and motivated to learn new skills to get the job done.

Focused Problem Solving: You excel at identifying the most critical variables in a complex system and can develop a clear, focused plan of action even when all the details are not yet available.

Hands-on experience with electronics debugging tools.

Electrical engineering fundamentals (ability to read schematics & layout & component datasheets).

You have experience developing robust software and algorithms in a modern object-oriented or scripting language (e.g., Python, C++). Familiarity with the Apple ecosystem is a plus but not required.

Background in testing high-volume consumer electronics, particularly with Touch, Sensing, Display, or other complex user-facing technologies.

Knowledge of digital signal processing (DSP) or image processing algorithms.

Experience with instrument camera and optical capture system is a plus.

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering and design teams.

Passion for learning and contributing across disciplines.

Analytical Problem-Solving: Excellent skills in debugging and performing failure analysis across software, hardware and system domains. Experience with structured problem-solving methodologies like Design of Experiments (DOE). Ability to perform and interpret statistical data analysis.

Master's degree preferred.

You don't wait to be handed a question; you identify the questions worth asking, conceptualize the right framework to answer them, and propose approaches that others haven't considered yet. You know the marketing and media landscape deeply: how marketing mix models quantify cross-channel marketing effectiveness using statistical or econometric models, how incrementally testing from geo-based experiments to causal inference methods — isolates true causal lift, and how behavioral signals derived from clustering, propensity modeling, or sequence analysis can shape smarter audience strategies and campaign design. We build the scalable model training services and frameworks that accelerate the development of real-world AI applications, designed with both usability and efficiency in mind. Description

The Apple Cloud AI Platform team works with Apple's researchers and ML engineers to train and ship models at Apple's bar for quality and privacy. In this role, you will bring deep hands-on experience in large-scale model training to Apple's most important training efforts. You will develop training recipes for pre-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and model distillation, and apply techniques such as parameter-efficient fine-tuning, preference optimization, quantization-aware training. You will diagnose loss spikes and numerical instability, and choose the precision, parallelism, and optimizer settings that let models converge reliably at scale on GPUs and TPUs. As a Staff ML/Research Engineer, you will set the technical direction for how Apple trains its models and lead efforts that span multiple teams.

Responsibilities

Work with researchers and ML engineers to develop cutting-edge ML models, and turn their needs into training features and performance improvements that every team on the platform can use.
Develop model distillation and compression methods, such as teacher-student distillation and quantization-aware training, that bring the quality of large models to smaller models.
Train models with long-context extension, mixture-of-experts architectures, and multimodal inputs, and solve the stability and efficiency problems each one brings.
Dig into training behavior at scale, such as loss spikes, divergence, and drops in throughput, and track each problem down to its root cause in the data, the numerics, the code, or the hardware.
Build and own scalable, efficient training frameworks and services on GPUs and TPUs, built on PyTorch or JAX and on higher-level frameworks.
Build reinforcement learning infrastructure for post-training, including rollout and inference services, reward pipelines, and secure sandboxes where models can run code and use tools.
Integrate the training platform with Apple's data and governance stack so that every training run meets privacy and security standards.
Set technical direction across teams, mentor engineers, and raise the engineering bar.

8+ years of experience in large-scale model training, including reinforcement learning, from research to production.

Experience with common fine-tuning and distillation techniques, such as supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning with LoRA, and teacher-student distillation.
Hands-on experience with at least one higher-level training framework such as Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, TorchTitan, NeMo, AXLearn, or MaxText.
Deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX, including distributed training features.

Experience training large models with data, tensor, pipeline, or expert parallelism across hundreds to thousands of GPUs or TPUs.
Strong understanding of GPU and TPU architecture, including memory hierarchy, matrix units, and high-bandwidth memory, and how they shape training performance.
Experience with collective communication libraries such as NCCL and with high-speed interconnects such as NVLink, InfiniBand, and TPU ICI.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Every dollar Anthropic earns and every dollar it spends on compute has to reach the books correctly, and the volume grows with Claude usage. That data comes from across the company and from partners: usage and billing, compute, infrastructure assets, leases. Products and pricing models keep launching, and each one adds another path into the books. Our goal is a continuous close with zero material issues, with audit-grade controls.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the engineers who build the platform that gets us there: one front door for every finance event, an append-only ledger, and an accounting engine that posts each event exactly once. You’ll hire and grow the team, and hold the bar for how the platform is built and run in production. Its users include Claude agents, which read and write through the same APIs and controls as people.

You'll partner with engineering teams in Billing, Compute and Infra on shared contracts and APIs, and with product owners and finance operations, who set the priorities and define the needs. You don't need a finance background. If you have led teams that build backend systems where correctness matters, we will teach you the domain.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a team of engineers: hire, coach and hold a high bar for engineering quality
  • Own delivery of the front door for finance events and its governed contracts, and the accounting ledger and engine, so every event is posted exactly once and can be traced back to its source
  • Be accountable for the production services that other engineering teams call in real time, such as the tax and collections services in the billing flow
  • Make sure finance apps and agents have the platform support they need: SDKs and frameworks, scoped access, SOX guardrails, observability, and the capabilities finance needs that claude products do not provide out of the box
  • Define and own the reliability and correctness bar: SLOs on the services other teams call, tests that check key upstream calculations on every change, and daily accuracy and completeness checks from source to books
  • Align on technical design, data contracts and APIs with engineering leaders in Billing, Compute and Infra
  • Drive down the time it takes finance to support a new product, program or compute buildout

Minimum qualifications

  • Have led teams that build and run high-volume backend systems where correctness matters, such as ledgers, billing, payments, metering or other systems of record
  • Have built or run event-driven systems with idempotent processing, replay and backfill, and know what it takes to keep them correct in production
  • Have sound judgment on platform boundaries, data contracts and API design
  • Have hired and grown engineers, and set engineering standards for platforms
  • Work well across functions, with upstream engineering teams, finance and auditors, and explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-engineering partners, in writing and in the room

Preferred qualifications

  • Have 3+ years of engineering management experience, with 8+ years total in the industry
  • Built developer platforms or paved paths used by other builders
  • Worked with Go and with streaming systems such as Pub/Sub or Kafka
  • Built with LLMs and agents, including MCP
  • Built or run a ledger or sub-ledger, with a working knowledge of double-entry accounting
  • Managed teams through audit and compliance work, such as SOX change management, segregation of duties and audit trails
  • Worked with ERP or financial systems, such as Workday Financials or Oracle Financials

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every dollar Anthropic earns and every dollar it spends on compute has to reach the books correctly, and the volume grows with Claude usage. That data comes from across the company and from partners: usage and billing, compute, infrastructure assets, leases. Products and pricing models keep launching, and each one adds another path into the books. Our goal is a continuous close with zero material issues, with audit-grade controls.

You’ll build the platform that gets us there: one front door for every finance event, an append-only ledger, and an accounting engine that posts each event exactly once. This is a distributed systems problem with an unusually high correctness bar. The system has to be right to the cent, replay cleanly and explain any number as of any date, at that volume. You will shape its architecture. Its users include Claude agents, which read and write through the same APIs and controls as people.

You’ll work closely with SWEs in Billing, Compute and Infra on shared contracts and APIs, and with product owners, finance operations and internal audit to turn accounting and controls requirements into designs. You don’t need a finance background. If you have built backend systems where correctness matters, we will teach you the domain.

  • Shape the platform’s technical direction: architecture, engineering standards and design reviews

  • Experience designing and running high-volume, event-driven systems (publish/subscribe, streaming) with idempotent processing, replay and backfill
  • Experience designing relational data models and writing SQL for complex, versioned data
  • Experience designing APIs, SDKs and service-to-service integrations used by other teams
  • Experience building systems with auditability, access control or compliance requirements
  • Experience turning requirements from non-engineering partners into technical designs
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including design docs

  • 10+ years of experience
  • Experience building developer platforms or paved paths
  • Experience with streaming systems such as Pub/Sub or Kafka
  • Experience building with LLMs and agents, including MCP
  • Built a ledger, sub-ledger, billing or payments system
  • Familiarity with accounting concepts: double-entry, journal entries
  • Familiarity with internal controls and audit concepts: audit trails, segregation of duties, change management
  • Exposure to ERP or financial systems, such as Workday Financials

As an Actuation Engineer, you will design, develop, and integrate the actuation systems that bring this autonomous air vehicle to life — from control surface actuators to other electromechanical or hydraulic subsystems critical to flight performance. You will work cross-functionally with structures, electrical, software, and controls engineers to define requirements, select and validate components, and ensure your subsystems perform reliably under the demanding conditions of flight test and eventual fielded operations.

This role requires comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action — you will be expected to move fast, test early, and iterate often as the vehicle design matures. You'll support component-level testing, subsystem integration, and vehicle-level flight test campaigns, working directly with program leadership to ensure your systems meet performance, reliability, and schedule targets. If you thrive on solving hard, unprecedented engineering problems with a small team of builders, this is a rare opportunity to leave your mark on a platform from its earliest days.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own and drive the design and development of actuation systems for control surfaces and other electromechanical/hydraulic subsystems, from initial concept through flight test and low rate production.
  • Define actuation requirements (torque, speed, precision, environmental) in close collaboration with structures, controls, and systems engineering.
  • Select, size, and validate actuators, motors, gearboxes, linkages, and associated hardware to meet performance, weight, and reliability targets.
  • Work in close partnership with electrical and software teams to ensure actuator control, feedback, and health monitoring are fully integrated into the vehicle's flight control system.
  • Spearhead design reviews, conduct structural and dynamic analysis, and develop test plans to verify actuator performance under flight-representative loads and conditions.
  • Support component-level bench testing, subsystem integration, and vehicle-level ground and flight test campaigns.
  • Actively contribute to the enhancement of team tools, templates, processes, and standards for actuation subsystem development.
  • Cultivate a vibrant, positive, dedicated, high-energy, educational, and enjoyable team environment.
  • Balance operational needs across vehicle subsystems while optimizing for development speed, mass, manufacturability, and cost.
  • Support critical hardware demonstrations with customers as needed.

  • MATLAB/SIMULINK/SIMSCAPE experience, particularly for actuator or servo system modeling
  • Manufacturing knowledge & experience with machine shops (sheet metal, CNC, etc.)
  • Rapid prototyping background (structures/electronics/software) & 3D printing knowledge
  • Proficient in hands-on prototyping (machining, shop tools, welding, soldering)
  • BS or MS in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or equivalent work experience
  • Demonstrated hands-on fabrication skills
  • Ability to travel 25% with potential surges above 25%
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

  • Direct experience designing or integrating electromechanical actuators, servo motors, and motor controllers into flight vehicle systems
  • Solid understanding and application of GD&T
  • Advanced design skills for CNC machining, composites, sheet metal, injection molding, and PCBA integration
  • Experience with actuator control loops, feedback sensors (encoders, resolvers, LVDTs), and closed-loop performance tuning

We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This position will be filled by a highly motivated Airframe and Power Plant Mechanic with a passion for developmental flight test of a new and revolutionary products contributing valued mechanical expertise in all fields of aircraft and missile systems maintenance. You will work heavily with the program leadership and a wide spectrum of cross-departments to help build a team focused on solving hard problems and changing the industry forever. The role will be responsible for aircraft mechanical assessment, maintenance coordination, flight execution, and reporting on all facets of flying systems readiness to the test program.

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril works across the entire spectrum of products and business lines, as well as all flight operations and test range management. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, sub-component qualification testing and much more. In short, if it involves test, we support it. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this a fantastic opportunity.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Assist with many aspects of aircraft fabrication, assembly, and operation including structural fabrication, mechanical integration (flight control surfaces, propulsion, etc.), composites fabrication, and avionics build/integration/test.
  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain aircraft and subsystems including landing gear, fuel system, flight control, and propulsion.
  • Perform common airframe construction techniques such as utilizing rivets, mechanical fasteners, nut plates, etc.
  • Complete aircraft and equipment documentation (maintenance manuals, Check list, Flight logs etc.)
  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain site support equipment.
  • Communicate mechanical assessment with engineering and production.
  • Perform validation and testing of various electronic components using equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, and test racks.
  • Perform proper FOD and tool control practices.
  • Lift and move heavy objects up to 50 lbs.
  • Operate fork lifts and pallet jacks.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Valid A&P license.
  • 3 years or more of airframe and power plant experience.
  • 2 years or more of missile or rocket system development experience.
  • Must have strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient with computer use (standard browser, word processing applications).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a fast paced, challenging work environment.
  • Willing to be multi-capable. Which shall include some electronics troubleshooting and repair.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to travel as required for test planning and execution.
  • Able to work extended hours as required.
  • Ability to stand and walk for long periods.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.
  • In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Design Engineer role will be based out of Santa Ana, CA. As design engineer, you will be responsible for developing CAD models for parts, equipment and tooling designs and layouts to support manufacturing processes, the production system, movement simulations and digital twins of the production environment. You will work closely with manufacturing engineering, suppliers, and production teams to ensure designs are optimized for manufacturability and comply with applicable quality standards including Subsafe, AS9100, and Mil-std specifications.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop comprehensive 3D models using CAD software, incorporating detailed Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), Product Manufacturing Information (PMI), material specifications, finish requirements, and part information.
  • Apply PMI/Model-Based Definition (MBD) to 3D models to support downstream manufacturing and inspection processes.
  • Generate conceptual design layouts and detailed production drawings using GD&T and performing tolerance stackup analysis.
  • Create and manage Engineering Bills of Materials (EBOMs), ensuring proper structure and alignment with Manufacturing Bills of Materials (MBOMs).
  • Establish and configure Teamcenter/CAD Bill of Materials (BOMs) and maintain PLM data integrity.
  • Perform PMI validation and model checking to ensure compliance with relevant industry and military standards such as Subsafe, AS9100, and Mil-std specifications.
  • Interface with vendors and in-house fabrication/assembly teams during design and prototype hardware builds, incorporating producibility lessons learned through design changes and drawing revisions.
  • Generate essential design documentation, including assembly models & drawings, detailed part models & drawings, and manufacturing build-to packages.
  • Conduct drawing package quality reviews and incorporate engineering review feedback and red-line markups.
  • Support configuration management at the system or subsystem level.
  • Work hands-on in a manufacturing environment, collaborating with operations and manufacturing engineering to understand and optimize production systems.
  • Design composite structures, machined components, mechanisms, fluid systems, and electromechanical assemblies.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience with detailed mechanical systems from cradle to grave, including structures, mechanisms, fluid systems, and electromechanical systems.
  • Experience with 3D CAD software (e.g. Siemens NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, etc.).
  • Solid understanding and application of GD&T in production drawings.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment where products are manufactured.
  • Ability to manage and create large assembly models and 2D drawings.
  • Ability to create workflow releases through Teamcenter Active Workspace.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Siemens NX experience highly preferred.
  • Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, particularly Teamcenter.
  • Experience creating kinematics and motion simulations.
  • Strong hands-on technical skills - both professional and hobby.
  • Experience with PMI/MBD workflows and model-based design practices.
  • Knowledge of Subsafe, AS9100, or Mil-std drawing and design standards.
  • Experience designing for large-scale manufacturing and working with contract manufacturers.
  • Ability to work well in an integrated team including daily interactions with technicians, engineers, and managers.
  • Creative problem solver that can bring multiple disciplines together.
  • Self-motivated with strong multi-tasking, organizational, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Process improvement experience, including justification of return on investment for design or operational changes.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Maritime Division is responsible for planning and executing Anduril's product and revenue roadmap for maritime missions. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, and operations, the Maritime team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril maritime capabilities in a challenging operational environment worldwide. As a leader in the Maritime Division, you must be a technical leader with the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits. This role is crucial in ensuring that each initiative aligns with the company's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, balancing innovation with practical execution to drive the business line's success.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will lead the technical development and integration as Chief Engineer for a maritime product, from initial concept through delivery. You will work closely with program leadership, teams from other Anduril products, and third party system vendors to develop these engineering solutions so that requirements are tied to customer inputs and there is traceability to program office technical decisions.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Support early architecture definition and scoping for a new product, defining the technical approach, key requirements, and prototype design
  • Support the build out of development timelines with associated milestones and staffing needs
  • Work directly with the product team (Product Manager, EPM, Lead Systems Engineer) to ensure tactical development is executed on plan
  • Accountable for technical decisions and developments on the AUV
  • Perform initial system trades and studies on key functions, such as energy storage, vehicle control, volume and mass budget creation, and payload capacity
  • Lead a new team within Anduril Maritime working on development and prototyping of a new platform; defining key performance parameters and requirements and supporting SRR, PDR, and CDR
  • Work closely with functional leads to drive common approaches for technical development and process
  • Responsible for root cause corrective action process as well as case-by-case execution and implementation. Have high ownership over the reliability and lifetime performance of the AUV product and family
  • Technical point of contact for IRADs on AUV, consulting or delegating as required to appropriate leads
  • Identify opportunities for Division collaboration and commonality in design and processes
  • Key stakeholder for technical feasibility/impact in proposed work or capability insertion

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Deep understanding of ocean-going craft, systems engineering, product development, and overall engineering process
  • Experience in a senior role leading maritime programs from initial concept through test and delivery to customers
  • Strong understanding of the "why" behind vehicle and systems design
  • Experience working on mission-critical DoD systems
  • Proven history of delivery when presented with open-ended problems, balancing technical analysis with test and validation to move rapidly through new production design
  • Experience creating teams and focusing them around a common vision, leading by example and embodying high-ownership over the problem and the technical solution
  • Bachelor's degree in Marine, Mechanical, Electrical or Software engineering, or equivalent experience in a relevant field
  • Willingness to Travel 25% to customer and test sites
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

The Supply Chain Compliance Project Manager is a hands-on builder within the Supply Chain Program Development team who designs, documents, and deploys the compliance processes that allow our supply chain to operate in a defense environment. This role requires someone who can take ambiguous regulatory and contractual requirements—FAR/DFARS, ITAR, export controls, and customer flow-downs—and partner with subject matter experts to translate them into clear, executable workflows that withstand internal review, customer scrutiny, and government audit.

You'll own complete compliance workstreams from discovery through implementation—conducting stakeholder interviews, mapping current-state processes, identifying gaps and control weaknesses, designing future-state solutions, and leading the deployment and change management efforts required to make them stick. This isn't a policy writing role. You'll work directly with Procurement, Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering to ensure compliance is embedded into how we actually work, not just how we say we work.

The Compliance Project Manager collaborates closely with Program Managers, Supply Chain leadership, Legal, and Contracts to transform regulatory obligations into documented, auditable, and repeatable business processes. You'll build the artifacts that prove compliance—compliance matrices, control documentation, desk guides, training materials, and audit readiness packages.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own end-to-end process development for compliance initiatives—from interpreting requirements to delivering documented, deployed, and adopted processes.
  • Conduct discovery through stakeholder interviews and workshops, then design and document compliance processes, SOPs, workflow diagrams, and desk guides.
  • Map current-state workflows to identify compliance gaps and control weaknesses, then drive corrective actions to closure at root cause.
  • Lead deployment and change management, including training, adoption tracking, and post-implementation refinement.
  • Support audit readiness and government assessments (DCMA, CPSR) by ensuring documentation, traceability, and evidence are complete and accessible.
  • Partner with Procurement, Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering to embed compliant processes into daily operations and existing systems.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, operations, compliance, or process design within aerospace, defense, or another regulated industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement new processes from concept through deployment.
  • Strong facilitation and requirements gathering skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous problems with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, high-quality documentation habits, and persistence in driving issues to resolution.
  • Ability to operate independently and manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in aerospace and defense.
  • Familiarity with FAR/DFARS, ITAR, CPSR, or DCMA expectations.
  • Experience supporting audits, CPSR readiness, or internal compliance reviews.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Radar team at Anduril develops state-of-the-art sensing capabilities for air surveillance, counter-UAS, and counter-intrusion missions. Our software-defined radars provide persistent, all-weather detection and tracking of aerial and ground threats, seamlessly integrating with Lattice OS to enable autonomous decision-making and multi-sensor fusion. We're building next-generation radar systems that are rapidly deployable, highly mobile, and designed for the modern battlefield—from protecting critical infrastructure to enabling advanced air defense operations.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Mission Operations (MOPs) team is responsible for managing the execution, growth, and success of our customer accounts. Working across product, engineering, sales, and logistics teams, our Mission Operations Engineers own the customer relationships and develop, plan, and deploy Anduril products in support of their missions. They work side-by-side with customers to understand their specific problem sets and then shape Anduril's offerings alongside our engineering teams to fit the mission needs. Because the problems we solve are uniquely challenging, our Mission Operations Engineers naturally gravitate toward finding solutions and are adept at navigating organizational hurdles. They are ultimately responsible for customer and mission success and therefore play a critical role in the shaping and future of Anduril Industries.
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Serve as "project manager" / "on-site lead" or remote systems owner — depending on focus area — working directly with U.S. military, DHS, and allied customers to deliver Anduril's radar and integrated sensor capabilities across multiple locations
  • Monitor radar system performance, connectivity, integration with mesh networks, and fusion with other sensors (EO/IR, RF) and C2 systems at distributed sites, either on-site or remotely
  • Gather, triage, and prioritize user feedback on radar detection performance, tracking accuracy, classification capabilities, issues, and errors found during fielding, testing, exercises, and normal use
  • Provide input to account and engineering teams on radar features, detection algorithms, and UI/UX improvements that enhance operator workflows
  • Support engagement with other units, commands, and organizations for increased deployment and installation of our radar systems across military installations, critical infrastructure sites, and forward operating locations
  • Contribute to a streamlined user feedback and engagement system for radar operations — issue tracking, operator training sessions, refreshers, and focused preparation for exercises and events

Software & Analysis focus, this role will also:

  • Build and maintain tooling for remote radar system monitoring, connectivity checks, and health/performance dashboards across distributed sites
  • Develop software integrations between radar systems, mesh networks, and C2/fusion platforms to reduce manual troubleshooting
  • Analyze detection performance and tracking data from fielding, testing, and exercises to identify trends and root causes
  • Build self-service diagnostics and automation that make remote troubleshooting faster and less dependent on being on-site

Integration & Field focus, this role will also:

  • Lead site standups from initial radar integration through operational acceptance, physically installing and configuring hardware
  • Troubleshoot and test hardware in the field, working directly with strategic end-users to resolve issues in real time
  • Organize and execute site logistics: travel planning, test event layout, equipment staging, and coordination with partner organizations
  • Deliver operator training sessions, refreshers, and pre-exercise preparation on-site

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience and a Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, computer engineering, or related field
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
  • For the Software & Analysis focus: demonstrated software engineering experience (scripting/automation, data pipelines, or systems integration) and comfort with statistical analysis of sensor performance data; willingness to travel occasionally (not a primary function of this focus)
  • For the Integration & Field focus: basic CLI familiarity (comfortable running commands and following technical procedures; not expected to write or integrate software)
  • Willingness to travel 50-75%

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape
  • Basic understanding of radar fundamentals, sensor fusion concepts, or air defense operations
  • Experience working in small, cross-functional teams, solving complex problems, surrounded by ambiguity
  • Experience working in high-stress environments, including field deployments or operational settings
  • Self-starter who takes initiative with little direction
  • Ability to communicate efficiently and succinctly both internally across the team and externally to multiple stakeholders including military operators, program managers, and technical staff
  • For the Integration & Field focus specifically: military or hands-on technical background (e.g., electronics maintenance, systems integration, field service) is highly valued
  • For the Software & Analysis focus specifically: experience building internal tools, dashboards, or monitoring systems for hardware/sensor fleets

About the Job

Anduril is seeking a Software Quality Engineer to develop and maintain the test and release infrastructure for our radar software portfolio. This is a hands-on engineering role combining testing against real radar hardware with automated test development, hardware-in-the-loop and software-in-the-loop environments, CI/CD, release assurance, and reproducible radar test-data workflows.

You will work directly with software and firmware engineers across multiple radar products to reduce manual validation, detect regressions earlier, shorten feedback cycles, and make releases repeatable, traceable, and auditable.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute manual and automated test plans, test cases, and test scripts for radar software and firmware, including functional, regression, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop testing
  • Identify, document, and track software and firmware defects; collaborate with developers to reproduce issues, debug root causes, and verify fixes
  • Support the design and build-out of software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure, including test rigs, emulators, and harnesses that validate radar software against representative hardware and simulated environments
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that run automated test suites and provide fast, actionable feedback across the radar product portfolio
  • Develop tooling for reliable collection, cataloging, retention, retrieval, and replay of radar test data so results are reproducible across programs and field events
  • Support repeatable deployment of firmware and software updates to lab hardware, test benches, and fielded units
  • Build release-assurance workflows that collect test evidence, generate release notes and software bills of materials, version release artifacts, and maintain traceability between source code, builds, test results, and deployed software
  • Partner with software, firmware, systems, and configuration-management teams to define release criteria and verify that software meets quality standards before deployment
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing methodologies, coding standards, and release practices as the radar software portfolio scales

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance, software test engineering, or software development infrastructure
  • Experience developing automated tests at the unit, integration, or system level
  • Proficiency in Python for test automation and scripting
  • Working proficiency in C++ sufficient to understand, instrument, and debug production software
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD tooling
  • Experience with bug-tracking systems such as Jira
  • Experience testing and debugging software in Linux environments
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating hardware-in-the-loop or software-in-the-loop test infrastructure
  • Experience collecting, managing, and replaying large or high-volume test datasets
  • Experience with release automation, artifact management, software bill of materials generation, or software configuration management
  • Experience with firmware or embedded-software deployment and update pipelines
  • Familiarity with Nix or NixOS for reproducible build and test environments
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker
  • Experience writing or analyzing code with LLMs such as Claude Code or Codex

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead an electrical engineering team in creating hardware solutions for vehicle management, DSP, and networking
  • Develop and improve workflows throughout the FPGA / HDL design cycle (Architecture, functional block definition, simulation, system testing, HDL library standardization)
  • Independently reviewing high speed digital and compute based designs
  • Oversee the full PCB development cycle of host boards for FPGAs / SoCs / SoMs (Developing requirements, schematic capture, board layout, bring-up, test, and integration)

  • Create, maintain and communicate product development schedules with sufficient detail to ensure that all assigned personnel are aware of their tasks and deadlines.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  • 7+ years of experience designing, testing and troubleshooting complex board designs in military, automotive or similar hardware.
  • Experience with leading an Electrical Engineering team focused on Digital Design
  • Proficiency in an HDL language (VHDL, Verilog)
  • Familiarity with common FPGA, CPU, MCU, GPU devices and technologies.
  • Familiarity with standard interfaces such as Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, etc.
  • Experience in design for signal integrity / power integrity.
  • Knowledge of modern analog and digital electronics and electronic circuits.
  • Competence with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, thermal chambers, current-probes, and automation of tests.
  • Proficient with Altium Designer or equivalent electronic design automation design tool
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

  • Understanding and familiarity with DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160, DO-311A
  • Understanding and familiarity with MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-704, MIL-STD-461
  • Expertise in computer networking
  • Experience with implementing enhanced security measures

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking an experienced Director, Global Supply Chain Integration to fill a unique hybrid role that sits between supply chain and growth. The individual in this role will support Anduril directly in building supplier relationships in Europe, and also act as a strategic advisor to Anduril growth teams and industry partners as we seek to bring Anduril products into the region by developing critical partnerships. This isn't a traditional supply chain role. You'll operate at the intersection of growth, strategic sourcing, and supply chain risk management—shaping deals before they're signed and building the infrastructure that enables rapid scaling in one of the world's most complex regulatory environments.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Drive Strategic Growth & Partnership Development

  • Fuel Anduril's European expansion by directly supporting growth and corporate development teams as we forge relationships with industry leaders across the UK and Continental Europe
  • Shape pre-contract strategy by driving scope definition, proposal development, and term sheet generation during pre-commit phases of international captures
  • Be the supply chain voice in critical go/no-go decisions, bringing market intelligence and risk assessment to leadership discussions
  • Monitor and analyze UK/EU industrial ecosystem dynamics, emerging manufacturing technologies, and regulatory developments to identify partnership opportunities

Build & Optimize European Supply Networks

  • Develop regional supply base by proactively identifying and qualifying suppliers across diverse commodity categories that support multiple product domains
  • Lead end-to-end supplier engagement including selection, qualification, and onboarding for Anduril's European partners—assessing technical capability, capacity, quality systems, and financial stability
  • Master multi-tier visibility by understanding and mitigating supply chain risks and constraints across tier 1, 2, and 3 suppliers
  • Drive localization initiatives that strengthen competitive positioning and align with national security supply chain requirements

Provide Expert Advisory & Support

  • Guide European industry partners by providing strategic advisory support to their supply chain teams as they identify and develop regional suppliers
  • Support comprehensive sourcing strategies for partners executing on Anduril programs, ensuring alignment with technical requirements and security considerations
  • Navigate regulatory complexity by ensuring flawless compliance with European regulations (REACH, RoHS, ITAR, dual-use goods, sanctions, export controls
  • Partner with business line teams to assess existing sourcing strategies and develop comprehensive approaches aligned with Anduril's product roadmap and cost targets

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as primary liaison between Anduril's engineering, operations, program teams and UK/European manufacturing partners—bridging cultural and organizational boundaries
  • Partner closely with Product Sourcing Engineers and Global Sourcing Managers to deliver integrated solutions
  • Manage supplier performance including escalation protocols, corrective action oversight, and strategic capacity planning to support rapid scaling and new product introductions

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing or procurement focused on contract manufacturing, preferably within defense, aerospace, or advanced technology industries
  • Professional fluency in English (written and verbal), with proven ability to navigate cross-cultural communication and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels in both languages
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally (approximately 30–40%) to support supplier engagement, audits, and program requirements
  • Ability to work across international timezones with U.S. partners

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Past experience in defense industry highly desirable
  • Demonstrated success managing complex supplier relationships and negotiating agreements with Dutch companies
  • Demonstrated success negotiating and managing complex manufacturing agreements with European suppliers, with deep understanding of European business culture, negotiation practices, and relationship-building expectations
  • Regulatory expertise in European compliance landscape (FEFTA, Three Principles on Transfer of Defense Equipment, export controls, dual-use technology regulations)
  • Broad commodity knowledge spanning electronics, precision manufacturing, materials, optics, sensors, and other defense-relevant categories
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, including expertise in total cost modeling, should-cost analysis, and make-vs-buy assessments, combined with proficiency in ERP systems and sourcing tools
  • Track record of building supplier networks and partnerships in Europe
  • NPI strategic sourcing experience in fast-paced environments
  • Foundational understanding of manufacturing processes (e.g., electronics, machining)
  • Strong financial acumen, including TCO and cost reduction
  • Past experience supporting growth teams or corporate development functions will be highly valued

The Intelligence Systems team is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. ABOUT THE JOB

As an Electrical Engineer in the Manufacturing organization you will design and build complex systems and PCBA platforms to test our products. Data acquisition and physical layer interfaces using FPGA, MCU, and off-the-shelf equipment will enable testing our systems to stringent standards ensuring that we are consistently shipping the highest quality products to our customers. You will work in a multi-disciplinary design team, managing requirements, capturing custom circuits, and designing complex assemblies and harnesses. You will work with firmware engineers to enable board support packages for embedded Linux, and bring up MCU RTOS platforms. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics.

This role will be based temporarily at Santa Ana, CA for a 3 month training period before transitioning to Ashville, OH.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build things that test things. Design Circuits and Schematics that will be built into test automation platforms.
  • Integrate your designs into Anduril’s PDM systems. You will follow the same process for component design and release that our product design teams use.
  • Design and source PCB Assemblies with varying complexity - from FPGA based data acquisition boards, to MCU platform data interfaces, breakout boards, wiring harnesses, or peripheral modules.
  • Architect and source circuit board test fixtures, integrating your designs with internally developed and off-the-shelf data acquisition equipment.
  • Build internal library for test circuit for data acquisition, leverage your expertise for DFM / DFT.
  • Bring up, Debug, and Characterize circuits, low speed interfaces (I2C, SPI, CAN, etc.) and high speed signals (RF, memory, USB).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, which requires a regular interaction with production and manufacturing stakeholders and frequently working directly on the production floor.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields OR 6+ years of advanced knowledge acquired through work experience and/or intellectual instruction in lieu of degree
  • 3+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on product designs that have gone to manufacturing.
  • Experience with Professional Electronics Design packages (Altium, Cadence, PADs, etc.) for schematic capture and layout.
  • Expertise in PCBA Design. Ability to design and fabricate your own designs, or guide contract manufacturing resources.
  • Familiarity with electronics test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscope, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.
  • Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems and releasing designs for production.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required pursuant to contractual obligations

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with scripting tools Python for configuration and automation of setup tasks.
  • Familiarity with FPGA PCBA platforms - RTL, design synthesis, and bare-metal coding.
  • Master’s of Science in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.

Anduril is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer based in Costa Mesa, CA to develop and test cutting edge electronics for avionics propulsion systems. We are looking for a self-starter to apply these skills in propulsion flight controllers, power electronics, high-efficiency motor controllers, and electromagnetic actuators.

This individual will be responsible for the electrical design, rigorous analysis, test, and integration of propulsion-subsystem electronics from concept to production, while ensuring alignment with strategic business goals. The engineer will also be involved in managing key vendor relationships, and ensuring performance, thermal management, and reliability in our cutting-edge propulsion technologies.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Full Cycle PCB Design: Translate system-level propulsion requirements into robust designs. Perform schematic capture and high-density PCB layouts (with a strong preference for Altium), component selection, bring-up, test, debug, and integration with the propulsion system.
  • Engine System Electronics: Design and optimize flight controller circuits, power distribution/supplies, motor controller circuits, and electromagnetic actuator circuits.
  • Rigorous Analysis: Conduct circuit simulations, worst-case analysis (WCA), thermal analysis, DFMEA, and component derating to ensure reliability under extreme vibration and temperature environments.
  • Comprehensive Testing: Lead board bring-ups, Design Verification Testing (DVT), qualification (Qual) testing, and functional testing.
  • Collaborative Design: Provide electrical support and collaborate closely with mechanical, thermal, software, test, quality, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams for development.
  • Peer Reviews: Conduct peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Perform root cause and failure analysis in support of engine test and field operations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or Robotics, with 0–7+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting complex board designs. Recent graduates are welcome to apply if they bring a technical internship or standout leadership experience from an engineering club (FSAE/EV, UAVs, robotics, avionics, or similar).
  • Technical Fundamentals: Solid engineering fundamentals across Analog, Digital, and Power Electronics.
  • Software & Tools: Deep proficiency with electronic design tools, specifically Altium Designer (or equivalent for schematic and layout) and LTSpice (or equivalent for circuit simulation).

  • Interfaces & Protocols: Familiarity with standard interfaces (CAN, I2C, SPI, Ethernet) and common MCU/CPU architectures.
  • Security Clearance: Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE).
  • Advanced Tools: Experience with MATLAB / Simulink for data analysis, control loop modeling, or system simulations.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an Electrical Test Technician to join the Hardware Engineering Services team within Anduril's Hardware Platform Organization. You will be embedded in a fast-paced R&D lab building the test infrastructure and cable harnesses that support hardware development across Anduril's defense products. This is a hands-on, build-first role. You'll own custom test rack and fixture builds from scratch, fabricate mil-spec cable harnesses, and work directly with electrical engineers to bring new hardware from prototype to test.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design and build custom electrical test racks, test fixtures, and ground support equipment (GSE) from engineering drawings, BOMs, and minimal instructions often as the first article in a fast-changing R&D environment
  • Fabricate and terminate cable harnesses to IPC-620 Class 3 standards using mil-spec connectors including D38999, Mighty Mouse (Glenair), Amphenol, micro-D, and coaxial/RF assemblies; perform backshell integration, band-it clamping, and EMI shielding termination
  • Set up, execute, and document electrical test procedures including continuity, hi-pot, insulation resistance, and functional validation; record findings in test records and communicate issues to engineering
  • Operate and configure bench test equipment oscilloscopes (including triggering and signal acquisition), power supplies, electronic loads, function generators, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, and DAQ systems
  • Troubleshoot electrical assemblies and systems to the component level using systematic root cause analysis; drive issues to resolution independently or in direct collaboration with engineers
  • Perform PCBA rework and repair to IPC-610 standards, including SMT and through-hole components
  • Work directly with electrical engineers to interpret drawings, redline documentation, flag design or BOM discrepancies, and propose build solutions including from in-progress or incomplete work instructions
  • Support setup, execution, and troubleshooting of EMI/EMC test configurations per MIL-STD-461 and RTCA DO-160

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building custom electrical test racks, test fixtures, or cable harnesses in an R&D, prototype, or aerospace/defense environment production-line assembly experience alone does not meet this requirement
  • Demonstrated fabrication experience with mil-spec circular connectors specifically D38999, Mighty Mouse, Glenair, Amphenol, or equivalent including crimping, insertion/extraction tooling, backshell integration, and band-it clamping for EMI shielding
  • Current or previously held IPC-620 certification (CIS or CIT); must be able to recertify upon hire
  • Current or previously held J-STD-001 soldering certification; must be able to recertify upon hire
  • Proficiency configuring and operating oscilloscopes including triggering modes, vertical/horizontal scaling, and signal acquisition as well as power supplies, electronic loads, and DMMs
  • Ability to read and build from electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and BOMs with incomplete or in-progress documentation; proactively identifies and escalates discrepancies before building
  • U.S. Person status required as this position needs to access export-controlled data
  • Ability to lift a minimum of 25 lbs unassisted

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • IPC-620 space addendum certification (CIS-S or CIT-S) and/or current IPC-610 PCBA inspection certification
  • SMT and through-hole PCBA rework experience including IC-level components (QFN, QFP, BGA) under microscope
  • Experience with EMI/EMC testing and MIL-STD-461 test setup, including CE102, CS114, RE102, and RS103 configurations
  • Background in aerospace, defense, or satellite systems environments (e.g., SpaceX, Northrop Grumman, Boeing, Raytheon, Rocket Lab, SAIC, Shield AI, or equivalent)
  • Experience building RF/coaxial cable assemblies including layer-by-layer prep and impedance-controlled terminations
  • Familiarity with test automation, data acquisition scripting, or automated EMC software (TILE, Elektra, EMC32, or equivalent)

ABOUT THE JOB

As an Electrical Assembly Technician, you'll wear two hats. On the product side, you'll assemble panels and switchboards, pull and route cable, terminate connectors, hook up motors, and outfit marine compartments with complete electrical systems. On the facility side, you'll size transformers, run high-voltage feeds to CNC machines and production equipment, install distribution panels, and keep the shop floor powered and operational. You'll be expected to own the work from sizing through installation and energization.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Assemble electrical panels, switchboards, junction boxes, and controller enclosures. Install components, wire per schematics, and dress/lace wiring.
  • Pull, route, and secure cable through compartment foundations, hangers, stuffing tubes, and penetrations.
  • Terminate cables at connectors, terminal blocks, lugs, and equipment interfaces.
  • Hook up motors, controllers, and actuators: verify phasing, megging, and continuity.
  • Support electrical testing.
  • Groom completed electrical systems for company, customer, and government inspections.
  • Install, wire, and terminate high-voltage equipment feeds for CNC machines, welding equipment, overhead cranes, and production tooling.
  • Size and install transformers (480V to 240V step-down) for production equipment requirements.
  • Install conduit, cable tray, wireways, and raceways per NEC.
  • Wire distribution panels, disconnects, motor starters, and VFDs.
  • Perform facility electrical troubleshooting and repair — identify faults, replace components, restore service.
  • Coordinate with equipment vendors on power requirements, connection diagrams, and commissioning.
  • Ensure all facility electrical work meets NEC, OSHA, and local code requirements.
  • Complete hardcopy and electronic documentation: assembly travelers, test records, cable logs, termination sheets.
  • Maintain compliance with NAVSEA, SUBSAFE, and SOC requirements as applicable to submarine electrical systems.
  • Red-line drawings and report discrepancies through proper channels.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • 7+ years of electrical experience: industrial, shipboard, or manufacturing environments.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams, and cable schedules.
  • Experience with 480V 3-phase and 208/240V single- and 3-phase systems — installation, termination, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience pulling, routing, and terminating electrical cable.
  • Proficiency with wire harness fabrication: crimping, soldering, connector assembly.
  • Working knowledge of NEC for facility electrical installations.
  • Experience using meggers, multimeters, hi-pot testers, and phase rotation meters.
  • Willing to work any shift and overtime as production requires.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • California licensed electrician (journeyman or master).
  • Experience with NAVSEA, SUBSAFE, or SOC-controlled electrical systems.
  • Military shipbuilding, submarine, or naval shipyard experience.
  • IPC/WHMA-A-620 certification (Certified IPC Specialist or Trainer).
  • Experience sizing and installing transformers and coordinating protective devices.
  • Background in CNC machine or heavy industrial equipment electrical hookup.
  • Background in aerospace, defense, or AS9100 / ISO 9001 environments.

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril plays a crucial role in our mission, ensuring that every product meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, software validation testing and much more. This position is looking for a highly motivated flight test engineer with emphasis in software/hardware capability development and evaluation for the Altius UAS platform. Altius is a Group 2/3 autonomous vehicle specializing in intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) missions. You will be responsible for the evaluation of the software and hardware capabilities for operational suitability as well as Altius’s integration into the full suite of Anduril systems to complete complex operations.

What you’ll do

  • As a flight test engineer, under minimal supervision, you will be responsible for test planning, execution, reporting, and evaluating the system under test (software and/or hardware).
  • Test duties include:
  • Support and plan test events conducted at test sites as required by the specific test.
  • Configuration management of test owned assets. This includes specific to test configuration management (hardware components, specific payloads, software/firmware configuration) as well as fleet management (facilitate and track required maintenance, planning/assigning asset requirements for current testing and future efforts).
  • Generation of evaluation test plans and reports focusing on system functionality and suitability of software and hardware integration efforts.   • Prior experience with ERP, WMS and MES systems
  • Knowledge stochastic \ deterministic models when to apply them
  • Proficient in handling large data sets, including filtering, identifying trends, and graphical representation.
  • Candidate should have knowledge of design engineering and manufacturing engineering processes including:

    • 3D factory layout
    • Manufacturing process planning of fabricated parts, and complex discrete assembly process
    • Manufacturing simulation of assembly processes, human ergonomics, and discrete event simulation
    • Strong manufacturing data analytics and statistical analysis background with proficiency in statistical process control

ABOUT THE JOB

As the Lead Industrial Engineer on the Production Controls team, you will lead the critical chain production model and act as flex capacity across scheduling and production control. You will own the integrated schedule model across programs and shared resources, and keep it current as demand and capacity change for Anduril's advanced AI factory. WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Plant and equipment layouts, material flow paths, and space allocation for a new maritime factory.
  • Build the production model: precedence networks, resource definitions, durations, and constraints.
  • Integrate frequent changes into the model and keep it matched to how work actually runs.
  • Size and manage buffers; track consumption and drive recovery.
  • Capacity plans and rate models: units per year under a given configuration, with the sensitivity analysis behind the number.
  • Sequencing of operations and work flow: how a build is broken into stations, what runs in parallel, where the unit sits and for how long.
  • Discrete-event simulation of the factory and the line, used as the primary way we validate capacity before the building exists.
  • Designing and optimizing the production system by integrating design, supply base, facilities, equipment, and personnel.
  • Feeding the precedence network that our dynamic scheduling system (LOKI) plans against.
  • Technical direction on production system design across VCS and Megalodon build processes: you set the method, others execute it.
  • Requirements to our architecture/engineering firm and outside consultants, and review of what comes back.
  • The trade studies that close at design review: building configuration, bay allocation, automation degree, station count.
  • Flex to cover scheduling and production control gaps.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Industrial engineering, production planning, scheduling, or manufacturing operations background. No degree required. We hire on demonstrated capability. Apprenticeship, Navy Nuclear Power School, military experience, trade background, or self-taught modeling all count.
  • Critical chain, theory of constraints, or buffer management experience.
  • Low volume, high mix, or engineered-to-order environment.
  • Comfortable operating without direct supervision and making calls within defined limits.
  • Demonstrated capacity or rate modeling: you have built the model, defended the number, and been held to it.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years in production system design, factory design, or manufacturing engineering for large complex products, including at least one program where you owned the capacity or rate commitment.
  • Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering, operations research, manufacturing engineering, systems engineering, or related technical field.
  • Shipyard or aerospace final-assembly experience: stage of construction, module breakdown, pre-outfitting, erection sequence.
  • Greenfield or major-expansion factory work.
  • MES/ERP fluency (Forge, Odoo, SAP, Solumina, Oracle). 
  • Aurora scheduling system experience preferred.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking an Integration and Test Engineer with a strong electrical focus to join the Maneuver Dominance team at our Costa Mesa HQ to help develop and scale our Hardware-In-The-Loop (HITL) capabilities. This role will focus on the design, build, and sustainment of HITLs including but not limited to overall system architecture, procurement, harness diagrams, breakout box designs, switching mechanisms, PCB designs, and test troubleshooting. You will work at the intersection of simulation, hardware integration, software development, and system-level testing to enable reliable and repeatable testing on physical systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop and maintain the HITL/Ironbird electrical infrastructure that bridges our simulation software to Hardware-In-The-Loop testing, enabling a seamless testing experience for hardware, software, and flight test engineers
  • Develop system architecture including harness diagrams, breakout boxes, switching mechanisms, and PCB designs
  • Support part procurement, physical stand-up, configuration, and maintenance of open-loop and closed-loop HITLs, and the integration of hardware, compute, networking, sensors, and other components required for HITL testing
  • Troubleshoot and resolve real-time simulation issues during HITL operations, including timing constraints, hardware interface problems, and model fidelity discrepancies
  • Develop diagnostics and telemetry debug capabilities that provide visibility into system state and enable efficient troubleshooting of integration and test failures
  • Coordinate harness build and other electrical tasks with electrical engineering technicians
  • Develop fault-injection capabilities that enable controlled failures and degraded conditions to be introduced for system behavior evaluation
  • Develop configuration management tracking tools to maintain consistent and reproducible HITL configurations
  • Automate HITL health checks, setup, configuration, deployment, and test execution to reduce manual effort and improve repeatability
  • Understand and contribute to HITL software architecture and test framework
  • Establish testing best practices that enable HITL systems to be used as a reliable part of the development and integration lifecycle
  • Work closely with software, systems, simulation, and hardware engineers to identify and resolve integration and test issues
  • Act with a strong safety mindset (“Stop, Think, Do”) while operating in prototype and experimental environments with the aim of eliminating potential harm to team members.
  • Follow established procedures and identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, and efficiency

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or similar) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautics Engineering, Computer Science, or similar
  • Experience architecting, developing, and sustaining HITL/Ironbird labs for Group 4 or 5 UAS, aerospace, or defense vehicle integration and test environment
  • Hands-on skillset debugging within a lab space with oscilloscopes, digital multi-meters, programmable power supplies, electronic loads, and other electrical test equipment
  • Experience using diagnostic and protocol analysis tools such as Saleae Logic Analyzers, Wireshark, PEAK-System CAN interfaces, or similar tools
  • Understanding of software/hardware interfaces, networking, and electrical bus protocols (CAN, Ethernet, RS-232/422/485, MIL-STD-1553)
  • Experience leading and troubleshooting LRU-, subsystem-, system-level integration and bring-up of electrical systems, harnesses, and electro-mechanical assemblies
  • Experience designing harnesses, breakout boxes, simple PCBs, and switching mechanisms
  • Knowledge of safe lab practices with power, batteries, and ESD
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, mechanical drawings, and engineering documentation
  • Experience developing configuration management processes for LRUs/harnesses, and test tools such as logging, diagnostics, and debug utilities
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues across software and hardware boundaries
  • Ability to understand and contribute to HITL and test software frameworks
  • Familiarity in Python, C++, Linux, Github, and Jira
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and adapt quickly in a face-paced development environment
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal and communication skills
  • A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a security clearance in United States, United Kingdom, or Australia desirable

ABOUT THE TEAM

Omen is Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains.
