ABOUT THE TEAM

The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.


ABOUT THE JOB
Anduril Rocket Motors is seeking a talented Test and Systems Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Huntsville, AL. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and verifying requirements for a critical space propulsion program. You will also aid in developing test processes, standards, and procedures. If you are someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and has a passion for contributing to national security, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU’LL DO

    • Interface with stakeholders including internal programs and external customers to derive qualification requirements and develop robust test plans and approaches for verification
    • Provide technical leadership and guidance to the existing test team on multiple types of tests from subscale to solid rocket motor static tests
    • Participate in and drive key verification activities including subscale testing, environmental testing, and static testing of solid rocket motors
    • Develop and standardize test processes and procedures, including defining test CONOPs and identifying and evaluating and high-risk processes
    • Identify and work with suppliers and customers to outsource testing as necessary
    • Identify need for and develop new test capabilities at our production facility
    • Generate, review, and release work instructions, processes, and procedures
    • Present to peers and customers in safety reviews, Test Readiness Reviews, and others.
    • Support prototyping, manufacturing, and test operations onsite at our manufacturing facilities and suppliers’ facilities.
    • Develop artifacts based on stakeholder needs and work closely with functional areas to ensure artifacts are complete and accurate. Model Artifacts will often be contractual deliverables and require demonstration at stakeholder meetings and events.
    • This role will be critical proving that Anduril offers real Systems Engineering, Test, and Mission Systems Integration capabilities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • B.S. in aerospace, mechanical, computer science or similar engineering or technical field.
    • 8+ years Systems or Test Engineering Experience across the life cycle. The more, the better.
    • Test experience, preferably propulsion and space related.
    • Strong technical leadership experience, initiative, and ownership over tasks
    • Experience documenting processes and procedures and producing on-floor work instructions/shop floor instructions
    • Understanding of rocket motors and propulsion systems used in missiles.
    • Basic knowledge of reliability engineering concepts and practices.
    • Experience with systems testing and evaluation methodologies.
    • Experience with Data Acquisition systems, instrumentation, and data post-processing
    • Experience with Systems Engineering, Requirements Elicitation and Management, Integration, and Test Activities on complex systems - DoD Weapon Systems, Space Systems, etc...
    • Outstanding communication skills to include presentation of developed artifacts.
    • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance
    • Experience creating and improving processes.
    • 10-15% travel

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • Experience working with ordnance or energetic materials
    • Experience with SysML, DoDAF, UAFP, or similar.
    • Experience developing various model based system engineering artifacts - Operational Viewpoints, System Viewpoints, activity diagrams, use case diagrams, BDDs, IBDs, parametric diagrams, etc...
    • Experience with Cameo MagicDraw or similar systems engineering software (Rhapsody, SparxEA, etc...).
    • Experience with Digital Engineering workflows and Integrated Modeling Environments (i.e. Teamwork Cloud).
    • Experience with modeling of rocket motor systems.
    • Experience in one of the following areas; thermal analysis, structures, propellant chemistry.
    • Knowledge of reliability prediction techniques and failure mode analysis.
    • Experience with test planning, execution, and data analysis for complex systems.
    • Experience Cameo Simulation Toolkit plugin for Cameo MagicDraw.
    • Proficiency with Mathworks products (MATLAB, SIMULINK etc.).

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Systems Engineer to join our Maritime team. You will work closely with the program leadership and a wide spectrum of cross-departments to help build a team focused on solving hard problems and changing the industry forever. In this role you will be responsible for designing and supporting the integration of various subsystems and ensuring overall system performance meets the required specifications and standards. Join our dynamic team and help us build the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) that will redefine underwater operations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own cross-functional coordination between the program and internal support groups (production, platform tooling), shifting the team from reactive to proactive interfacing
  • Establish and maintain configuration management practices that enable rapid iteration without sacrificing rigor
  • Lead requirements generation, analysis, and verification - finding the middle ground between structure and speed, with strong justification for any technical adjustments
  • Drive qualification testing, design-build-test (DBT), integration verification, and acceptance testing activities
  • Perform root cause and corrective action analysis for issues found during integration and test; adjust manufacturing test procedures as needed
  • Maintain vehicle architecture documentation, interface definitions, and traceability across the product lifecycle
  • Work across business lines and product teams to build consensus, minimize silos, and align on shared objectives
  • Support sea operations, strategic technical planning, risk management, and proposal efforts as needed

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years in systems engineering, integration & test, or platform architecture
  • Electromechanical hardware experience; able to troubleshoot across mechanical, electrical, and software boundaries
  • Demonstrated skill in root cause and corrective action methodologies
  • Software literacy: can read and analyze code (Rust, Python, or C), understand dependencies, and engage in systematic analysis
  • Experience working within requirements frameworks—with the judgment to adapt them and the discipline to justify changes
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator: builds consensus, understands others’ processes, compromises between competing priorities
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills; brings structure to ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance
  • Ability to travel ~10%

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with qualification testing, DBT cycles, or configuration management for products transitioning to production
  • Background in robotics, autonomous systems, medical devices, or high-volume electromechanical products
  • Defense experience is welcome but not required
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools (Python, MATLAB, R, SQL) or requirements management software (e.g., JAMA)
  • Experience with Linux, command line interfaces, and software debugging

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "small" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

We are continuing to expand our product portfolio, now moving into the surface maritime domain. Products like Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and surface products in the pipeline will create a system-of-systems that enable a multitude of autonomous missions across all maritime domains. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril's Maritime Division and help us build the future of defense capability.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to join the Maritime Enabling Technology (MET) team, based in Quincy, MA. MET serves the entire Maritime Division, developing shared technologies, common interfaces, and enabling capabilities across all product lines. In this role, you will be the primary MET Systems Engineering presence in Quincy, acting as the connective tissue between MET and co-located program teams across multiple business lines. The role blends systems engineering with technical program management: you will drive cross-system integration, manage stakeholder alignment and ensure that decisions on one product don't create downstream problems for another. This is a high-autonomy position that requires a proactive, independent operator with strong conviction and effective communication skills at every level.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Serve as the primary MET Systems Engineering point of contact in Quincy, engaging daily with co-located program teams across multiple Maritime business lines
  • Own cross-program systems integration and interface definition, ensuring that enabling technologies developed by MET are adopted smoothly across products
  • Drive stakeholder alignment across Designated Engineers, Chief Engineers, and program leads, translating program needs into MET development priorities and communicating MET capabilities and constraints back to programs
  • Identify and manage cross-system implications of technical decisions, ensuring that changes in one product area do not create integration risks or incompatibilities in others
  • Contribute to architecture, requirements definition, and verification strategy for shared subsystems, common interfaces (including Lattice integration), and enabling capabilities
  • Support the full product lifecycle - from design and rapid prototyping through integration, test, deployment, and sustainment of complex autonomous systems
  • Mentor engineers across teams, building systems engineering capacity and contributing to a culture of cross-functional collaboration within Maritime

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, related technical field or equivalent professional experience
  • 7–12 years of professional engineering experience, with demonstrated depth in systems engineering, systems integration, or a closely related technical discipline
  • Proven ability to work across organizational and technical boundaries - you have been the person who connects teams, resolves interface conflicts, and drives alignment
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior technical leadership, program managers, and working-level engineers
  • Experience acting as a technical lead, program integrator, or TPM for multi-disciplinary engineering teams
  • High ownership and a bias toward action - comfortable operating with autonomy in a geographically distributed team, with limited day-to-day oversight
  • Capacity to think holistically across complex systems - understanding how subsystem-level decisions propagate through an integrated product architecture
  • Experience with requirements definition, interface specification, system verification, and integration planning for hardware-software systems
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with the design, integration, and operation of robotic and/or autonomous systems (maritime experience is a plus but not required)
  • Familiarity with defense acquisition, product delivery lifecycles, or working within a DoD customer environment
  • Experience with common middleware/integration frameworks for autonomous platforms
  • Background in one or more of: perception systems, navigation, autonomy software, sensor integration, communications systems, or power/energy systems for unmanned platforms
  • Experience within a rapid-iteration, hardware-software co-development environment

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own the requirements verification traceability matrix for a maritime autonomous vehicle: the thread that runs from a program requirement, through subsystem allocation, to the specific test or analysis that proves it was met. By the time this role starts, the requirements baseline and the test campaign will both be in motion. The gap this fills is between them. When a requirement changes, someone has to know which verification items just became invalid; when a test closes, someone has to confirm it actually closed what it claimed. That is this seat.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the requirements verification traceability matrix end to end
  • Maintain allocation from program requirements through subsystem specifications
  • Define verification method for each requirement: test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration
  • Track verification status and report closure against program milestones
  • Run change impact analysis when requirements or interfaces move
  • Write and review requirements for testability, not just correctness
  • Work with the MBSE engineer so traceability lives in the model rather than beside it
  • Work with the T&E Lead so test evidence maps cleanly to verification items
  • Prepare verification artifacts for design reviews and customer milestones
  • Travel up to 15% to test sites and operational locations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent
  • 7+ years in systems engineering with direct ownership of requirements or verification traceability
  • Experience with requirements management tooling (DOORS, Jama, Polarion, or equivalent)
  • Experience building or maintaining a verification matrix on a hardware program
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with AUV, UUV, submarine, spacecraft, or aircraft programs
  • Experience with MBSE and SysML, particularly requirements traceability inside a model
  • Experience supporting formal verification reviews or customer milestone deliveries
  • Scripting for traceability reporting and data extraction (Python, SQL)
  • Experience on a program where the requirements baseline was still being written

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own end-to-end program execution for one or more hardware programs within AES — from early development through production scaling. You are the single accountable owner for schedule, cost, and scope across your program, and the primary interface between the program team, senior leadership, and external stakeholders. You will drive decisions, not just surface them.
  • This role is ideal for someone with deep experience in hardware development who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — able to define a program roadmap one hour and resolve a supply chain blocker the next.
  • Own the full program lifecycle for assigned AES hardware programs — from NPI and prototype builds through low-rate and full-rate production — with accountability for schedule, cost, and scope performance.

  • Define program execution strategy, including phase gate criteria, acceptance frameworks, build plans, and production transition roadmaps.
  • Lead cross-functional program teams spanning engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and operations — aligning priorities, resolving conflicts, and driving accountability at every level.
  • Identify, assess, and actively mitigate program risks before they become schedule or cost impacts; escalate clearly and decisively when they do.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external customers — delivering clear, credible program status and representing AES with confidence in program reviews, CDRs, and customer engagements.
  • Partner with Supply Chain and Manufacturing to drive production scaling plans, capacity investments, and make/buy decisions that support program commitments.
  • Drive continuous improvement in program execution rigor, establishing repeatable processes and tools that scale across the AES portfolio.
  • Mentor and develop Program Coordinators and junior TPMs, building the program management capability of the broader AES team.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager who excels at building and nurturing internal relationships. You will be the key liaison that connects diverse Anduril business lines to foster collaboration, drive mutual success, and enhance customer outcomes.

Orchestrate Internal Collaboration. Build and maintain strong working relationships across departments (engineering, product, supply chain, logistics, and growth). Facilitate clear communication and align strategic priorities to create a unified approach to customer missions.

Drive Customer Success through Partnership. Act as the internal advocate for customer needs by sharing feedback and insights with relevant teams. Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and capitalize on opportunities that benefit Anduril and our customers.

Enhance Product Deployment. Oversee the planning and execution of Anduril product deployments with seamless integration. Gather user feedback and work with engineering teams to refine offerings and meet mission requirements.

Foster a Culture of Teamwork. Serve as the central contact for bridging gaps between internal teams. Seek to deeply understand and represent partnership interests, driving initiatives that enhance internal synergy.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Mission First Mindset. We put the needs of the mission and our customers first and understand that the US and its allies have no preordained right to victory in any future conflict. We actively seek out opportunities to better understand our customers’ mission needs, with a goal to build the best possible products for the warfighter and radically evolve our national and international defense capabilities. We push ourselves and the limits of our capabilities in the pursuit of this goal.

Ownership Mentality. We’re looking for owners; those who have a natural bias to assume responsibility, a healthy dose of skepticism, and contribute to a culture of performance. We empower our Mission Operators to quickly assume high levels of responsibility and entrust them to actively own their account and shape its success. Our Mission Operators are just as comfortable helping to shape a proposal or pitch a new customer as they are working with engineers on new features or deploying products in the field.

Technical Aptitude and Intellectual Curiosity. We are first and foremost a technology company, working at the leading edge of capabilities like machine learning, autonomy, distributed networking, and multi-modal sensor fusion. Do you have a natural desire to see beyond simple cause and effect relationships to really understand how complex systems operate? Do you actively seek out opportunities to educate yourself? These capabilities form the foundation of our product offerings, so we are looking for those who are comfortable communicating technical concepts and can articulate them in the context of the customer’s mission.

Structured Thinker and Problem Solver. Leading technical programs requires clear communication and well thought-out plans. We are looking for assertive communicators who bring a thoughtful perspective and honest dialogue. A solution-driven approach, the ability to distill complexity into its essential, digestible components, and the ability to supervise execution are critical to ensure mission success.

High Value Team Member. Do you enjoy working as part of a team? At Anduril, the path to success weaves through the organization - account teams, engineering, logistics, technical operations, and more. It requires humility, an eagerness to learn, and empathy toward your fellow team member. We assume best intentions and empathize with customers just as we do with our colleagues. Can you develop rapport at both the user and executive levels? Do you enjoy sharing successes? We are a low ego group that promotes teamwork and collaboration to bring about success.

360 Degree Leader. We are a flat, non-hierarchical organization with a matrix structure that is dynamic and evolving. We expect you to be self-aware enough to recognize your position of unstated leadership within the company. You should have a demonstrated ability to lead and influence people through both formal and informal constructs and in situations where there is lack of clarity across teams. Finally, we need people who identify gaps and breakdowns and solve them immediately, rather than point them out and step back. You should also seek 360 feedback to help inform your growth trajectory as a leader.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Champion Internal Collaboration:
Serve as the key bridge among internal Anduril departments—engineering, product, logistics, and more—to align efforts in developing and deploying integrated hardware-software C2 solutions that meet operational needs.

Drive Product Adoption and Scale:
Champion the adoption of Connected Warfare products across Anduril divisions and into adjacent customer missions by identifying high-impact integration opportunities, building compelling internal use cases, and partnering with growth and engineering teams to expand the product footprint beyond initial deployments.

Facilitate Continuous Improvement:
Design and implement user feedback loops to systematically gather, prioritize, and share insights and challenges experienced by Anduril C2 products, ensuring that this valuable input drives collaborative enhancements.

Influence Product Evolution:
Actively engage with program and engineering teams to provide feedback that refines product features and optimizes user workflows, promoting a culture of shared excellence.

Build Strategic Internal Relationships:
Foster strong working relationships with program, engineering, and growth leaders across divisions, ensuring trust, clear communication, and alignment of goals to drive synergy and increased adoption of Anduril products.

Sales and Financial Metrics Tracking:
Navigate and utilize various internal business systems (e.g., ERP, CRM, BI tools) to accurately track, analyze, and report on product sales and key financial metrics.

We are looking for a Senior Tracking Software Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Foothill Ranch, CA. In this role, you will lead the development of advanced 2D and 3D tracking algorithms that maintain custody of space objects, processing sensor detections and messages into actionable tracks for space situational awareness missions. As a senior member of the team, you will architect and implement sophisticated multi-target tracking systems using cutting-edge state estimation and data association techniques, develop physics-based models to validate performance, and mentor engineers while working closely with software teams to deploy your algorithms into operational systems. You will drive technical decisions, lead design reviews, and serve as a subject matter expert in tracking algorithms. This will require deep expertise in tracking algorithms, state estimation (Kalman filtering), data association methods (JPDA, MHT), proficiency in MATLAB, Python, and C++, experience with modeling and simulation, and demonstrated technical leadership. If you are someone who enjoys solving challenging tracking problems involving clutter, maneuvering targets, contested sensing environments, and real-time mission constraints while guiding others to do the same then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead systems engineering and algorithm development tasks supporting space and missile defense tracking missions, providing technical direction and guidance to team members
  • Architect and implement advanced object tracking and state estimation algorithms, including track initiation, maintenance, correlation, and termination
  • Design and evaluate multi-target tracking and multi-sensor fusion approaches for EO/IR, RF, or hybrid sensor architectures
  • Lead the implementation of advanced data association techniques including JPDA (Joint Probabilistic Data Association), MHT (Multiple Hypothesis Tracking), nearest neighbor, and track-to-track fusion methods
  • Drive innovation in data association techniques, exploring novel approaches and optimizations for complex operational scenarios
  • Build sophisticated physics-based models and conduct modeling and simulation including Monte Carlo analysis, recorded sensor playback, and hardware-in-the-loop testing to validate tracking performance
  • Lead performance analysis, trade studies, and simulation-based assessments of tracking robustness under challenging conditions (maneuvering targets, clutter, countermeasures, degraded sensing)
  • Collaborate with and mentor software engineers to transition tracking algorithms from MATLAB/Python prototypes to production C/C++ code optimized for real-time operational systems
  • Drive the systems engineering lifecycle including requirements decomposition, trade studies on tracking approaches, verification and validation planning, and design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR)
  • Lead technical documentation efforts and present at design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and customer engagements
  • Mentor engineers in tracking algorithm development, state estimation theory, and best practices
  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert for tracking systems, advising program leadership on algorithm performance, risks, and opportunities

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or related technical field
  • 8+ years of experience designing, implementing, and testing multi-target tracking algorithms for aerospace, defense, or autonomous systems
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in tracking algorithm development, including leading design efforts, mentoring team members, or serving as a subject matter expert
  • Deep theoretical and practical expertise with state estimation techniques, including Kalman Filters (EKF, UKF), multi-target tracking concepts, and Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) filters
  • Proven experience developing tracking algorithms that handle track initiation, maintenance, correlation, and termination in operational systems
  • Expert proficiency in algorithm development using MATLAB and/or Python with demonstrated experience transitioning algorithms to C++ for production deployment
  • Extensive experience with modeling, simulation, and testing workflows including Monte Carlo analysis, sensor data playback, or hardware-in-the-loop environments
  • Strong ability to work collaboratively with software engineers, systems engineers, and test teams to integrate tracking algorithms into operational systems
  • Excellent communication skills with experience presenting technical concepts to diverse audiences including engineers, program managers, and customers

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or related technical field
  • 10+ years of experience in tracking algorithm development for defense or aerospace applications
  • Experience in one or more of the following domains: missile defense or space systems; EO/IR or RF sensors; kill vehicles, interceptors, or countermeasures
  • Extensive experience handling challenging tracking scenarios including track fragmentation, ghost tracks, sensor outages, and high-clutter environments
  • Deep familiarity with real-time system constraints, embedded systems, or edge compute optimization
  • Demonstrated experience leading efforts within the systems engineering design cycle, including requirements decomposition and traceability, algorithm design and trade studies, verification and validation (V&V), and documentation and design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR)
  • Experience with MBSE tools (Cameo, Rhapsody, DOORS)
  • Experience with advanced tracking techniques such as Random Finite Set (RFS) methods, Probability Hypothesis Density (PHD) filters, or machine learning-enhanced tracking
  • Publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conferences related to tracking, state estimation, or sensor fusion
  • Experience briefing and interfacing with government customers (DoD, IC, or similar)
  • Track record of delivering tracking solutions into operational systems or fielded products

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team is building Thunder - an autonomous attack rotorcraft built to fight alongside crewed combat aviation to deliver overwhelming mass effects deep beyond the front lines. The team in London builds the Mission System and the autonomy that makes aircraft like Thunder work.

Autonomy is only as good as the link that carries it. Thunder is a compact airframe with weapons, sensors and radios competing for the same antenna real estate, flying low and in formation, in a spectrum that is actively contested. That is the problem you would own.

ABOUT THE JOB

We’re looking for a Senior Weapons Integration Engineer to join the Thunder team in Costa Mesa, CA. As a Senior Weapons Integration Engineer, you will lead the end-to-end technical execution and tactical integration of kinetic stores and weapon systems onto an advanced autonomous aircraft program co-developed with our airframe partner.

You will architect critical Store Management System (SMS) trades, define digital and physical interfaces (e.g., MIL-STD-1760, UAI), and ensure the platform's mission software reliably interfaces with diverse modern armaments. Serving as the platform's weapons authority, you will interface closely with our internal autonomy teams, our partner’s airframe structures group, weapons suppliers, and government customers to synchronize mechanical bay constraints, safe separation dynamics, and fire-control architectures. You will drive integration test plans, hazard and system-level analyses, and regulatory flight safety baselines required for technical design reviews and weapon safety boards (e.g., WSESRB/NNMSB). This high-impact role is instrumental in transforming an autonomous platform into an operationally decisive, airworthy combat capability.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead or support efforts performing integration, verification and/or validation of weapon systems onto Anduril or other-party platforms
  • Develop program plans, estimates, and schedules
  • Develop system/architecture designs, perform system level analysis, and generate requirements
  • Adjudicate conflicting design/development requirements with broader team
  • Develop and present technical material for reviews and meetings
  • Support lab, ground, and flight test events
  • Develop/maintain Interface Control Documents, Software Requirement Specifications, Performance Specifications, presentations and review test plans/procedures
  • Coordinate and interface with customers, contractors, and engineering groups assigned to projects
  • Support ongoing operation of the weapons system(s)
  • Provide support for proposals/white papers for future efforts or capabilities
  • Provide direction to design and to technical staff
  • Work with and manage suppliers to develop and procure hardware
  • Identify risks and manage mitigation plans to closure

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelors, Masters or PhD degree in engineering, computer science or a related technical discipline and progressive engineering experience as follows;
  • 5+ years of combined work experience with post-graduate study in an engineering discipline
  • Familiarity with Air-to-Air/Air-to-Ground weapons, MIL-STD-1553, MIL-STD-1760, and logical Interface Control Documents
  • Experience integrating weapons, payloads, or avionics onto aircraft
  • Experience with weapon or tactical datalinks
  • Must be customer focused with the ability to formulate and implement plans to resolve technical engineering problems
  • Ability to travel to support program and test events (up to 25%)
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with Seek Eagle and Non-Nuclear Munitions Safety Board processes

  • Software programming or embedded systems experience (familiarity with C/C++/Rust, MATLAB, Python, etc.)

We are looking for a Signal Processing Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Foothill Ranch, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for developing discrimination algorithms that separate threats from non-threats, decoys, and debris using EO/IR sensor data for space and missile defense missions. You will design signal processing pipelines including detection, feature extraction, image processing, and develop advanced decision logic to enhance classification performance. This will require deep expertise in signal processing for EO/IR sensors, classification algorithms, detection theory, and proficiency in algorithm development. If you are someone who loves the challenge of extracting signal from noise, thrives on building algorithms that work in contested and degraded environments, and wants to see your work protecting forces against emerging threats in space, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Develop discrimination algorithms for EO/IR sensors that classify and distinguish threats from decoys, debris, and clutter in real-time operational environments
  • Design and implement signal processing pipelines including detection algorithms, feature extraction, image processing, and measurement generation from sensor data
  • Develop and integrate advanced decision logic to enhance classification performance and adapt to evolving threat environments
  • Analyze and optimize algorithms for EO/IR sensor phenomenology including noise characteristics, SNR considerations, resolution limits, and environmental effects
  • Build physics-based models and conduct modeling and simulation including Monte Carlo analysis, recorded sensor playback, and hardware-in-the-loop testing to validate discrimination performance
  • Develop analysis tools to characterize discrimination algorithm performance under challenging conditions such as countermeasures, clutter, and degraded sensing environments
  • Collaborate with software engineers to transition discrimination algorithms from prototypes to production code optimized for operational deployment
  • Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand mission needs, present discrimination solutions, and demonstrate system performance

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and testing signal processing algorithms for EO/IR sensors or similar sensing modalities in aerospace or defense systems
  • Strong understanding of EO/IR sensor phenomenology including noise characteristics, detection theory, SNR analysis, resolution limits, and environmental effects
  • Experience with signal processing techniques including detection algorithms, filtering, and measurement generation from sensor data
  • Proficiency in algorithm development and coding with demonstrated experience transitioning algorithms to production environments
  • Experience with modeling, simulation, and testing workflows including physics-based modeling, Monte Carlo analysis, or hardware-in-the-loop environments
  • Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers, systems engineers, and test teams to integrate algorithms into operational systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or related technical field
  • Experience with space or missile defense systems, threat discrimination, or intercept systems
  • Experience developing advanced decision logic or adaptive algorithms for classification workflows
  • Demonstrated experience with pattern recognition, computer vision, or image processing for defense applications
  • Experience handling discrimination challenges including countermeasures, spoofing, and contested/degraded sensing environments
  • Background in fire control systems, guidance/navigation/control (GNC) integration, or kill vehicle systems
  • Experience with radar systems, RF signal processing, or multi-modal sensor fusion
  • Demonstrated experience working within systems engineering processes including requirements management, trade studies, and verification/validation
  • Experience with MBSE tools (Cameo, Rhapsody, DOORS) or systems engineering toolchains

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril's Continuous Integration platform enables every engineering team at Anduril to build, test, and deploy our products globally. When it is slow or unreliable, every team downstream pays for it - but when it's reliable and zippy, life is awesome. In this role you will ensure awesomeness; you will help build and deliver fully automated, faster and more reliable CI pipelines that lets teams ship without breaking the teams next to them. This role directly supports and enables a critical business line, so your first focus is the functional and operational improvements that most directly speed up their build, test, and deployment experience. The work you do will compound across other products as well. You will deliver against a shared roadmap, own concrete epics end to end, and instrument the metrics that show whether the CI experience is actually getting better. You will work across a complex delivery ecosystem, multi-stage release pipelines and Cloud and Robot environments, where correctness has measurable consequences. WHAT YOU WILL DO

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

About the Team

The M&A Business Systems team is the tip of the spear when Anduril acquires a new company. We are a small, fast-moving team responsible for integrating acquired companies into Anduril's Oracle Fusion ERP and best in class internal tools. We operate an aggressive acquisition roadmap and run multiple integration programs in parallel at any given time, enabling operations across the U.S. and internationally.

The Role

We are seeking an early career, quick to learn Solution Analyst, M&A to join the M&A Business Systems team and own hands-on configuration, data manipulation, and integration work across our full acquisition portfolio. A successful Solution Analyst will own much of the configuration and data work related to M&A. They will also be expected to grow their skillset by being embedded in the full integration lifecycle from the moment a deal closes: involved in onsite discovery, providing fit/gap analyses, completing build/configuration, converting data, executing test scenarios, and supporting Go-Lives at acquired sites. You'll be the person who ensures a newly acquired company can actually operate from day one inside Anduril's enterprise systems across all work streams.

You will work directly with the broader M&A systems team, collaborating across EngOS/PLM (Teamcenter), home-grown manufacturing and planning systems (Forge, MRPSpeed), customer and contract mgmt (Salesforce), and the Oracle Fusion ERP core spanning procurement, inventory, order management and finance/accounting. If you thrive in high-tempo, ambiguous environments where the answer isn't in a playbook yet and you have the scars to prove you've been here before, this role was written for you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data conversion for M&A integrations: extract source data, map to Oracle templates, derive business rules for undefined fields, validate data quality and leverage AI tools to eliminate manual work and build repeatable processes for future acquisitions
  • Support legal entity design and intercompany configuration for new acquisitions, translating operational, accounting and legal requirements into application design decisions for ERP and satellite system teams.
  • Execute system configuration for new Oracle legal entities across workstreams: DTB (Design to Build), WMS (Warehouse/Inventory Operations), PTP (Procure to Pay), OTC (Order to Cash), PTC (Projects to Close), and RTR (Record to Report).
  • Plan and execute testing cycles, build and run test cases, resolve defects, and drive root cause and resolution with satellite system teams (Teamcenter, Forge, Salesforce, MRPSpeed).
  • Travel onsite to acquired companies to lead discovery sessions, demos, deliver hands-on ERP training, and provide Go-Live and Hypercare support.
  • Collaborate with the M&A PM and enablement functions to build and maintain standardized data templates, integration SOPs, and reusable training materials (videos, guides) that scale the team's playbook across future acquisitions.
  • Partner with cross-functional satellite tool teams (PLM/Teamcenter, Forge/MES, Salesforce, WMS) to coordinate configuration changes and test dependencies on acquisition timelines.
  • Operate in agile/sprint-based delivery: own your workstream, hit sprint milestones, surface blockers early, and keep integration programs moving without being told what to do next.
  • Contribute to and maintain the M&A ERP knowledge base, capture design decisions, configuration documentation, and lessons learned in Airtable and Quip so future integrations start further ahead.


Required Characteristics

Anduril is an extremely fast-paced defense technology company. The M&A team runs at a pace most teams don't. The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Bias for Action — you move fast, escalate blockers immediately, and don't wait for perfect information to make progress.
  • Outcome-Oriented — you care about Day 1 Go-live working, not about process elegance. You work backward from the deadline.
  • Ownership — you own your workstream end to end. If something is at risk, you raise it and you fix it.
  • Agility — acquisition timelines shift. Legal entity decisions get made late. You adapt without drama.
  • Dive Deep — you're comfortable in the weeds of data templates, config workbooks, and test scripts. You spot the gap before it becomes a blocker.
  • Customer Focus — you treat acquired company employees as your users. You build trust with teams who are often new to enterprise systems and nervous about change.
  • First Principles Thinking — you don't just replicate how the last integration was done. You ask whether it was the right way and improve the playbook.


Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on ERP experience (Oracle Fusion preferred but will accept NetSuite, SAP, or similar), including configuration, data conversion/loading, and troubleshooting — M&A integration or rapid deployment experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience executing data migrations: extracting source data, mapping to target templates, validating quality, and coordinating loads.
  • Deep knowledge in at least one or more particular work streams (order to cash, procure to pay, record to report, design to build, etc.) strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of legal entity and intercompany transaction design — experience configuring new legal entities in Oracle Fusion is a significant plus.
  • Proven ability to work in agile/sprint-based delivery environments; comfortable writing user stories, tracking work in PM tools (Airtable, Jira, or equivalent), and iterating quickly.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills — you can work with accounting, legal, ops, engineers, and ERP developers in the same day and adjust your communication style for each.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%, including to acquired company sites domestically and internationally, for discovery, onboarding, testing, and Go-live support.
  • U.S. Person status required (access to export-controlled data).
  • Ability to work onsite full-time at primary office location.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with M&A ERP integration programs or ERP rapid deployment / accelerated implementation methodologies.
  • Familiarity with connected enterprise tools: Teamcenter/PLM, Salesforce, Odoo, or similar.
  • Prior experience at Big 4 consulting firms in ERP implementation practices.
  • Aerospace & Defense, complex manufacturing, or government contracting industry background.
  • Experience building reusable enablement content — training videos, SOPs, how-to guides — for end users who are new to ERP systems.
  • Undergraduate degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Supply Chain, or related field.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This position will be filled by a highly motivated Airframe and Power Plant Mechanic with a passion for developmental flight test of a new and revolutionary products contributing valued mechanical expertise in all fields of aircraft and missile systems maintenance. You will work heavily with the program leadership and a wide spectrum of cross-departments to help build a team focused on solving hard problems and changing the industry forever. The role will be responsible for aircraft mechanical assessment, maintenance coordination, flight execution, and reporting on all facets of flying systems readiness to the test program.

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril works across the entire spectrum of products and business lines, as well as all flight operations and test range management. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, sub-component qualification testing and much more. In short, if it involves test, we support it. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this a fantastic opportunity.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Assist with many aspects of aircraft fabrication, assembly, and operation including structural fabrication, mechanical integration (flight control surfaces, propulsion, etc.), composites fabrication, and avionics build/integration/test.
  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain aircraft and subsystems including landing gear, fuel system, flight control, and propulsion.
  • Perform common airframe construction techniques such as utilizing rivets, mechanical fasteners, nut plates, etc.
  • Complete aircraft and equipment documentation (maintenance manuals, Check list, Flight logs etc.)
  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain site support equipment.
  • Communicate mechanical assessment with engineering and production.
  • Perform validation and testing of various electronic components using equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, and test racks.
  • Perform proper FOD and tool control practices.
  • Lift and move heavy objects up to 50 lbs.
  • Operate fork lifts and pallet jacks.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Valid A&P license.
  • 10 years or more of airframe and power plant experience.
  • 8 years or more of missile or rocket system development experience.
  • Must have strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient with computer use (standard browser, word processing applications).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a fast paced, challenging work environment.
  • Willing to be multi-capable. Which shall include some electronics troubleshooting and repair.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to travel as required for test planning and execution.
  • Able to work extended hours as required.
  • Ability to stand and walk for long periods.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.
  • In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

As a Senior Battery Engineer, you will drive the development of energy storage systems (ESSs) that power Anduril's next-generation drone products, from concept through full-rate production. Our battery packs enable everything from long-endurance loitering munitions to tactical unmanned aircraft operating in the most demanding environments. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical owner of ESS delivery, working on extremely accelerated timelines and acting as the main interface between the Core Battery Group and internal product teams. You will take individual ownership of battery packs from cell selection through pack prototype iterations to pack production. If you are a self-starter with deep technical experience in defense, aerospace, aviation, or electrification industries who thrives on hands-on problem-solving and extreme ownership, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own End-to-End ESS Delivery: Drive battery pack development from concept to production on extremely accelerated timelines, taking full ownership of achieving performance requirements, cost targets, reliability issue resolution, design-for-manufacturing (DFM) support, and more.
  • Serve as the Core Interface: Act as the main point of contact between the Core Battery Group and internal Anduril product teams, maintaining a positive, collaborative relationship throughout the program lifecycle while sharing expertise to the rest of the company.
  • Define Requirements: Collaborate with program teams to translate user stories and CONOPs into actionable ESS requirements.
  • Drive Cell Selection: Lead battery cell selection using accelerated de-risking and validation processes.
  • Lead Design Iterations: Partner with mechanical engineers to deliver design revisions across component testing, mini (scaled down) modules, prototype packs, and production packs—defining the maturity required at each stage.
  • Support Manufacturing Ramp: Work with manufacturing engineering to scale from prototype pack revisions to production units, ensuring adequate validation and reliability verification in an organized fashion through tools like DFMEAs.
  • Get Hands-On: Directly support battery bring-up, test, debug, and vehicle integration activities.
  • Sustain Fielded Systems: Conduct root cause analysis and data processing on fielded ESSs to drive countermeasures and design updates as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or fundamental Physical Sciences with an applied focus on energy storage technologies, plus 10+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting energy storage systems.
  • Past ownership of battery pack design and prototype assembly.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering robust, high-performance energy storage systems with substantial technical ownership and contributions.
  • Demonstrated technical contributions to drive one or more energy storage systems from prototype to production.
  • Professional awareness of at least one: 1) Battery management system (BMS) electrical design, 2) BMS algorithms and software functionality, 3) BMS validation against operational requirements.
  • Professional awareness of at least one: 1) Battery cell characterization methods (mission profile validation, equivalent-circuit model characterization, cycle/calendar life assessment, safety features, etc.), 2) Battery cell or pack modeling/simulation in Matlab or Simulink.
  • Basic capabilities and understanding of CAD tools (CATIA, NX, SolidWorks).
  • Understanding of UN38.3, NAVSEA S9310, and/or equivalent (UL, IEC) battery safety standards.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or fundamental Physical Sciences with a focus on energy storage technologies.
  • Understanding and familiarity with MIL-STD-882, MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-704, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464.
  • Advanced experience designing battery pack components and sub-assemblies with CAD tools.
  • Experience with rapid deployment of drones/UAVs.
  • Experience with student lead competition/collegian competitions (e.g. Formula SAE/Baja, Hyperloop, racing, small startups).
  • Advanced expertise with: 1) Battery management system (BMS) electrical design, 2) BMS algorithms and software functionality, 3) BMS validation against operational requirements.
  • Advanced expertise with: 1) Battery cell characterization methods (mission profile validation, equivalent-circuit model characterization, cycle/calendar life assessment, safety features, etc.), 2) Battery cell or pack modeling/simulation in Matlab or Simulink.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

WHAT YOU'LL DO


Motor Control Algorithm Development
•       Design and implement field-oriented control (FOC), six-step commutation, and direct torque control algorithms for BLDC and PMSM motors
•       Develop sensorless rotor position estimation techniques (back-EMF observer, sliding-mode observer, high-frequency injection) for applications where Hall sensors or encoders are not viable
•       Design current, speed, and position control loops with rigorous bandwidth, stability margins, and disturbance rejection specifications
Modelling & Simulation (MIL / SIL / HIL)
•       Build high-fidelity motor and inverter plant models in MATLAB / Simulink, including magnetic saturation, iron losses, and thermal coupling
•       Develop controller models and validate performance through Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) simulation against requirements
•       Execute Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing using Embedded Coder auto-generated C code to verify fixed-point scaling, quantisation effects, and code-generation fidelity
•       Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) integration with real-time simulators (dSPACE, Typhoon HIL, or equivalent) for full controller board validation
•       Integrate Simulink auto-coded algorithm modules with the microcontroller RTOS, peripheral drivers, and application framework
Firmware & Embedded Systems
•       Implement motor control firmware in C on microcontrollers (e.g., STM32, TI C2000, NXP S32K) with hard real-time constraints
•       Configure and optimise motor control peripherals: PWM timers, ADC synchronisation, encoder/Hall interfaces, comparator-based overcurrent protection
•       Architect firmware for deterministic control loop execution — interrupt prioritisation, DMA pipelines, and minimal-jitter scheduling
•       Implement fault detection, diagnosis, and safe-state management in firmware (overcurrent, overvoltage, overtemperature, sensor loss, stall, phase loss)
•       Develop communication interfaces (CAN, SPI, UART, RS-485) for command, telemetry, and diagnostics

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


•       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience
•       10+ years of professional experience designing and implementing motor control algorithms (FOC, Trapezoidal, or equivalent) for BLDC or PMSM motors
•       Strong foundation in classical and modern control theory — PID tuning, frequency-domain analysis, state estimation, observer design
•       Proficiency in MATLAB / Simulink, PLECS for control design, motor modelling, and auto-code generation (Embedded Coder or equivalent)
•       Deep experience writing production-quality embedded code on  microcontrollers with hard real-time motor control loops
•       Perform Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) integration with real-time simulators
•       Working knowledge of power electronics: three-phase inverter operation, PWM schemes, dead-time compensation, DC bus dynamics, and loss estimation
•       Hands-on experience with motor control peripherals — ADC triggering, encoder/Hall/resolver interfaces, PWM complementary outputs, hardware overcurrent comparators
•       Familiarity with communication protocols: CAN, SPI, I²C, UART, RS-485 etc
•       Strong bench skills — oscilloscope, current probe, frequency response analyser, dynamometer or motor test stand
•       U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export-controlled data (ITAR / EAR)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


•       Master's or PhD with thesis work in motor control, power electronics, or electric machine design
•       Experience with sensorless control techniques at low speed and standstill (HFI, pulsating voltage injection)
•       Experience with SiC or GaN power device integration and high-switching-frequency inverter design
•       Experience with real-time simulation platforms (dSPACE, OPAL-RT, Typhoon HIL) for HIL validation
•       Background in defense, automation, automotive, aerospace,  or robotics motor control applications — actuators, gimbal drives, electric propulsion
•       Experience with thermal modeling of motors and inverters, I²t protection, and derating algorithms
•       Active or ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Mechanical Actuation Systems

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. SUMMARY - ABOUT THE TEAM / JOB
Anduril’s Manufacturing team seeks a Staff Manufacturing Engineer. The Core Tech Manufacturing Team rapidly iterates and builds cutting-edge defense hardware, specializing in advanced mechanical actuators and motion control systems for Anduril’s sea and air vehicle platforms. This role encompasses the full manufacturing value-chain: Design for Manufacturability (DFM), specialized tooling, process optimization for precision mechanical and electromechanical assembly, vendor management, quality planning, and comprehensive documentation for high-reliability hardware.

Ideal candidates demonstrate holistic ownership in solving complex technical challenges with creative, physical solutions, personally manufactured or overseen, within fast-paced, resource-limited settings.

As Staff Manufacturing Engineer, Mechanical Actuation Systems, you will strategically drive the end-to-end manufacturing development and production of high-performance mechanical actuators, providing expert technical guidance and strategic insight to ensure robust operation and reliability in challenging sea and air vehicle environments. This role requires exceptional technical expertise and strategic problem-solving skills in DFM for complex mechanical and electromechanical systems, advanced precision assembly techniques, and rigorous test development for critical motion control components. If you are a hands-on technical expert who thrives on solving the toughest engineering challenges, delivering innovative manufacturing solutions, and elevating technical standards across the organization, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Serve as a primary technical driver for NPI initiatives, transitioning precision mechanical actuators and electromechanical systems from prototype to scalable production, architecting solutions for manufacturability, performance, and supply chain robustness.
  • Act as the principal manufacturing interface with Design Engineering, providing critical and influential feedback for Design For Manufacturability and Assembly (DFM/DFA) specifically for actuator components and integrated systems.
  • Architect, design, and oversee implementation of novel tooling, jigs, and fixturing for precision actuator assembly, alignment, and testing, setting best practices.
  • Establish and continuously optimize robust, repeatable process flows for complex actuator assemblies, encompassing intricate operations like bearing installation, gear train assembly, sensor integration, and sealing, setting benchmarks for manufacturing excellence.
  • Strategically define, implement, and optimize Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOM) and Routings within MES and ERP systems, specifically for actuator sub-assemblies and final product builds.
  • Drive the development and standardization of comprehensive manufacturing documentation, including detailed work instructions, quality control plans, inspection requirements, and environmental test procedures for high-reliability actuators.
  • Design, validate, and strategically implement robust test methodologies and equipment for critical actuator performance characteristics (e.g., torque, speed, precision) and environmental qualification (e.g., vibration, thermal, ingress protection).
  • Provide deep hands-on technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and technicians during prototype builds, troubleshooting, and production validation of actuator hardware, fostering technical excellence.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 12+ years of progressive manufacturing or design engineering experience, specifically with precision mechanical components, electromechanical hardware, or motion control systems.
  • Proven track record of driving significant technical initiatives, providing expert guidance, and mentoring engineers.
  • Demonstrated expertise in delivering complex electromechanical hardware (actuators, robotics) in fast-paced, resource-constrained environments.
  • Deep expertise in establishing and optimizing manufacturing environments, including MBOM creation, MES integration, and Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) for actuator production.
  • Proficient with Siemens NX for CAD and Teamcenter for PLM software.
  • Hands-on experience physically manufacturing hardware (e.g., precision machining, additive manufacturing, electromechanical assembly, fabrication). Personal projects in robotics or control systems a plus.
  • Strong interest in manufacturing high-performance defense hardware and a commitment to continuous technical mastery.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Hands-on experience with control systems, servo motors, or high-performance electromechanical components in aerospace, marine, or robotics.
  • Experience with harsh environment manufacturing considerations (e.g., sealing, corrosion prevention, vibration isolation, lubrication).
  • Familiarity with aerospace (e.g., DO-160, MIL-STD-810) or marine environmental testing and qualification standards.
  • Software scripting (e.g., Python, MATLAB) for automation, data analysis, or testbed control.
  • Experience with advanced manufacturing processes like precision grinding, gear cutting, or specialized surface treatments for critical components.

You will work on new aircraft development in a lean, high-ownership culture where you directly shape the product and operate at a velocity to fly new designs within months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will work closely with the Omen program leadership and a wide spectrum of cross-departments as part of a team focused on solving hard problems and changing the industry forever. Join our dynamic team and help us build the next generation of autonomous flight systems.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS (our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift), the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.

This work is anchored by Arsenal-2, our software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network.

MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.

This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Staff Product Manager for Manufacturing Software, you will lead product for the entirety of Maritime Digital Production. Rather than owning a single line of effort, you will set product vision and strategy across MDP's domains: the factory data platform, the manufacturing execution applications, the scheduling and optimization engine, and the AI systems that remove manual toil from the shop floor and business operations. You will be the senior product voice for the function, balancing investment across these domains, raising the product bar, and guiding the other product managers on the team.

Product Leadership

You set the product bar for the entire function. You mentor and guide other product managers, establish the product practices and standards the team works to, and create clarity across domains so that individual owners can move fast without losing the thread of the broader strategy. You lead through influence rather than authority, earning trust with engineering, operations, and leadership across MDP.

Product Strategy

You can “see around the corner” for the function, crafting the vision, portfolio roadmap, and critical dependencies well beyond the current cycle. You constantly engage with stakeholders and leadership to solicit input and buy-in, proactively communicating goals and managing expectations. You escalate and own the largest tradeoffs and decision points across the portfolio.

Product Prioritization

You work backward from strategy to set clear outcomes across domains in partnership with your engineering, design, and operations leaders. You build the structures that let multiple teams prioritize competing work within rapid development cycles, and you keep the portfolio adaptable as new information arrives.

Problem Discovery and Solution Generation

You become attached to problems, not solutions. You seek out real-world context through onsite user research on the factory floor, direct conversations with technicians and operators, internal expert feedback, existing product data, and industry investigation. You separate what a customer asks for from what a customer actually needs, capture core workflows, and translate them into well-scoped requirements and success hypotheses across the portfolio.

Product Execution

From design to delivery, you fill gaps wherever needed to make well-scoped solutions a reality across the function. You proactively communicate with teams and leadership, approach solutions with humility and creativity to hit milestones, and set a high bar for how products are deployed, adopted, and supported on the floor.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Setting product vision and multi-year strategy across all of Maritime Digital Production, and making the portfolio-level tradeoffs about where the function invests across its domains
  • Owning the cross-domain roadmap and prioritization, resolving competing demands between factory data, manufacturing execution, scheduling and optimization, and AI initiatives
  • Gathering and refining both functional requirements and non-functional requirements such as tool capacity, performance, and reliability, and setting the standard for how requirements are captured and prioritized across the team
  • Communicating across stakeholders and senior leadership, and exercising the judgment to tell whether a stakeholder truly needs what they are asking for or whether the underlying problem is better solved another way
  • Walking the factory floor, talking directly with technicians and operators about how their work is going, and turning what you hear into opportunities to fix and improve the products across the portfolio
  • Navigating the organizational dynamics between Maritime Digital Production and partner platform teams, advocating from the customer point of view when Maritime's needs differ from how a platform team would prefer to build
  • Aligning and collaborating with the Corporate Technology product organization, keeping the Maritime product roadmap in sync with and aware of the broader CorpTech product roadmap so the two organizations move in step on shared platforms, standards, and dependencies

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 12+ years in a software product management role or similar leading role in product development, including experience owning a portfolio or leading product across multiple teams or domains
  • Demonstrated ability to set product vision and strategy at a functional or organizational level and drive it through multiple teams
  • Experience mentoring or guiding other product managers and establishing product practices and standards
  • Domain expertise within hardware-related industries such as manufacturing, supply chain, warehousing, or logistics
  • Demonstrated ability to gather and refine both functional and non-functional requirements (such as capacity, performance, and reliability) and turn them into a prioritized backlog
  • Strong understanding of the interplay between enterprise systems, including ERP, WMS, MES, PLM, and supplier portals
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, operations stakeholders, and senior leadership, and to judge whether a request reflects a real underlying need
  • Demonstrated success working directly with end users in operational environments, including time spent on a production or factory floor observing workflows firsthand
  • Ability to navigate cross-team and cross-department dynamics, representing the customer point of view and building alignment when priorities differ
  • Experience aligning a product roadmap with a partner or platform organization, keeping priorities in sync across groups that share technology and dependencies
  • Demonstrated success decomposing complex problems into addressable component parts and arranging the correct sequencing across teams
  • Proven ability to “see around corners” by crafting product strategy well beyond the current development cycle
  • Comfort maturing products from MVP to enterprise-grade production at scale
  • Must be able to travel up to 25% of the time
  • U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

  • Experience building or owning manufacturing execution systems (MES), shop floor control systems, or operational software for factory, warehouse, or field environments
  • Hands-on experience in manufacturing industries with time spent on assembly lines or in production facilities working directly with operators and technicians

Anduril is seeking a highly skilled, mission-driven, highly organized, detail-oriented, and responsive Staff Program Manager to provide critical tactical support and operational oversight for our strategic defense clients, driving the adoption, expansion, and long-term success of Anduril's cutting-edge Rocket Motor Systems. Staff Robotics Engineers lead the delivery of vehicle perception and planning capability integrated in to our products, acting as technical leads, extremely senior individual contributors, and/or as team leads that are also hands-on contributors. This includes systems analysis, sensor selection and integration, perception architecture and implementation, motion planning, health management, behaviour analysis, simulation and test infrastructure, and interfaces with lower- and higher-level systems. We expect Staff Robotics Engineers to demonstrate unparalleled end-to-end outcome ownership, driving the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of safe and effective vehicle autonomy on Anduril’s autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own customer success through the design and delivery of a multi-year, multi-stakeholder software roadmap that spans across multiple teams
  • Leverage internal product and program-specific engineering teams to rapidly deliver capability beyond the scope of current platforms, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time
  • Partner with external teams, collaborating on interfacing requirements between diverse systems and technologies
  • Lead teams that architect, design and implement trusted safe navigation, collision avoidance, and situational awareness systems that balance constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment
  • Drive the development and implementation of sensor suites, perception algorithms, planning algorithms, and test fixtures to deliver safe navigation and effective operation of Anduril’s autonomous vehicles
  • Perform high impact IC work in architecture and implementation across the whole perception and planning stack

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.

We are scaling at an historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own navigation, guidance, and control for a maritime autonomous vehicle. Reporting to the Cognitive Systems Lead, you will lead a team covering inertial navigation, safe navigation systems, and actuation control software. You will define how the vehicle knows where it is, where it needs to go, and how it gets there across GPS-denied ocean environments.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own GN&C architecture: inertial navigation, safe navigation, and actuation control software
  • Lead INS integration and GPS-denied navigation solution development
  • Drive Safe Navigation System design and safety certification approach
  • Define actuation and control software requirements in coordination with body subsystem
  • Manage navigation compute requirements and hardware selection
  • Lead trade studies across navigation sensor suites and fusion approaches
  • Lead and mentor junior engineers across GN&C sub-disciplines
  • Interface with VMS, communications, and mission systems teams
  • Support prototype integration, testing, and sea trials
  • Travel up to 25% to test sites and customer locations
  • Own GN&C architecture: inertial navigation, safe navigation, actuation control software, depth keeping and hover
  • Lead trade studies across navigation sensor suites and fusion approaches, including make vs buy

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent
  • 8+ years of experience in GN&C, inertial navigation, or vehicle control systems
  • Experience with INS, Kalman filtering, or sensor fusion
  • Familiarity with control system design for marine or aerospace vehicles
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with AUV, UUV, or submarine navigation systems
  • Working knowledge of GPS-denied navigation techniques (DVL, USBL, terrain-aided navigation)
  • Experience with safety-critical navigation system design
  • Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent modeling tools
  • Experience in defense or maritime robotics
