Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

We’re building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the head of the Data Foundation pillar of our Analytics and Data Insights team, you’ll lead the team that makes Cohere’s data trustworthy, governed, and available: the warehouse every analytics surface runs on, the pipelines that keep it fresh, the access model that keeps it secure, and the agentic analytics layer that lets anyone at Cohere (and their agents) ask questions of governed data directly.

Your team owns the full data lifecycle. You’ll run ingestion into BigQuery from internal and external data sources, orchestrate it in Airflow and Cloud Run, model the data warehouse in dbt, and serve the results through Looker, export APIs, and customer-facing analytics surfaces. Everything is provisioned as code in Terraform, and governance is part of the design: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, and documented access paths that let people and agents move fast without putting data at risk.

This role is both highly visible and highly impactful, and you’ll inherit a solid structure on which to build the rest of the stack: a Terraform-provisioned warehouse framework, dbt modeling conventions, an alerting and incident-response practice, and documentation patterns to keep everything discoverable. The roadmap is set with big bets in flight: scaling that framework across the company, standing up an internal analytics agent with a real eval harness, and consolidating institutional knowledge into a self-correcting and self-maintaining system that keeps context centralized, current, and documented, rather than dispersed and in people’s heads.

Responsibilities

As the head of the Data Foundation pillar, you will:

  • Build and lead the team. Hire and grow a team of data and infrastructure engineers; set the technical bar; develop strong talent and raise team performance, building leadership capability beneath you.

  • Set the roadmap from company strategy. Own and sequence the Data Foundation roadmap: the warehouse buildout, the agentic analytics program, data governance, and the platform work that unblocks our other pillars. You’ll make the trade-offs and carry the cross-functional impact that comes with them.

  • Own the data platform end to end. Ingestion (managed connectors and an open-source connector framework), orchestration on Airflow and Cloud Run, warehouse modeling in BigQuery with dbt (raw, core, mart layers), and serving through Looker, export APIs, and semantic layers. All of it provisioned as code in Terraform.

  • Own data governance. Define how humans, service accounts, and agents get access to governed data: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, documented onboarding paths, audit logs, and sensitive requests (including legal holds) handled to deadline.

  • Operate for reliability. Run the alerting and anomaly-detection framework, own data freshness SLAs, lead incident response and postmortems, and turn every incident into a durable standard so the same class of failure doesn’t recur.

  • Lead the agentic analytics program. Wire the semantic layer into an internal analytics agent, build the eval harness that measures its accuracy, and make the eval-driven call on where AI earns its way into production. Apply the same discipline to automating data engineering work itself.

  • Set the standard for analytics across the company. The medallion framework, naming conventions, and testing patterns your team maintains become the way other teams ship analytics data. You’ll onboard new domains onto it and keep the docs accurate to how the systems actually work.

  • Partner across the org. Work with the North product and engineering teams on the analytics surfaces that ship in the product (including a customer-facing analytics export), with Business Insights on marts for the business, with Security on data governance, and with Legal on compliance-critical data requests.

Qualifications

You may be a good fit, if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience across data engineering, data infrastructure, or analytics platform work, with a strong management track record leading data platform or infrastructure teams

  • Serious hands-on history in data engineering or infrastructure before management. You can still read a Terraform plan, a dbt DAG, or an Airflow scheduler log and ask the question that matters

  • Production experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar), workflow orchestration (Airflow or similar), and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)

  • Depth in data modeling: you think in fact and dimension tables, raw/core/mart separation, and semantic layers, and you have opinions on where tests and contracts belong

  • A record of setting a team’s roadmap from company or function strategy and delivering outcomes that span teams, with the cross-functional partnerships to match

  • Operational excellence you can point to: alerting you trust, SLAs you meet, incidents you run to ground and write up so they teach

  • Exposure to data security and governance: IAM, access management, VPC service controls or equivalent, audit and compliance workflows

  • Genuine excitement about AI: you follow the research, have opinions, and are energized by building the data foundation an AI company (and its AI agents) runs on

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, leading a multi-workstream roadmap, and working directly with executives on priorities

If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply!

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.

The Network Delivery Implementation team builds and operates the future of Google's global network, connecting billions of users to our expanding services and enabling the world's imagination with dependable, universal connectivity. We own the full network life-cycle in our data centers and metro points of presence, driving continuous reliability, efficiency, and rapid service activation to meet the ever-growing demands of a connected world, with the goal to make connectivity ubiquitous between every machine and every user on the Internet.

In this role, you will be a key contributor as a member of the Global Network Delivery team, directly impacting Google's ability to deliver network capacity to its customers. You will influence the future of network delivery through automation and process innovation. You will possess teamwork, collaboration, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach to challenge the status quo.Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $126000 - $180000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Oversight and quality assurance of installation technicians for rack, stack and installation of networking equipment.
  • Test routers and commission, optical transport equipment, and other network devices in new and existing network nodes across Google's global network.
  • Generate implementation plans and provide technical leadership and guidance during deployment activities.
  • Work closely with project management, network engineering and rest of the engineering team to identify in advance potential problems in network installations, including in the areas of facility power (AC/DC), cooling, security/access, rack layout and cable management.
  • Own network documentation, updating and maintaining network drawings and plans.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Network or Telecom Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in DWDM or TCP/IP or system design operations methodology.
  • Experience interpreting and validating deployment packages (including orders and construction specs) to verify design accuracy and escalating discrepancies to engineering partners before installation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in one or more of the following disciplines: layer 1 optical transmissions systems, layer 3 routing TCP/IP, wireless networking, network design, or operations.
  • Experience identifying recurring errors in deployment packages or specifications and driving feedback loops to improve design accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Experience with Linux (e.g., running commands and navigating directories).
  • Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting, or SQL to query databases and track deployment consistency.
  • Familiarity with network troubleshooting and testing tools.
  • Ability to lead technical projects and troubleshoot complex field deployments alongside data center technicians and third party vendors, ensuring installation quality and resolving on-site technical blockers to meet timelines.

You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, the required use of OSHA standard safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience in maintenance of electrical distribution systems or construction/technical environment, or a related field.
  • Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.
  • Knowledge of electrical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, ATS/STS units, PDU/PMM units).
  • Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

Overview

Overview  

Microsoft Research India (MSR India) is a leading research lab advancing innovation across research areas like Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Theory, Technology & Empowerment, and Systems. The lab was established two decades ago and has been at the forefront of computer science research in India, home to world-class talent and projects.  

AI is rapidly changing both the systems we need to secure and the way security itself is practiced. AI systems increasingly interact with sensitive data, execute code, invoke tools, and take actions across complex environments, creating new security challenges. At the same time, advances in AI create opportunities to fundamentally rethink how we detect vulnerabilities, understand attacks, and build defences. 

Our team is pursuing an Growth-orientedresearch agenda at the intersection of security and AI, spanning both securing AI systems and using AI to advance security. Our research includes protecting sensitive data throughout AI pipelines, securing agentic and autonomous systems against new classes of attacks, developing principled defences for AI-enabled systems, and using AI to discover vulnerabilities, understand complex attack surfaces, and develop new security defences. 

As a Sr Researcher – Security and AI, you will push the state of the art in security for emerging AI systems. You will pursue  long-term research problems while also having opportunities to translate research advances into systems deployed at Microsoft scale. You will work with researchers and engineers across MSR India, Microsoft Research worldwide, and Microsoft product groups, enabling your work to have impact both in the research community and on systems used by millions of users. 

We are looking for candidates who: 

  • Are passionate about advancing the state of the art in security, privacy, cryptography, systems, and AI 

  • Have a strong research track record, demonstrated through publications at top venues such as IEEE S&P, USENIX Security, ACM CCS, NDSS, or other leading security, systems, cryptography, or machine learning venues 

  • Are excited about tackling emerging security problems created by AI and agentic systems 

  • Combine scientific rigor with strong systems thinking and the ability to turn research ideas into working prototypes 

  • Thrive in a highly collaborative, interdisciplinary research environment 

  • Take end-to-end ownership of open-ended research problems 



Responsibilities

Responsibilities 

  • Lead research at the intersection of security and AI, spanning both securing AI systems and applying AI to security problems. 

  • Develop new techniques to protect sensitive and proprietary data in AI systems and pipelines, including training, post-training, reinforcement learning, inference, and agentic workflows. 

  • Investigate the security of AI agents and autonomous systems, including attacks arising from tool use, code execution, memory, external data, multi-agent interaction, and long-running autonomous behavior, and develop principled defenses against them. 

  • Explore how AI can help address security problems, including discovering vulnerabilities and attack paths, understanding complex security environments, detecting attacks and anomalous behavior, and developing effective defenses. 

  • Investigate new attacks enabled or amplified by advances in AI and develop robust defenses against them. 

  • Design rigorous threat models, benchmarks, evaluations, and experimental methodologies for emerging AI security problems. 

  • Form hypotheses, build prototypes, design experiments, and evaluate new security mechanisms in realistic environments. 

  • Pursue  long-term research while identifying opportunities to translate promising ideas into practical security mechanisms. 

  • Publish at top-tier security, systems, cryptography, and machine learning venues, release research artifacts where appropriate, and help shape the research agenda in security and AI. 

  • Collaborate with research and product teams across Microsoft to translate research advances into stronger security for real-world Microsoft systems. 

  • Mentor interns and entry level researchers and contribute to MSR India's broader academic and research engagement. 

  • Embody our culture and values.  



Qualifications

Required Qualifications  

  • PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 

  • 1+ years of software engineering or research experience. 

  • Strong background in one or more areas of computer security, privacy, cryptography, computer systems, or machine learning. 

  • Strong research track record in security, cryptography, systems, machine learning, or a closely related area. 

  • Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and communicate results through publications, prototypes, open-source artifacts, or other impactful outcomes. 

  • Ability to identify and formulate important research problems, develop novel technical approaches, and evaluate them rigorously. 

  • Ability to work effectively across disciplinary boundaries and collaborate with diverse research and engineering teams. 

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Research experience in AI security, security of LLMs, or security of agentic systems. 

  • Experience with security and privacy techniques for AI training, post-training, inference, or data pipelines. 

  • Experience in areas such as systems security, applied cryptography, privacy-enhancing technologies, confidential computing, access control, or secure machine learning. 

  • Experience studying adversarial behavior, software vulnerabilities, attack surfaces, or security of large-scale systems. 

  • Experience applying LLMs or other AI techniques to security problems such as vulnerability discovery, security analysis, attack detection, or defense generation. 

  • Experience building and evaluating large-scale security or AI systems. 

  • Experience designing threat models, security benchmarks, adversarial evaluations, or red-team methodologies for emerging systems. 

  • Experience working across the research-to-production boundary and translating research ideas into real-world systems.

Overview

The Transformation & Strategic Deals Services Sales Lead is responsible for identifying, shaping and winning complex, high-value transformation engagements with strategic customers.

The role operates at the intersection of industry transformation, consulting, technology, partnerships and commercial deal-making. Rather than simply responding to established opportunities, this seller will create new transformation conversations, bring together the right ecosystem of partners and capabilities, and develop propositions around the customer's most important business priorities.

A critical measure of success will be the creation of lighthouse customer wins that demonstrate what is possible, establish credibility in the market and provide a blueprint that can be replicated across the next wave of customers.



Responsibilities

Originate large transformation opportunities

  • Build senior-level customer relationships and engage around CEO, CIO and business leadership priorities.
  • Identify transformation opportunities before they become traditional procurement exercises or defined projects.
  • Connect business challenges with consulting, engineering, adoption and technology capabilities to shape a broader transformation agenda.
  • Develop a pipeline of fewer, larger and more strategically important services opportunities.
  • Create momentum from concept and executive vision through to commercial engagement and execution.

 Lead with industry, not technology

  • Develop a deep understanding of the industries and customers being served.
  • Translate industry trends and disruption into relevant transformation conversations.
  • Start with the customer's business model, competitive environment and strategic priorities rather than individual products.
  • Work with industry leaders and account teams to identify repeatable transformation themes that can be taken to multiple customers.

Explore and build strategic partnerships

  • Partnership development should be a core part of the role, not an afterthought.
  • The seller will:
    • Identify where partners can increase credibility, capability, scale or speed.
    • Explore new partnership models that allow organisations to jointly approach transformational customer opportunities.
    • Connect technology, consulting, industry expertise and ecosystem capabilities into a compelling customer proposition.
    • Determine where we should lead, partner, co-create or orchestrate.
    • Establish relationships that can unlock opportunities beyond a single customer engagement.

 Construct lighthouse wins

  • The role should deliberately pursue a small number of engagements capable of becoming market-defining references.
  • The seller will work across sales, industry, consulting, engineering, delivery and partners to create the conditions for these lighthouse engagements to succeed.

 Industrialise the win

  • Winning the first customer is only part of the job.
  • The seller should capture:
    • What customer problem created the opportunity?
    • What executive conversation unlocked it?
    • What industry proposition resonated?
    • Which capabilities and partners were required?
    • What commercial construct worked?
    • What can be standardised?
    • Which customers should be targeted next?


Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, consulting sales, customer success, professional services, or business development roles. 
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent higher education qualification. 
  • Proven sales performance, with a track record of year-on-year quota/target achievement or overachievement.
  • Demonstrated experience selling to and supporting Enterprise and Public Sector customers.
  • Proven ability to build relationships with senior business and technology decision-makers.
  • Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong consultative selling, business development, and account management capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and executive engagement skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across virtual and cross-functional teams.

Overview

The Head of Growth and Strategy is responsible for helping shape and accelerate the next phase of growth across Microsoft Australia and New Zealand.

 

Sitting within the Office of the ANZ President, the role will bring together customer growth, market strategy and business transformation. It will identify where ANZ has the greatest opportunity to grow, translate those opportunities into a focused set of strategic priorities, and mobilise the organisation to execute against them.

 

This is not a strategy role that stops at defining the plan. The Head of Growth and Strategy will be accountable for turning strategy into action, working across the ANZ leadership team, customer organisations, industries and functions to remove barriers, accelerate priority growth opportunities and ensure our transformation agenda delivers measurable customer and business outcomes.

 

The role will also bring a strong outside-in perspective into the Office of the President, ensuring our choices are informed by changing customer needs, competitive dynamics, market trends and the opportunities created by AI.



Responsibilities

Drive the ANZ Customer Growth Agenda

  • Define the ANZ customer growth agenda, identifying the customers, industries, markets and opportunities where focused intervention can create disproportionate growth.
  • Use customer and market insight to identify emerging opportunities and structural barriers to growth.
  • Work with segment and industry leaders to translate growth opportunities into specific customer strategies and execution plans.
  • Establish a systematic approach to accelerating priority customers and opportunities, ensuring the right leadership attention, resources and capabilities are brought together.
  • Partner with sales, technical, partner, marketing and operational teams to remove obstacles that prevent customers from moving from experimentation to scaled transformation.
  • Bring the Office of the President to bear on the most important customer growth opportunities where executive sponsorship can materially change the outcome.

 

Own Strategy and Strategic Choices

  • Lead the development and ongoing stewardship of the ANZ strategy, ensuring there is a clear connection between market opportunity, customer priorities, investment choices and execution.
  • Bring an outside-in perspective through customer, competitor, partner, industry and macroeconomic insight.
  • Work with the ANZ Senior Leadership Team to identify the small number of strategic choices and growth plays where ANZ will differentiate and lead.
  • Translate those choices into clear priorities, investment decisions, ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Provide the agreed strategic choices and priority growth plays as the formal starting input to the annual planning process led by Business and Sales Operations.
  • Maintain a clear strategic narrative that connects our ambition for ANZ with what needs to change in the business to deliver it.

 

Lead the ANZ Transformation Plan

  • Own the integrated ANZ transformation roadmap required to deliver the growth strategy.
  • Translate strategic priorities into a small number of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives with clear executive sponsorship, each with a named SLT owner accountable for delivery, and with milestones and measures tracked within the ANZ rhythm of business.
  • Drive transformation across organisational boundaries, bringing together teams that do not directly report to the role.
  • Identify structural, process, capability and operating-model barriers to growth and mobilise the organisation to address them.
  • Leverage internal AI use cases across our own ways of working and use our experience to strengthen the transformation conversations we have with customers.
  • Assess whether the transformation portfolio is producing the intended customer and market outcomes, and escalate to the President with recommended corrective action where it is not
  • Bring evidence-based stop, start and accelerate recommendations on the growth and transformation portfolio to the President and SLT for decision.

 

Create a Strategy-to-Execution Growth Engine

  • Own the front end of the strategy-to-execution chain (insight → opportunity → strategic choice → investment case), and agree with Business and Sales Operations a clear hand-off into the operating plan.
  • Connect customer insight, market intelligence and business performance to leadership decision-making.
  • Define outcome measures for the President-sponsored growth plays, agreed with Business and Sales Operations and incorporated into the ANZ scorecard as the single source of performance truth
  • Identify cross-segment or cross-industry opportunities that individual teams may not see when operating independently.
  • Work closely with Finance, Sales Excellence & Operations, Marketing and the field to ensure resources follow the areas of greatest strategic opportunity.

 

Strengthen Executive Customer Engagement

  • Work with the ANZ President and leadership team to identify where executive engagement can unlock strategic customer relationships and transformation opportunities.
  • Help shape the President's engagement with priority customers, partners and market influencers around the strategic growth agenda.
  • Ensure insights from executive customer conversations feed directly back into the ANZ strategy and transformation plan.
  • Support strategic customer and partner engagements where a whole-of-Microsoft perspective or cross-business intervention is required.
  • Build a deeper understanding of the issues occupying CEOs and boards across Australia and New Zealand and translate these into opportunities for Microsoft to create greater customer value.

 

 Advise and Mobilise the ANZ Leadership Team

  • Act as a strategic adviser to the ANZ President on growth, market opportunity, customer priorities and transformation.
  • Lead through influence across a highly matrixed organisation, creating alignment around the priorities that matter most.
  • Challenge constructively where activities or investments are not aligned with the strategy.
  • Build coalitions across ANZ, Asia and corporate teams to accelerate outcomes that cannot be delivered locally alone.
  • Help build greater strategic, commercial and transformation capability across the broader leadership community.

 

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role should ultimately be visible in the market and with our customers, not simply in the quality of the strategy.

The Head of Growth and Strategy will have succeeded when:

  • ANZ has a clear and differentiated growth strategy understood and owned by the leadership team.
  • The organisation is focused on a smaller number of high-impact customer and market opportunities.
  • Priority customers are progressing faster from technology adoption to enterprise-scale transformation.
  • Strategic priorities have clear ownership, investment, milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • The transformation portfolio is demonstrably removing barriers to customer growth.
  • Customer and market insight is routinely influencing our strategic and investment choices.
  • The Office of the ANZ President is acting as an accelerator of growth rather than an additional layer of governance.


Qualifications

The successful candidate will bring:

  • Significant senior leadership experience across strategy, growth, business transformation, consulting, commercial leadership or enterprise technology.
  • A demonstrated record of translating strategy into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise customer transformation and the factors that enable organisations to adopt and scale technology successfully.
  • Commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect market opportunity with investment and execution choices.
  • Experience leading complex transformation across organisational boundaries and influencing senior leaders without relying on direct authority.
  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn complex market and business information into clear choices and action.
  • Deep executive presence and credibility with senior customers, partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to create simple, compelling strategic narratives.
  • Strong understanding of the Australian and New Zealand market and the economic, technology and industry forces shaping customer investment.
  • Strong AI and technology fluency, particularly an understanding of how AI is changing customer business models, organisational transformation and competitive advantage.

 

Leadership Attributes

The Head of Growth and Strategy will be:

  • Customer obsessed: starts with the customer problem and works backwards.
  • Commercially minded: connects strategy to growth, investment and measurable outcomes.
  • Strategic and practical: equally comfortable defining where we should play and working through what needs to happen on Monday morning.
  • Outside-in: actively tests internal assumptions against customers, competitors and the market.
  • A systems thinker: sees connections across customers, industries, technologies and organisational boundaries.
  • Execution oriented: has the persistence to drive change through to measurable outcomes.
  • Influential without authority: able to mobilise senior leaders and teams around shared priorities.
  • Constructively challenging: willing to surface uncomfortable facts and challenge established ways of working.
  • Low ego, high judgement: focused on enterprise outcomes rather than ownership or credit.
  • A catalyst for change: creates clarity, generates energy and turns ambition into action.

We are looking for a senior Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) – Azure Infrastructure, Modernisation & AI to join our Customer Success team. This IC5 role will serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic enterprise customers, helping them design, modernise and operate secure, resilient and AI-ready solutions on Microsoft Azure.
The role requires strong hands-on architecture and engineering depth across Azure infrastructure and platform services, combined with practical experience in application and database modernisation and a strong understanding of how modern Azure platforms enable AI workloads.
The successful candidate will work directly with customer architects, engineers and technology leaders to translate business and technical priorities into executable architectures and modernisation roadmaps. They will lead complex engagements from architecture and readiness assessment through migration, modernisation, production deployment and optimisation, while helping customers establish the secure, governed and scalable platform foundations required for AI.
As an IC5 CSA, this individual is expected to operate independently in complex customer environments, influence senior technical stakeholders, provide architectural leadership across multiple technology domains, and contribute technical leadership and best practices across the wider CSA community.


Responsibilities

  • Lead Azure architecture and modernisation engagements for strategic enterprise customers, providing deep technical guidance from assessment and architecture through implementation and production adoption.
  • Architect enterprise Azure platforms spanning compute, networking, storage, identity, security, governance, management, observability, business continuity and disaster recovery.
  • Drive end-to-end modernisation, helping customers evolve from traditional infrastructure and virtual-machine-based environments towards modern Azure platform services across infrastructure, applications and databases.
  • Provide strong database architecture and optimisation expertise, particularly across Azure SQL and SQL Server, including migration, performance optimisation, availability, scalability and modernisation patterns.
  • Build AI-ready cloud foundations, helping customers design landing zones, networking, security, identity, governance, infrastructure-as-code and operational capabilities that support Azure AI and Microsoft Foundry workloads in production.
  • Partner with AI and application specialists to help customers take AI solutions beyond experimentation and into secure, scalable and governed production environments.
  • Assess customer estates and develop actionable cloud migration and modernisation roadmaps, identifying technical dependencies, risks, architecture decisions and opportunities to accelerate customer outcomes.
  • Apply architecture best practices for resilience, security, reliability, performance, operational excellence and cost optimisation, helping customers continuously improve the health of their Azure environments.
  • Use Infrastructure as Code, automation, GitHub and AI-assisted engineering practices to accelerate architecture, deployment and modernisation activities.
  • Lead technical workshops, architecture/design sessions, proof-of-concepts and production-readiness engagements with customer engineering and architecture teams.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor, simplifying complex technology choices, challenging existing assumptions where appropriate, and helping customers make informed architecture decisions.
  • Work closely across Microsoft sales, Customer Success, engineering, Global Delivery, partners and specialist teams to remove technical blockers and accelerate customer solutions into production.
  • Own technical execution against committed customer outcomes and proactively identify opportunities for additional Azure adoption, modernisation and consumption.
  • Contribute technical leadership to the broader CSA community through mentoring, architecture reviews, reusable patterns, technical content and sharing of customer learnings.

 



Qualifications

Technical Experience

  • Significant experience designing, implementing and operating large-scale enterprise cloud platforms, preferably on Microsoft Azure.
  • Deep technical expertise in several core Azure infrastructure domains, including:
    • Azure compute and virtualisation
    • Azure networking and hybrid connectivity
    • Storage
    • Identity and access
    • Security and governance
    • Azure Landing Zones
    • Monitoring and observability
    • High availability, resiliency and disaster recovery
  • Strong experience with SQL Server and/or Azure database technologies, with the ability to advise customers on database architecture, migration, modernisation, performance tuning, availability and scalability.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud migration and modernisation, including transitioning traditional infrastructure and applications towards cloud-native and managed Azure services.
  • Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code, such as Bicep, ARM, Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI or equivalent technologies.
  • Good understanding of DevOps and modern engineering practices, including Git/GitHub and CI/CD.

AI & Modern Platform Capability

  • Strong understanding of the Azure platform requirements for running enterprise AI solutions in production, including networking, identity, security, governance, observability, capacity and operational readiness.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI services, generative AI and agentic AI concepts, with the ability to collaborate effectively with specialist AI architects.
  • Understanding of responsible and governed AI deployment, including security, identity, data protection, observability and lifecycle considerations.
  • Ability to rapidly learn emerging technologies and apply them to real customer architecture and engineering scenarios.

Architecture & Customer Leadership

  • Proven ability to design and communicate complex end-to-end enterprise architectures spanning multiple technical domains.
  • Strong customer-facing consulting and technical advisory experience with the ability to lead architecture discussions with senior architects, engineering leaders and technology executives.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into architecture decisions, technical roadmaps and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with experience working through complex production and architecture challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions without direct authority and collaborate across customers, partners and multidisciplinary internal teams.

IC5 Leadership Expectations

  • Operates independently across ambiguous and highly complex customer environments.
  • Provides technical leadership beyond individual engagements and helps establish architecture patterns and best practices for the broader team.
  • Mentors and develops other engineers and architects through technical coaching, architecture reviews and knowledge sharing.
  • Identifies emerging customer and technology trends and converts them into reusable approaches that can scale across multiple customers.
  • Demonstrates a strong customer-outcome mindset, combining technical depth with commercial awareness and an understanding of how architecture decisions translate into adoption and Azure consumption.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure architecture experience equivalent to Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) level.

  • Experience with regulated enterprise environments, particularly financial services, is highly desirable.

As a Microsoft Senior Data Center Technician (SDCT), you will demonstrate expertise in standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment, as well as a holistic understanding of the functions of, and interactions between, network and server equipment. You will provide input for suggested modifications to these processes and procedures as needed to improve service quality and efficiency while providing guidance to other technicians.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world. 

 

The Global Customer Success (GCS) organization, an organization within CE&S, is leading the effort to enable customer success on the Microsoft Cloud by harnessing leading, AI-powered capabilities and human expertise to deliver innovation solutions that accelerate business value, drive operational excellence and nurture long term loyalty.

 

We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) to help design and deliver secure, resilient solutions that protect customer environments, reduce risk, and enable trusted use of cloud and AI technologies. In this role, you will contribute to repeatable security focused solutions and work collaboratively across technical engagements spanning design, implementation, and operations.

You will support customer engagements by helping remove security and technical blockers and accelerating adoption of Microsoft security and cloud platforms, working across identity, data, applications, and cloud services. This includes contributing to solutions built on platforms such as Copilot, Azure, data services, application services, and developer tools, with a focus on secure by design architectures and operational readiness.

 

You will deliver engagements using established repeatable IP and execution frameworks, with accountability for secure deployment, operational quality, and successful customer outcomes. You will build certifications across priority workloads, including Azure, data and application platforms, GitHub, and related tools, and collaborate closely with customer engineers and security teams to translate security requirements and risks into practical, real world solutions.

This role is well suited to individuals who are fast learners, problem solvers, and naturally curious, with the ability to communicate clearly, listen actively, and work effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders on security focused initiatives.

 

This opportunity will allow you to rapidly accelerate your technical skills, build consultative and communication capabilities, and gain hands-on experience developing AI driven and agentic systems within customer environments - all while learning how to deliver with excellence and consistency.

 

This role is 100% Microsoft onsite or customer site only.

  • Manage, scale, and optimize job scheduling systems (LSF, Slurm, etc.) in a large-scale, multi-site environment supporting EDA and other compute-intensive workloads
  • Analyze scheduler and infrastructure performance data to identify systemic bottlenecks and drive measurable improvements in utilization, throughput, and turnaround time
  • Building and improving our ecosystem around GPU-accelerated computing
  • Define and develop automation scripts and wrappers tools for IC Design environment
  • Identify recurring operational challenges and implement targeted automation or process improvements to reduce manual effort and prevent repeat incidents
  • Root cause analysis and suggest corrective action for problems large and small scales
  • Partner directly with customer teams to clarify requirements, translate technical tradeoffs, and drive issues to closure

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience operating and supporting large-scale Linux-based compute infrastructure

  • Strong hands-on experience supporting and tuning job scheduling systems (LSF, Slurm, etc.) in HPC or silicon design environments
  • Proficiency in Linux systems administration (CentOS/RHEL)
  • Proficient in modern CI/CD techniques, GitOps and Infrastructure as Code(IaC)
  • Proficient in Python programming and bash scripting

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Deep knowledge of job scheduling systems (LSF, Slurm, etc.) configuration tuning, scheduler internals, and advanced troubleshooting techniques
  • Network licenses (e.g. FLEXlm) continuous maintenance, provisioning, automation, monitoring and troubleshooting
  • Experience implementing reliability engineering practices within HPC scheduling environments
  • Experience building or enhancing observability systems, including metrics collection, monitoring pipelines, alerting strategies, and performance dashboards
  • Background with container technologies such as Docker, Singularity, or Podman in HPC environments

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a world-class research group focused on making fundamental biological discoveries. The team combines cutting-edge AI with hands-on biological research, positioning Anthropic at the forefront of demonstrating how AI tools can accelerate scientific workflows and enable discovery.

About the role

We are hiring Research Associates: early-career bench scientists who will join a small team to help establish our biology research program. This is an entry-level role, great for individuals who have done some research during an undergrad or masters program and may be considering pursuing a PhD in Life Sciences in the future.

You'll work directly alongside senior scientists, executing and troubleshooting experiments at the bench while learning advanced techniques in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment. We value curiosity, careful hands, and the willingness to take ownership of a result. Our scientists are eager to teach; we're hiring for motivation and trajectory as much as for existing skill.

This is a fully hands-on bench role — while familiarity with computational biology and bioinformatics is welcome, the role does not involve AI/ML model development.

Key responsibilities

  • Execute molecular biology and biochemistry experiments at the bench under the direction of senior scientists
  • Maintain meticulous, reproducible records and contribute to shared protocols
  • Troubleshoot experiments, propose adjustments, and present results clearly in group meetings
  • Maintain mammalian and bacterial cell lines, materials stocks, and reagent inventories
  • Learn and adopt new techniques rapidly as projects evolve, with training provided

Minimum qualifications

  • Have hands-on research experience in molecular biology, biochemistry, or a closely related field
  • Are proficient with foundational molecular biology techniques: PCR, gel electrophoresis, molecular cloning, and plasmid preparation
  • Have experience with aseptic technique and bacterial or mammalian cell culture, and with nucleic acid extraction, purification, and quantification
  • Follow, document, and adapt experimental protocols with care and precision
  • Are highly motivated, eager to learn, and energized by hands-on bench work
  • Are practical and resourceful — you'd rather find a way through than a reason it can't be done
  • Listen carefully, take feedback well, ask good questions, and are comfortable when priorities shift quickly
  • Are excited to use AI models as a tool at the bench to plan experiments, interpret data, and decide what to try next

Preferred qualifications

  • A BS or MS in molecular biology, biochemistry, chemical biology, microbiology, bioengineering, or a related discipline
  • Protein expression and purification experience (e.g., affinity, SEC, IEX)
  • Mammalian cell culture experience, including transfection and stable line maintenance
  • Enzyme kinetics or quantitative biochemical assay development (fluorescence, absorbance, FRET)
  • Next-generation sequencing library preparation experience
  • Familiarity with common bioinformatics workflows and molecular biology software (e.g., sequence analysis, alignment, primer and construct design)
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude in a research setting — for literature review, protocol drafting, data interpretation, or experimental troubleshooting

This is a rare opportunity to help define how a frontier AI company does biology. You'll learn quickly, work closely with people who want to teach, and see your results feed directly into how the most capable AI models are evaluated and improved.

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for solving a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, perception, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way.   • 3+ years of professional industry experience working with C++ or Rust programming languages.

  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases.
  • A desire to work on critical software that has a real-world impact.
  • Must be willing to travel up to 25% for testing and demonstrations.
  • Eligible to obtain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong background with focus in Physics, Mathematics, and/or Motion Planning to inform modeling & simulation (M&S) and physical systems.
  • Developing and testing multi-agent autonomous systems and deploying in real-world environments.
  • Feature and algorithm development with an understanding of behavior trees.
  • Developing software/hardware for flight systems and safety critical functionality.
  • Experience with distributed communication networks and message standards.

We are seeking a Robotics Software Engineer to join the Maneuver Dominance team. In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate software that connects autonomous platforms with mission payloads, including stores management systems (SMS), networked devices, and hardware interfaces. You will architect APIs and data transport layers that move information reliably between vehicles, payloads, and ground systems in demanding operational environments.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of software, networking, and hardware, and are passionate about delivering mission-critical systems, this opportunity is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop Networked Software: Engineer scalable, robust software that interacts with networking devices, managed networks, and common router or switch hardware.
  • Payload & SMS Integration: Design and implement software that interfaces with stores management systems (SMS) and other payload subsystems to coordinate the release and control of munitions and mission payloads.
  • API/ICD Design: Architect and implement software APIs and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) using HTTP, REST, and gRPC to connect distributed systems across vehicles, payloads, and ground stations.
  • Data Transport Engineering: Build and optimize low-level data transport over UDP and TCP, ensuring reliable, low-latency communication in constrained operational environments.
  • Hardware-Interfacing Software: Write code that interfaces directly with hardware, bridging embedded devices, sensors, and payload electronics with higher-level autonomy software.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with hardware, systems, vehicle, and payload teams to seamlessly integrate software into physical platforms.
  • Real-World Deployment: Travel up to 25% to test, debug, and deploy systems in operational environments.
  • Iterative Development: Contribute across the entire software lifecycle, including prototyping, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Troubleshoot and Debug: Analyze and resolve issues in deployed systems, ensuring reliability and operational success.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Technical Expertise: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • C++ or Rust Proficiency: 3+ years of hands-on experience developing production-grade software in C++ and/or Rust. Strong programmers in adjacent systems languages will be considered if other qualifications are met.
  • Networking Software: Experience building software that interacts with networking devices, managed networks, and common router or switch hardware.
  • API/ICD Design: Experience designing and implementing software APIs and ICDs, including work with HTTP, REST, and gRPC.
  • Data Transport: Solid understanding of low-level data transport layers, including UDP and TCP.
  • Hardware Interfacing: Experience writing code that interfaces with hardware (embedded devices, sensors, or payload electronics).
  • Systems-Level Thinking: Ability to navigate and contribute to complex systems and established codebases.
  • Real-World Impact: Passion for building software that directly influences mission-critical outcomes.
  • Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 25% to test and deploy systems.
  • Security Clearance: Must be eligible for a US security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Stores Management Systems: Direct experience with stores management systems (SMS) or related munitions/payload release systems in aerospace or defense platforms.
  • Aerospace/Defense Background: Familiarity with aerospace integration standards, vehicle bus protocols (e.g., MIL-STD-1553, ARINC), or DO-178/DO-254 development practices.
  • Distributed Systems: Experience designing fault-tolerant distributed systems and message-passing frameworks for multi-node coordination.
  • Embedded & Real-Time Systems: Experience with embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal development on resource-constrained hardware.
  • Programming Skills: Additional experience with Python, Go, or scripting for tooling and test automation.
  • Performance Optimization: Familiarity with profiling and optimizing networked and hardware-interfacing software.

Required Qualifications

  • Sensor Integration: Proven ability to work with and integrate sensors (e.g., LiDAR, cameras, IMUs) into robotics systems.
  • Systems-Level Thinking: Ability to navigate and contribute to complex systems and established codebases.
  • Real-World Impact: Passion for building software that directly influences mission-critical outcomes.

  • Advanced Robotics: Experience with motion planning, perception, localization, and multi-agent coordination.
  • Simulation Expertise: Proficiency in designing Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) simulation environments.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Software Engineering team owns keeping our datacenters running at the scale and reliability required for frontier AI training and inference by building software systems and platforms to automatically predict, monitor, and rapidly respond to changing operational conditions and incidents. Our clusters are large, heterogeneous, and always on - the team makes them observable and keeps them running: we build the infrastructure that lets engineers and technicians expedite and automate their day to day, speeding node remediation and increasing overall GPU uptime. The team partners closely with datacenter operations, AI research, and facility infrastructure teams to deliver high-impact tools that turn raw operational data into clear insight and action, ensuring true site-wide reliability and automated operation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant data ingestion pipelines that reliably consume high-volume telemetry from compute nodes, GPUs and accelerators, schedulers, storage, network fabric, and facility systems (power, cooling, energy storage) in real time.
  • Develop frontend visualizations, interactive dashboards, and UI components that present processed data in clear, real-time views for operators, capacity planners, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Design, build, and operate multi-service production systems (UI, APIs, data pipelines, auth, and on-call) to enable reliability, uptime monitoring, predictive alerting, upgrade/change/risk management, and site-wide impact assessments.
  • Build and maintain the software stacks that make site operations scalable, auditable, and fast - including repair trackers, vendor RMA workflows, operational infrastructure, and their integrations with ticketing, inventory/rack systems, telemetry stores, and vendor portals.
  • Drive automation that reduces manual effort in cluster monitoring and improves anomaly detection accuracy.
  • Keep the tools themselves reliable: uptime, data integrity, reconciliation, access control, and safe deploys.
  • Work day to day with your users, in person, to rapidly incorporate feedback and process improvements that improve GPU uptime.
  • Deep-dive into operational problems, find efficient solutions, and apply first-principles thinking.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or a STEM discipline and 3+ years of professional software development experience; OR 5+ years of professional software development experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Programming experience in Python, Rust, C++, Java, or similar languages.
  • Experience working with Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or similar database management systems.
  • Proven ownership of correctness-sensitive systems - state machines, workflows, or operational data where inaccurate state has real-world impact.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.

 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience building or operating large-scale observability, telemetry, or real-time analytics systems.
  • Experience with time-series or analytical databases (Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse, InfluxDB) and streaming or high-volume telemetry pipelines.
  • Experience building observability dashboards and alerting with Grafana, New Relic, Splunk, or similar.
  • Frontend experience with React, Angular, or a comparable JavaScript framework, building intuitive UIs for critical operations.
  • Experience designing and shipping multi-service systems for mission-critical applications - RESTful APIs, data stores, and at least one of: UI, pipelines, or auth.
  • Experience operating services on cloud or on-prem infrastructure with Docker/Kubernetes in production and automated CI/CD deploys (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, etc.).
  • On-call discipline and a track record of owning internal platforms end-to-end with production rigor in rapidly changing environments.
  • Experience with HPC or supercomputing environments (schedulers such as Slurm, GPU/accelerator telemetry, high-speed fabrics, or parallel filesystems).
  • Experience integrating with industrial/OT data sources (SCADA platforms such as Ignition, tag historians, Modbus/OPC-UA) or power/cooling infrastructure telemetry.
  • MS in Computer Science or a related field.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission-critical deadlines.
  • Ability to work on an on-call basis on a weeklong rotational schedule.

Our team builds, tests, integrates, and scales Modeling, Simulation, & Analysis (MS&A) tools that beautifully visualize both real-world and simulated historical and/or live data. This new team will provide rigorous analytical products which will be used to guide product development and convince customers of our value advantage. These products will often be used for Business Development and Engineering purposes.

As a Warfighter Research & Systems Analyst, you will be a key team member with a background as an Operations Research and Systems Analyst (ORSA), data scientist, or wargamer, possibly with an operational military background. You will use your understanding of tactical wargaming and simulation to create scenarios, develop models, and support analysis to demonstrate the value of Anduril's systems. Modeling, Simulation, and Analysis (MS&A) will often complement demonstration events that together leave no doubt that Anduril offers real (not PowerPoint) warfighter capability.  

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Conduct joint and combined tactical (engagement-level and mission-level) analysis. Employ operations research, systems analysis, and wargaming to develop methodologies for analysis.
  • Leverage high-end models and simulations, including Anduril’s Lattice Mission Simulation and the Advanced Framework for Simulation, Integration and Modeling (AFSIM), to conduct studies.
  • Perform data analysis and utilize computer models to devise solutions for intricate challenges, applying the principles of scientific inquiry and advanced analytics.
  • Design, execute, and analyze tactical-level wargames to assess autonomous system capabilities and refine tactics .
  • Develop physics-based models and relevant operational scenarios for wargaming exercises, with an emphasis on modeling red and blue force systems and tactics .
  • Create and drive simulated entities during live play as a white cell or red cell operator to ensure realistic and challenging wargame execution.
  • Assess, decompose, and solve complex problems, conveying complex information and effectively communicating results to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with engineering and business development teams to demonstrate Anduril's capabilities and value proposition through rigorous, data-driven analysis.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently possess and be able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance 
  • 5 years of experience in Operations Research, Systems Analysis (ORSA), or a related discipline.
  • Experience with tactical experiment and wargaming design, including scenario development, data analytics, and trade-space analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience in modeling and simulation for military missions, with a preference for a background in red force tactics, modeling, and simulation.
  • Experience with DoD M&S tools (e.g., AFSIM, Brawler, Suppressor, ESAMS, Command PE).
  • Proficiency with C++ or Python for physics-based modeling and scripting.
  • Ability to assess and solve problems, and to effectively communicate results through strong verbal and written skills
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DOD Top Secret security clearance
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Operations Research, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • Operational military background with a subsequent transition into an ORSA or Operations Analyst position.
  • Experience with AFSIM plug-in development or other advanced M&S framework customization .
  • Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools such as Tableau, or scripting languages like MATLAB/SIMULINK .
  • Graduate of a military operations research course, such as the ORSA Military Application Course (ORSA-MAC), or equivalent service school.
  • Experience with Joint Combined Arms operations (e.g., OCA/DCA, ISR, SEAD/DEAD, Electronic Attack, or Long-Range Fires missions)

This role brings together the disciplines of Solution Architecture and Software Engineering to translate business strategy, customer needs, product direction, and technology trends into coherent logical and physical architectures that teams can implement and operate at scale. 

You will lead through technical depth, judgment, and influence across organizational boundaries. You will mentor software engineers, prototype solutions to the hardest software engineering problems the organization faces and review the most consequential architectural decisions. You will operate from enterprise and ecosystem context down to component topology and implementation detail, providing clarity in ambiguous situations and remaining grounded in engineering reality through design validation, prototypes, code and implementation reviews, operational data, and close collaboration with product and engineering teams. 

This is a high-impact technical leadership role for an architect who can connect strategy to execution: defining where the platform must go, documenting why, creating standards that scale, and partnering with teams to deliver the architecture incrementally without disrupting customers or business operations. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

-    Define, launch, and lead the ITP architecture guild as the cross-organization community of practice for architects and senior engineers, owning its charter, membership, cadence, working groups, and operating mechanisms so that standards, patterns, tools, and lessons learned scale across teams. 

-    Set and evolve architectural standards, principles, reference architectures, reusable patterns, approved technology choices, and guardrails that enable consistent, high-quality decisions and reduce ambiguity and rework across teams. 

-    Drive AI adoption and transformation through architecture, defining the AI-first reference architectures, patterns, and guardrails (agents, retrieval, evaluation, and Responsible AI) that teams across ITP, CSS, CSU, and MCAPS use to adopt AI safely and consistently. 

-    Align architecture processes, artifacts, taxonomies, and decision rights across business, engineering, and product groups so that a single architecture practice spans planning, funding, design, delivery, and operations. 

-    Develop, run, and continuously improve the architecture review process, including intake and triage criteria, objective quality bars, the reviewer pool, architecture decision records, escalation paths, and measures of adoption, cycle time, and outcome quality. 

-    Lead reviews of the most consequential products and programs, ensuring decisions are documented with context, options, tradeoffs, risks, and rejected alternatives, and are understood, implemented, measured, and revisited as conditions change. 

-    Aid teams in creating strong, forward-looking logical architectures spanning domains, capabilities, bounded contexts, services, data flows, integrations, APIs, identity, security boundaries, and user or system interaction patterns. 

-    Aid teams in creating strong, forward-looking physical architectures spanning deployment topology, compute, storage, networking, data platforms, service placement, geographic distribution, resiliency, observability, disaster recovery, capacity, and operational supportability. 

-    Coach teams in translating functional and nonfunctional requirements into architecture specifications and diagrams that move from enterprise and system context to detailed component, data, network, identity, and deployment views. 

-    Aid in the development of a pro-code golden path: the paved, opinionated, well-documented set of languages, frameworks, platform services, templates, scaffolding, and CI/CD pipelines that represent the supported way to build and ship software in ITP. 

-    Aid in the development of the golden loop: an instrumented inner and outer developer loop spanning local development, AI-assisted coding, code review, test, build, deploy, monitor, and feedback, so that velocity, quality, and developer experience are measurable and continuously improved. 

-    Mentor software engineers across levels, including principal and senior engineers and architects, through design coaching, code and design reviews, pairing, and career guidance, raising architectural capability across the organization 

-    Prototype solutions to the hardest software engineering problems facing the organization and validate high-risk or novel design elements through working prototypes, benchmarks, modeling, simulations, and technical spikes before teams commit to irreversible paths. 

-    Contribute production-quality reference implementations, templates, and sample code that make the golden path concrete and immediately usable by engineering teams. 

-    Identify architectural gaps, design cliffs, concentration risks, systemic dependencies, obsolete technologies, and accumulated technical debt, and prioritize investments that improve long-term agility and reduce operational and business risk. 

-    Define target-state architecture and sequenced transition roadmaps that connect the current state to the target state through practical, incremental steps while maintaining compatibility, service continuity, and customer trust. 

-    Help teams balance tradeoffs across reliability, security, privacy, safety, accessibility, performance, scalability, sustainability, maintainability, time to market, and total cost of ownership. 

-    Use telemetry, capacity and cost models, reliability data, security findings, incident learnings, customer feedback, and technology-market signals to evaluate architecture health and guide continuous evolution. 

-    Communicate complex architectures and decisions in terms appropriate for engineering, business, and executive audiences, and build trusted technical relationships with senior leaders, customers, and partners. 

-    Represent the organization in strategic architecture discussions and contribute reusable intellectual property, technical guidance, and thought leadership across Microsoft and the broader ecosystem. 

-    Embody our culture and values.

To be successful in this role: architecture grounded in engineering. This is not an ivory-tower architecture role. The successful candidate will be able to connect strategy, logical design, and physical design to implementable engineering decisions; validate high-risk assumptions with evidence; and stay engaged through implementation, deployment, operation, and architectural evolution.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
