Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Director of Proposals to lead our Business Proposals organization and turn complex deal strategies into compelling, compliant, and timely customer submissions. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Deal Strategy and Execution, you will build the team, standards of excellence, and execution discipline that help Shield AI win domestic and international business. 

You will lead proposal Sr. Managers and proposal professionals supporting the Americas, international markets, and emerging products. Working closely with account teams, Regional Deal Strategists, and functional leaders, you will translate customer mission needs, technical capabilities, and approved commercial approaches into clear, persuasive proposals that earn customer confidence. 

You will develop strong methodologies, processes and systems that raise the quality of written persuasion, allocate resources across competing opportunities, and establish repeatable practices that increase speed and consistency as proposal volume and complexity grow. 

What you'll do:

    Proposal Organization and Talent 
  • Lead, coach, and develop proposal managers and their teams, establishing clear expectations for quality, accountability, collaboration, and professional growth. 
  • Build workforce and capacity plans aligned with the opportunity pipeline, regional demand, pursuit complexity, and emerging product requirements. 
  • Assign proposal leadership and resources across concurrent pursuits, making prioritization recommendations to the Sr. Director of Deal Strategy and Execution when demand exceeds capacity. 
  • Establish a team culture grounded in candid feedback, excellent writing, sound judgment, and shared ownership of results. 
    • Proposal Strategy and Customer Persuasion 
  • Partner with account teams and Regional Deal Strategists early in pursuits to shape proposal strategy, win themes, discriminators, and supporting evidence around customer priorities and evaluation criteria. 
  • Translate complex offerings spanning autonomous platforms, software, payloads, integration, training, services, and sustainment into clear customer value narratives. 
  • Set the standard for executive summaries, technical and management narratives, graphics, and integrated proposal storytelling. Personally write, edit, and challenge critical content on priority pursuits. 
  • Ensure proposal claims are accurate, substantiated, and consistent with approved capabilities, configurations, scope, and delivery assumptions. 
    • Proposal Execution and Compliance 
  • Own the proposal lifecycle from intake and solicitation analysis through planning, development, reviews, production, and submission, including customer clarifications and revisions. 
  • Establish proposal schedules, compliance matrices, content plans, contributor assignments, and review milestones tailored to the size and complexity of each pursuit. 
  • Lead disciplined color team reviews that test compliance, persuasiveness, technical accuracy, and alignment with the approved deal strategy. Ensure findings are resolved before release. 
  • Hold teams accountable for complete, accurate, and timely submissions, with rigorous version control, production checks, and confirmation of delivery. 
  • Support both strategic pursuits and the broader portfolio of written responses, including requests for information, requests for proposals, and other customer submissions. 
    • Functional Alignment and Risk Management 
  • Coordinate contributions from Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Contracts, Delivery, Partnerships, and other subject matter experts, with clear owners and deadlines. 
  • Ensure proposed scope, pricing, terms, partner responsibilities, and delivery commitments reflect decisions approved by the appropriate functional owners. 
  • Surface missing inputs, unsupported claims, unresolved decisions, and submission risks early. Escalate with clear recommendations, required decisions, and schedule implications. 
  • Integrate proposal milestones with established Opportunity Review and Management Review processes while reducing duplicate work and unnecessary meetings. 
  • Maintain an accurate record of submitted commitments, assumptions, exclusions, and approved revisions to support contracting and delivery handoffs. 
    • Scalable Processes and Continuous Improvement 
  • Build and maintain a searchable library of approved proposal content, templates, proof points, graphics, and reusable response modules, with named owners and review cadences. 
  • Connect proposal content to approved capability definitions and deal frameworks so teams can reuse validated material with confidence. 
  • Partner with GTM systems and tools leaders to improve proposal workflows, collaboration, content retrieval, and reporting. 
  • Lead proposal retrospectives and incorporate customer feedback, evaluation results, and lessons from wins and losses into team practices and reusable content. 
  • Measure submission timeliness, compliance, response cycle time, rework, content reuse, and win rate on submitted proposals. Use results to improve execution and inform resource decisions. 

How you will work:

    The Director of Proposals owns the proposal organization, proposal strategy and execution plans, contributor coordination, written quality, compliance, and submission readiness. Regional Deal Strategists lead deal strategy and commercial construction on assigned pursuits, partnering with proposal teams to keep the submission aligned with the agreed approach. 

    Account teams retain ownership of customer relationships and the close. Functional leaders retain authority over their respective technical, financial, contractual, export, and delivery decisions. You will ensure those decisions are accurately reflected in the proposal and escalate unresolved issues through the Sr. Director of Deal Strategy and Execution. 

Required qualifications:

  • Significant progressive experience leading proposals for complex defense, aerospace, national security, or government technology opportunities, with a demonstrated record of delivering competitive, compliant submissions. 
  • Experience leading proposal managers and multidisciplinary proposal teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and resource allocation across concurrent pursuits. 
  • Demonstrated ability to develop winning proposal strategies and translate technical capabilities into clear, credible customer value. 
  • Strong command of solicitation analysis, compliance matrices, proposal planning, color team reviews, content development, and submission production. 
  • Detailed oriented with exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to improve executive narratives and technical content under demanding deadlines. 
  • Experience coordinating contributions and securing decisions across Sales, Engineering, Product, Finance, Legal, Contracts, and delivery organizations. 
  • Familiarity with government acquisition and contracting requirements, including the ability to identify proposal obligations and engage the appropriate experts. 
  • Sound judgment in handling sensitive information, managing competing priorities, and escalating risks with clear recommendations. 
  • A record of building practical processes and reusable content that improve quality and speed in a growing organization. 

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience supporting both U.S. government and international defense proposals, including partner contributions and coordination of export and contracting reviews. 
  • Experience with offerings that combine hardware, software, integration, training, field services, and sustainment. 
  • Experience supporting autonomous systems, aviation, defense software, or emerging technology pursuits. 
  • Experience establishing or scaling a centralized proposals function while preserving responsiveness to regional account teams. 
  • Familiarity with Shipley methods, APMP certification, or comparable proposal management training. 
  • Experience applying approved automation and AI tools to proposal workflows with appropriate information protection and human review. 

What success looks like:

  • Repeatable onboarding and performance standards established that challenge and uplevel the Deal Strategy & Execution org. 
  • Proposals are compelling, compliant, delivered on time, and aligned with approved deal strategy and executable commitments. 
  • Proposal managers and contributors operate with clear ownership, realistic plans, and earlier visibility into decisions and risks. 
  • Account teams receive responsive proposal support across strategic opportunities and the broader submission portfolio. 
  • Reusable content and consistent practices reduce avoidable rework and improve response speed. 
  • Proposal quality, team capability, and pursuit outcomes improve through measurable feedback and continuous learning.

Job Description:

The Senior Lead, TA & PX Systems Administration supports Shield AI's entire Talent Acquisition technology ecosystem, including the ATS, CRM, sourcing tools, and other recruiting technology, along with third-party HR technology such as Lattice, Pave, Compa, and Carta. The role is hands-on, administering and continuously optimizing Ashby as Shield AI's ATS and CRM, and partners with People Technology leadership to build the roadmap for TA and HR technology.

The role is an individual, hands-on position at the start. As Shield AI scales, it is expected to grow into a player-coach role that builds and leads a TA and PX systems team. It works with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, People Experience Operations, Total Rewards, People Analytics, Finance, Procurement, IT, Security, and other cross-functional partners to turn business requirements into durable system design, and to keep TA and PX systems well-configured, well-integrated, and well-governed.

What you'll do:

  • Partner with People Technology leadership to build and maintain the roadmap for TA and HR technology, aligned with TA and PX priorities and Shield AI's growth plans, and lead execution of roadmap initiatives.
  • Support the full TA technology ecosystem, including the ATS, CRM, sourcing tools, scheduling, assessments, background check, interview intelligence, and related recruiting technology.
  • Personally administer, configure, and continuously optimize Ashby as Shield AI's ATS and CRM, including approvals, offers, requisitions, pipelines, interview plans, scheduling logic, scorecards, custom fields, and reporting objects.
  • Administer and support third-party HR technology, including Lattice, Pave, Compa, and Carta, covering configuration, permissions, integrations, and upgrade management.
  • Support TA and HR technology vendor management, including evaluations, implementations, contract renewals, license administration, business reviews, and performance against service commitments, in partnership with People Technology leadership, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and Security.
  • Define integration architecture across the TA and PX stack, including UKG, O365 / calendar, identity and SSO, and the PX data platform, and manage change control and monitoring.
  • Translate business and process requirements from TA and PX stakeholders into clear system design decisions, trade-offs, and configuration; recommend priorities across competing requests; and document the resulting workflows, permissions, and data model.
  • Establish and maintain data governance for TA and PX systems, including field taxonomies, PII classification, role-based access, retention, naming conventions, and reporting boundaries aligned to the broader PX Analytics Estate.
  • Lead release management and UAT for TA and PX system changes, including test plans, sandbox validation, rollout, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Keep recruiting and PX data pipelines reliable enough for executive reporting, with clean source data, consistent definitions, and reporting objects that downstream analytics can trust.
  • Track the TA and PX technology market, evaluate new capabilities and vendors, and build recommendations on where to configure, integrate, consolidate, buy, or hold.
  • Ensure TA and PX systems support compliance with applicable data privacy, security, and recordkeeping requirements, including EEO, OFCCP, and GDPR, by maintaining system controls and supporting audits.
  • As the function grows, help define future roles, then hire and lead a team as a player-coach while staying hands-on in configuration and design.

Required qualifications:

  • Direct hands-on Ashby administration experience, including configuration, workflows, approvals, offers, permissions, integrations, and reporting objects.
  • 8+ years of experience administering and optimizing recruiting and HR technology, including deep ownership of at least one modern ATS and its surrounding TA technology stack.
  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education, experience, skills, and knowledge.
  • Experience contributing to a TA or HR technology roadmap and supporting vendor relationships and renewals across multiple platforms.
  • A hands-on builder who enjoys doing the configuration work, with experience mentoring others or leading cross-functional implementations and an interest in growing into a people leader.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end talent acquisition processes, from sourcing and pipeline management through interviewing, offers, and the onboarding handoff, and how technology enables each stage.
  • Fluency in the TA technology landscape, including ATS, CRM, sourcing, scheduling, assessments, interview intelligence, and analytics.
  • Experience administering PX SaaS tools such as performance, compensation, equity, engagement, or HRIS-adjacent platforms.
  • A systems-thinking mindset: you look at a requirement and see the workflow, data model, permissions, and downstream reporting implications together.
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and the judgment to translate ambiguous requests into clear configuration decisions and trade-offs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present roadmaps, trade-offs, and business cases to TA and PX leadership, Finance, and senior stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience leading an ATS migration or major recruiting technology consolidation onto Ashby or a comparable modern ATS.
  • Experience building or scaling a People or HR technology function, including hiring and developing systems administrators or analysts.
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts for people data, including PII classification, role-based access, and reporting boundaries.
  • Experience with UKG, Workday, or another enterprise HRIS as an integration partner.
  • Working knowledge of no-code automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, Tray) or scripting.
  • Prior experience supporting people technology in a regulated, government contracting, technology, aerospace, or similarly complex environment.

What success looks like:

  • A clear, prioritized roadmap for TA and HR technology is built with People Technology leadership and delivered against.
  • Ashby, sourcing tools, and supported PX platforms are configured, integrated, and permissioned to reliably support current and future TA and PX processes.
  • TA and HR technology vendors, renewals, and licenses are supported proactively, with clear recommendations on where tools deliver value.
  • System changes go through a consistent release-management and UAT process, with clear documentation and minimal disruption.
  • TA and PX data is well-governed, well-classified, and trustworthy enough to support executive reporting and audits.
  • Stakeholders receive timely, effective support, and repeat issues decline over time.

物流拠点において商品の入荷から出荷工程で発生する問題（商品違い、破損など）の原因を調査し、正常な状態で入出荷できるようにシステム処理を行います。

アマゾンの物流インフラを支え、お客様に迅速に商品をお届けするためには欠かせない重要な仕事です。

なお、本職種はパソコンを日常的に使用します。（使用ツール：アマゾンの物流管理システム、Microsoft Outlook、Word、Excelなど）

【役割・業務詳細】

入荷・出荷時に発生する問題の解決や、より安全で効率的な工程を目指し業務改善に取り組みます。

例えば、出荷時に商品の破損が見つかった場合、代替品の用意を行えるようにシステム処理を行い、期日内に商品が出荷できるよう手配します。

その他、複数名のメンバーと連携を取りながら、配送トラックの着車スケジュール管理や、梱包資材の発注管理など、配属される工程ごとに業務内容は異なりますが、お客様の注文に対して商品の不足や配送遅延を防ぎ、期日通りに商品をお届けできるように業務を行います。

※状況によっては、検品、棚入れ、ピッキング、梱包などの実作業が発生することがあります。

※業務特性上、立ち・歩きが多く発生する仕事です。

※最大で15kg程度の重量物を1人で取り扱うことがあります。

※上記以外に在庫管理や返品処理などの業務を担当いただくことがございます。業務内容の詳細は面接前に資料を送付しますので、ご確認ください。

※配属部署は会社にて決定します。部署の希望を承ることは出来ません。

【職場環境】

・アマゾンは従業員の安全を第一に考えて業務に取り組んでいます。社内には安全ルールがあり、必ず順守いただきます。

The YouTube Business Product Activation Team is responsible for bringing product to market and market to product. The team works closely with both business and product leaders to scale adoption of YouTube products across the partner and creator ecosystem.

The core capabilities of the team include: designing go-to-market strategies, identifying and prioritizing product activation opportunities across the business, ensuring launch readiness, defining and driving execution on product activation across segments, understanding needs of partners and creators to provide Product teams with market feedback and prioritization to shape product roadmaps, developing content strategy, collecting and synthesizing user feedback, and tracking performance.

The Shopping Product Activation team brings YouTube's Shopping product to market and the market to product. We answer tough questions to grow our Shopping business - For which users, creators, or partners is our Shopping product most relevant? What is the business case for the product (e.g., market value proposition, potential headroom)? What will it take to launch and land the product (e.g., GTM levers, messaging, comms)? What creators/partners do we need to prioritize and how?

Video commerce is revolutionizing the way that people decide what to buy. The YouTube Shopping team is at the forefront of this shift: connecting viewers to products they’ll love through the creators that they trust.

And, it's working: people watch over 30 billion hours of shopping-related videos on YouTube in a year. We are partnering with some of the worlds largest retailers, trusted brands, and store builders.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Agent Cloud initiative is evolving Google Cloud to manage the unique issues of non-deterministic AI agents and workloads. Our team bridges the gap between traditional Cloud networking and the new agentic ecosystem by leveraging traditional infrastructure systems like Bouncer, QuotaServer, QuotaStore to provide quota and rate limiting infrastructure under Agent Gateway, the central conduit securing and governing agent-to-agent and agent-to-tool communications.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


Join NVIDIA’s Modular Diagnostics team and lead AI-powered innovation. Our team develops key diagnostic applications and infrastructure to test every NVIDIA GPU. This ensures flawless performance before launch. As part of the Senior Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure Solutions team you will build intelligent automation. This automation speeds up critical engineering workflows and improves GPU validation speed and quality.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build and deliver agentic AI solutions—autonomous systems that reason, plan, and take actions. These automate silicon bring-up, test and validation frameworks, debugging, and engineering workflows to speed up GPU launches.
  • Build scalable AI infrastructure, services, APIs, and reusable platforms that enable teams across NVIDIA to develop and deploy AI-powered applications.
  • Integrate AI agents with engineering tools, knowledge bases, data platforms, and existing business processes to build end-to-end intelligent workflows.
  • Partner with multi-functional teams across Modular Diagnostics and adjacent organizations to identify high-impact use cases, define requirements, develop prototypes, and deploy production-ready solutions.
  • Establish evaluation, observability, security, and reliability practices for AI systems to ensure solutions perform at scale and meet enterprise standards.
  • Drive projects from concept through adoption, measure their impact against clear success criteria, and continuously improve their efficiency.

What we need to see:

  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years delivering production software, infrastructure, platform, or AI solutions.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++.
  • Track record of building applications with large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, or workflow orchestration.
  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and production software infrastructure.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and system-design skills with a history of shipping reliable systems.
  • Effective collaboration across technical and business teams, with clear communication and the ability to drive solutions from idea to production.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Background in GPU computing, CUDA, GPU architecture, or silicon bring-up processes.
  • Familiarity with engineering diagnostics, hardware development workflows, or systems software.
  • Hands-on work with MLOps, model evaluation frameworks, AI observability tools, or production AI monitoring.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or developer tools.
  • Prior work building internal developer platforms or engineering efficiency tooling.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 26, 2026.

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be, and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit of thinking in a cloud-enabled world  

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to help design, scale, and continuously improve the analytical models that power sales quota setting and incentive programs. This role sits at the intersection of Sales Incentive Design, Data Science, Statistical Modeling, AI, and Business Strategy. 

You will own and evolve quota methodologies, validate the data and assumptions behind quota-setting decisions, and partner across Finance, Plan Design, Implementation, Analytics, and business teams to translate complex financial and business objectives into scalable, explainable models. 

The role combines strong quantitative and technical depth with an understanding of sales compensation, quota methodologies, forecasting, financial modeling, or sales performance management. You should be equally comfortable analyzing complex datasets, developing models and AI-enabled solutions, and explaining recommendations to business and technical stakeholders. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we’re dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their highly qualified contributions each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world. 

What Success Looks Like?  

Success in this role means delivering quota methodologies that stakeholders can trust, understand, operationalize, and defend. You will connect financial objectives and sales strategy to rigorous quantitative models while continuously improving the underlying data, methodology, and technology. 

You will also help modernize how sales incentive and quota decisions are made by applying advanced analytics, automation, machine learning, and AI to improve accuracy, scalability, transparency, and business impact. 



Responsibilities

 

 

The Senior Data Scientist is responsible for the following:

  • Own and continuously improve sales quota models and methodologies, ensuring they are accurate, scalable, explainable, and aligned with compensation design and business objectives. 

  • Translate sales strategy, financial targets, budget assumptions, historical performance, run-rate data, and compensable metrics into executable quota methodologies. 

  • Validate quota-setting inputs and outputs, including baselines, historical data, assumptions, model logic, and results. 

  • Proactively identify data-quality issues, unsupported assumptions, model risks, and upstream dependencies that could affect quota accuracy or field outcomes. 

  • Partner across Finance, Sales Compensation/Plan Design, Implementation, Analytics, Operations, and data-owner teams to align financial objectives with quota methodology and execution. 

  • Provide quota-model expertise and analytical support to business and field stakeholders, clearly explaining model drivers, assumptions, limitations, tradeoffs, and required actions. 

  • Apply sound judgment in ambiguous situations by balancing model integrity, financial alignment, operational feasibility, and potential field impact. 

  • Maintain comprehensive methodology documentation, validation evidence, model assumptions, and operational readiness for annual quota-setting cycles and evolving compensable metrics. 

Data Science, Modeling & Statistical Analysis:

  • Develop statistical, forecasting, optimization, and machine-learning approaches to solve complex sales and business problems. 

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify performance trends, relationships, anomalies, risks, and opportunities. 

  • Apply techniques such as forecasting, hypothesis testing, experimentation, causal analysis, supervised and unsupervised learning, and optimization where appropriate. 

  • Assess model performance for both statistical validity and business impact. 

  • Identify risks involving data quality, bias, variance, methodological limitations, and model assumptions. 

  • Develop scalable analytical models and partner with engineering and data teams to operationalize solutions. 

  • Build reproducible analytical workflows using technologies such as Python, R, SQL/T-SQL, KQL, Spark, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, MLflow, or similar platforms. 

AI & LLM Solutions:

  • Partner with stakeholders to define metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI, large language model (LLM), and agentic solutions. 

  • Prototype, build, validate, and operationalize AI-enabled applications and analytical tools for internal customers. 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate models, prompting strategies, data sources, retrieval approaches, and context-engineering techniques for specific business problems. 

  • Design and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and other LLM workflows to improve the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs. 

  • Continually evaluate model performance and identify opportunities to refine AI systems. 

  • Leverage tools and platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, LangChain, GitHub Copilot, or comparable technologies. 

Business Partnership & Impact :

  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to understand complex business problems and translate them into analytical solutions. 

  • Develop analytical roadmaps that connect technical investments to measurable business outcomes. 

  • Present complex quantitative concepts, model assumptions, findings, and recommendations in clear business terms. 

  • Use storytelling, data visualization, and analytical evidence to influence decisions and drive stakeholder alignment. 

  • Help stakeholders understand both the capabilities and limitations of models and underlying data. 

  • Identify opportunities to improve business processes through data, automation, analytics, machine learning, and AI. 

Data Quality & Operational Excellence: 

  • Acquire, prepare, and validate datasets required for modeling and business analysis. 

  • Detect changes in source data, business assumptions, performance patterns, or expected outcomes that could materially affect model results. 

  • Partner with data owners to improve data integrity, completeness, and reliability. 

  • Build efficient, readable, maintainable, and extensible analytical code. 

  • Develop clear technical documentation supporting model validation, knowledge transfer, operational deployment, and ongoing governance. 

  • Promote appropriate standards for responsible AI, privacy, data quality, and analytical integrity. 

Other 

  • Embody our culture and values.  



Qualifications

 

 

 

Minimum Qualifications:  

  • Doctorate in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 1+ year(s) data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results)  

  • OR Master's Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results)  

  • OR Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results)  

  • OR equivalent experience. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Doctorate in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 3+ years data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results)  

    • OR Master's Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 6+ years data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results)  

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Operations Research, Computer Science, or related field AND 8+ years data-science experience (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results)  

    • OR equivalent experience. 

 

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, Quantitative Analytics, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Sales Analytics, or a related quantitative field. 

  • Experience developing complex statistical, forecasting, optimization, or machine-learning models. 

  • Proficient programming and analytical skills using Python, R, SQL, KQL, or comparable languages. 

  • Experience analyzing large datasets and translating quantitative findings into actionable business recommendations. 

  • Demonstrated ability to validate model inputs, assumptions, methodologies, and outputs. 

  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders across technical and business organizations. 

  • Experience with sales compensation, incentive compensation, quota setting, sales planning, territory planning, sales performance management, or revenue operations. 

  • Experience designing or managing quota allocation, quota methodology, target setting, capacity planning, or sales forecasting models. 

  • Knowledge of compensation-plan mechanics and the relationship between financial targets, performance metrics, quotas, and incentive outcomes. 

  • Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, optimization, or business planning in a large-scale sales organization. 

  • Experience building or operationalizing machine-learning or AI solutions using Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, Spark, MLflow, or similar technologies. 

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, context engineering, or agentic AI systems. 

  • Experience developing analytical solutions that operate on an enterprise scale.

Microsoft’s Audit, Risk and Compliance (ARC) organization is building data-driven capabilities to complement traditional assurance. The Common Controls Team (CCT) advances this mission through governed control testing, reliable evidence, and actionable insights, as it works toward full-population coverage of in-scope controls.

The Technical Program Manager, Data Analytics, sits at the intersection of analytics, automation, and audit context. The role connects fragmented data sources, translates control requirements into repeatable analytical tests, and uses Python and Kusto/KQL to analyze control populations, validate results and produce traceable evidence.

Beyond traditional reporting, you will build reusable automation and dependable reporting data that make testing more repeatable and reduce key-person dependence. Success means defensible evidence, clear insight into control signals and sustainable solutions, developed in partnership with audit, engineering, and program operations colleagues.

At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress—people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities
  • Analyze control populations with Kusto/KQL to identify exceptions, systemic patterns and signals that merit further investigation. 
  • Develop and test analytical hypotheses iteratively; document assumptions, methods and limitations, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. 
  • Connect disparate data sources through secure API (Application Programming Interface) and system integrations to support automated testing and reporting. 
  • Assess data quality, completeness, and fitness for testing; reconcile populations and results, and partner with data owners to resolve or escalate gaps. 
  • Build reusable Python automation that converts control requirements into reproducible tests and traceable, defensible evidence. 
  • Maintain version-controlled testing and reporting pipelines in Azure DevOps, with clear runbooks and operational support for reliable repeat execution. 
  • Translate validated results into reliable reporting datasets, dashboards and clear narratives that support monthly reporting and quarterly cybersecurity leadership insights. 
  • Collaborate with audit, business, data engineering and program operations colleagues to refine tests, interpret signals, and support control improvements. 
  • Apply Microsoft privacy, security, responsible AI (artificial intelligence), data classification and governance standards throughout analysis, integration and evidence handling. 
  • Embody our culture and values

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. Overview

Security is one of the most critical priorities for our customers in a world of growing digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world safer by empowering every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that delivers end-to-end, simplified protection. The Microsoft Security organization advances this mission by helping secure digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds across customers' heterogeneous environments, while also protecting Microsoft's internal estate. Our culture is grounded in a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and enabling teams and leaders to bring their full potential each day.

The Microsoft Security Research (MSecR) conducts security research at the intersection of offense, defense, and intelligence. AI is now everywhere: organizations and people across every industry are adopting large language models, copilots, and autonomous agents, and these systems bring a brand-new attack surface that can be manipulated, misused, and exploited in ways traditional software cannot. In Microsoft Security, we protect AI from these attacks. We are looking for a Senior Security Researcher and a Principal Security Researcher who combines a real security background with a deep, hands-on understanding of how modern AI works and how it breaks. You will help execute and conduct AI attacks through simulations, using what you find to make AI safer and to inform our security products so they protect customers better. This role is for someone who wants to shape how AI attacks are simulated and defended at scale. You will set methodology, build tooling, influence product direction, and drive innovation in attacking and defending AI systems (Security for AI). Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

As a Senior AI Security Researcher, you will: 

  • Lead the design and execution of simulations aimed at making AI safer, conducting realistic AI attacks whose findings inform our security products and help them protect customers more effectively.
  • Develop and execute hands-on attacks against AI systems, including:
    • 1) Direct prompt injection and jailbreaks that bypass system prompts, safety instructions, and alignment.
    • 2) Indirect (cross-domain) prompt injection (XPIA), where malicious instructions are hidden in untrusted content the model consumes: documents, web pages, emails, tickets, code, and RAG sources.
    • 3) Multi-turn, crescendo, and social-engineering style attacks that steer a model toward unsafe behavior over a conversation.
    • 4) Multimodal injection through images, audio, and files that carry hidden instructions.
    • 5) Guardrail, content filter, and safety-system bypass, including encoding, obfuscation, and adversarial phrasing.
    • 6) Sensitive data exfiltration and leakage, including system prompt and grounding-data disclosure and cross-tenant or cross-session leakage.
    • 7) Agentic and tool-use abuse: excessive agency, confused-deputy attacks, unsafe autonomous actions, and manipulation of tools, plugins, and connected systems. 8) Data and model attacks: training-data and RAG poisoning, model extraction, model inversion, membership inference, and adversarial examples / evasion.
  • Build scalable AI red teaming tooling and automation (custom attack harnesses and evaluation frameworks) to generate attack variations, run large evaluations, and continuously test AI systems as they change.
  • Partner with product, engineering, Responsible AI, and detection teams to translate findings into mitigations: better system prompts, input and output filters, grounding controls, agent guardrails, and detections.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of AI defenses (detections, safety classifiers, filters, and monitoring) and provide strategic recommendations to close gaps.
  • Conduct deep research into emerging AI attacker techniques and map them to frameworks such as MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Deliver executive-level briefings, technical reports, and prioritized, actionable recommendations. 
  • Act as a technical leader: shape AI simulation methodology, mentor team members, and drive long-term innovation in Security for AI.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 3+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 4+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check:

  • This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 3+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
    • OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 6+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND 8+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection.
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years of experience in security research and/or AI/ML security.
  • A security background: experience finding and exploiting real vulnerabilities (for example penetration testing, red teaming, vulnerability research, or application security), with an adversarial mindset.
  • Solid, practical understanding of how modern AI works: LLMs, prompting, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning, and agentic / tool-using systems.
  • Hands-on experience and familiarity with agentic AI systems, red teaming harnesses, and AI tooling: building or working with agents, tool-using LLMs, orchestration and evaluation frameworks, LLM APIs, and attack harnesses. -
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience attacking AI systems: prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, guardrail bypass, data exfiltration, or agent abuse, in research or professional settings.

  • Ability to translate offensive findings into practical defenses and to communicate clearly with both engineers and executives.
  • Contributions to AI security research, publications, CTFs, or open-source.

The Microsoft AI Monetization team plays a pivotal role in shaping how Microsoft generates value from AI innovations across products including Copilot, Bing, Edge, and Microsoft Advertising. Our teams operate at the intersection of engineering, product, data science, privacy, monetization, publishers, and business operations to deliver trusted, responsible, and scalable experiences.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead Online Forensics Operations, driving complex programs at the intersection of traffic quality, fraud prevention, partner operations, technical investigations, compliance, and advertising ecosystem integrity.

In this role, you will own execution across high-impact and often ambiguous operational programs. You will bring together engineering, product, traffic quality, partner management, support, and business stakeholders to investigate emerging issues, coordinate remediation, manage critical escalations, and establish mechanisms that make Online Forensics operations increasingly scalable, measurable, and effective.

This is a highly cross-functional role requiring solid technical judgment, operational discipline, executive communication, and the ability to create clarity and drive action when ownership, signals, or solutions are not immediately obvious.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.



Responsibilities
  • Online Forensics & Operational Program Leadership
    • Lead complex, cross-functional Online Forensics programs from problem identification and triage through investigation, mitigation, remediation, and operational follow-through.
    • Establish clear ownership, milestones, decision points, dependencies, and success measures across programs involving multiple engineering and business teams.
    • Drive execution in ambiguous environments where issues may span technical systems, partner operations, traffic quality, fraud, and business processes.
    • Build operating mechanisms that provide clear visibility into priorities, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Fraud Remediation & Advertiser Protection
    • Coordinate high-impact fraud investigations and remediation workflows across Online Forensics and partner teams.
    • Manage critical case workflows, including High Impact Cases and fraud investigation packages supporting strategic partners.
    • Drive timely coordination across investigation, remediation, credit, and sign-off processes.
    • Identify recurring operational patterns and work with engineering and product stakeholders to improve upstream prevention, detection, and remediation capabilities.
  • Traffic Quality, Suppression & Enforcement Operations
    • Drive operational execution for invalid traffic suppression and enforcement programs across signals such as IP, domain, user agent, and other traffic-quality indicators.
    • Coordinate approval processes for suppression and enforcement changes.
    • Partner with engineering and traffic-quality teams to ensure operational actions are appropriately tracked, reviewed, and executed.
    • Establish mechanisms for monitoring the effectiveness and operational health of enforcement programs.
  • Partner & Traffic Quality Escalations
    • Coordinate publisher and advertiser traffic-quality escalations, including initial assessment and routing to appropriate investigation teams.
    • Use traffic-quality and analytics dashboards to conduct health checks and identify signals requiring deeper investigation.
    • Support initial analysis of significant advertiser and publisher supply-quality issues.
    • Provide clear communication to stakeholders regarding investigation status, risks, decisions, and remediation.
  • Strategic Partner Operations
    • Manage operational engagement with strategic publisher partners on traffic-quality and Online Forensics matters.
    • Coordinate recurring partner communication, investigation follow-ups, and issue resolution.
    • Translate complex technical or forensic findings into clear, actionable narratives for business and partner stakeholders.
    • Build durable engagement mechanisms that improve responsiveness, accountability, and transparency across partner-facing operations.
  • Audit, Compliance & Operational Readiness
    • Coordinate Online Forensics support for audit and compliance activities, including MRC, SOX, and SOC-1 related requests.
    • Drive collection and organization of required operational evidence and summaries.
    • Ensure appropriate operational artifacts, meeting records, and production-change evidence are available to support audit activities.
    • Partner across Online Forensics, Traffic Quality, engineering, and compliance stakeholders to maintain ongoing audit readiness.
  • Experimentation & Pilot Programs
    • Lead operational execution of traffic-quality experiments and strategic pilot programs.
    • Define program objectives, execution plans, measurement approaches, and stakeholder responsibilities.
    • Coordinate results analysis and reporting to determine outcomes and inform next steps.
    • Translate pilot learnings into recommendations for scaled operational or technical improvements.
  • Technical Program Management & Risk Management
    • Translate complex technical and operational problems into structured execution plans.
    • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand technical dependencies and operational constraints.
    • Review technical designs, specifications, workflows, and system diagrams to understand risks and integration points.
    • Identify operational and technical risks early and drive mitigation plans across organizational boundaries.
    • Use data and operational metrics to identify trends, prioritize investments, and evaluate program effectiveness.
  • Automation & Operational Scale
    • Identify repetitive investigation, reporting, triage, and operational workflows that can be simplified or automated.
    • Partner with engineering teams to improve tooling and workflow efficiency.
    • Promote practical use of automation and modern productivity tools to increase investigator and operational leverage.
    • Turn recurring manual processes into scalable mechanisms wherever possible.
  • Executive Communication & Organizational Leadership
    • Provide concise, data-informed updates to leadership on operational health, major investigations, risks, dependencies, and emerging trends.
    • Translate complex technical and forensic issues into actionable narratives for technical, business, and executive audiences.
    • Drive alignment among stakeholders with different priorities and perspectives, influencing without direct authority.
    • Establish clarity in high-ambiguity situations and ensure teams converge on decisions, owners, and next actions.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 12+ years experience engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive high-ambiguity programs from problem definition through execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Solid technical aptitude with the ability to engage engineers, understand system architecture and data flows, and reason about technical and operational dependencies.
  • Solidanalytical and problem-solving skills, particularly for situations involving incomplete or conflicting signals.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive decisions across organizational boundaries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across engineering, business, partner, and executive audiences.
  • 8+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in technology organizations.
  • Experience with advertising platforms, online marketplaces, search, fraud prevention, abuse detection, traffic quality, trust and safety, cybersecurity, risk operations, or related domains.
  • Experience managing operational investigations, high-severity escalations, or incident-style programs involving multiple technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience using telemetry, dashboards, and large datasets to support investigations and operational decision-making.
  • Experience reviewing technical designs, specifications, system diagrams, or data workflows.
  • Experience driving automation or tooling improvements for operational teams.
  • Experience working with audit, compliance, or evidence-management processes.

In this position, you will thrive at the intersection of program operations, executive coordination, and team culture keeping complex processes running smoothly while bringing energy, creativity, and initiative to how our program connects, communicates, and celebrates progress. Your responsibilities will include: Championing Team Culture & Engagement: This is where you'll leave your mark. You'll keep the pulse of team morale and engagement through formal and informal methods bringing creativity, initiative, and care to how we celebrate milestones, welcome new members, and build connection across a distributed team. From owning the product that powers the execution of our communications strategy to designing thoughtful onboarding experiences and orchestrating team events that people actually look forward to you'll help make Services Technology a place where people feel valued and energized.

Establishing Programatic Operations:
You'll be responsible for the operational rhythm that keeps a large set of programs running.

You'll become the lead point of contact for our engagement with the VMO become the go-to person for resolving queries, unblocking issues, and keeping processes moving across PMO, VMO, HR legal, finance, procurement, and vendor partners.
You’ll ensure policy changes from our partners are formally and consistently communicated to the Services
Technology leadership team and the team at large.
Managing Team Logistics & Assets: You'll manage team travel, facilities, equipment, and asset tracking keeping detailed records, occupancy data, and seat counts accurate and up to date as ongoing operational responsibilities.
You'll also support space assessments and cross-site coordination as the program scales.
Executive Coordination: You'll own the orchestration of executive and cross functional meetings that drive the program forward including leadership reviews, client QBRs, value stream syncs, all-hands, and our program summits.
You'll partner with program leaders to shape agendas, prepare briefing materials, capture decisions and action items, and ensure consistent follow through.
You'll anticipate what executives need before they ask and make sure every high-stakes meeting produces clear outcomes.

Experience with tools for data acquisition and analysis (Python, LabVIEW), statistical analysis (JMP, MATLAB), and optical simulation (LightTools, FDTD, Zemax, Code V) is strongly desired

Experience in C/C++ for embedded systems and Python & ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)

PhD and 10+ years relevant industry experience
Mathematical modeling experience for nonlinear dynamical systems

The Privacy Engineering Team at OpenAI is committed to integrating privacy as a foundational element in OpenAI's mission of advancing Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Our focus is on all OpenAI products and systems handling user data, striving to uphold the highest standards of data privacy and security.

 

We build essential production services, develop novel privacy-preserving techniques, and equip cross-functional engineering and research partners with the necessary tools to ensure responsible data use. Our approach to prioritizing responsible data use is integral to OpenAI's mission of safely introducing AGI that offers widespread benefits.

 

About the Role

As a part of the Privacy Engineering Team, you will work on the frontlines of safeguarding user data while ensuring the usability and efficiency of our AI systems. You will help us understand and implement the latest research in privacy-enhancing technologies such as differential privacy, federated learning, and data memorization. Moreover, you will focus on investigating the interaction between privacy and machine learning, developing innovative techniques to improve data anonymization, and preventing model inversion and membership inference attacks.

This position is located in San Francisco. Relocation assistance is available.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Design and prototype privacy-preserving machine-learning algorithms (e.g., differential privacy, secure aggregation, federated learning) that can be deployed at OpenAI scale.

  • Collaborate across Security, Policy, Product, and Legal to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical technical safeguards and tooling.

As the Head of Enterprise Risk Management, you will help build and lead an integrated ERM program and the ERM platform that supports it. You will establish common risk language, governance, and decision processes while translating them into scalable systems, data products, and workflows.

You will own enterprise risk assessments, maintain a centralized risk register, develop risk appetite and key risk indicators, and help leaders evaluate significant changes such as new products, markets, partnerships, major systems, and strategic investments.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a hands-on leader who will build our ERM capability from the ground up, with the potential to build and lead a team over time. You will work with technical and business teams to connect source systems, improve data quality, automate evidence and control monitoring, and use AI to surface emerging risks and accelerate analysis.

You will also help create a strong risk culture, coordinate assurance across the three lines, and communicate complex issues with clarity and sound judgment. This is an opportunity to build a next-generation capability from the ground up.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and evolve OpenAI’s enterprise risk management framework, including risk taxonomy, governance standards, risk appetite, escalation thresholds, and mitigation expectations.

  • Lead enterprise risk assessments and maintain a centralized, decision-useful risk register that reflects strategic, financial, operational, technology, security, compliance, and emerging risks.

  • Establish key risk indicators, continuous-monitoring capabilities, and executive dashboards that translate complex data into clear signals, trends, and actions.

  • Enable risk-informed change governance for new products, markets, partnerships, acquisitions, major systems, and other high-impact initiatives.

  • Lead effective governance forums working cross-functionally with key partners such as Compliance, Finance, Security and others, and prepare concise reporting for senior leadership and the Board.

  • Define the strategy and roadmap for a modern ERM platform that will connect with systems across the enterprise including identity, finance, HR, ticketing, code, and others through reliable integrations and shared data models.

  • Apply automation, policy-as-code, data analytics, and AI-assisted workflows to evidence collection, control monitoring, issue management, risk analysis, and audit or regulatory responses.

  • Coordinate risk activities across Finance, Security, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Operations, and Internal Audit, clarifying ownership and reducing duplication across the three lines of defense.

  • Build, coach, and lead a high-performing team, strengthen first-line ownership, and foster a culture of practical risk management, curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

About the Team

The Connector Ecosystem team builds the platform and product experiences that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, skills, connectors, interactive apps, and open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We make plugins easy to discover, install, and use, ensure they’re invoked at the right time, and help people find new ways to get value from them.

We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work spans creation and publishing, reliable execution across our products, clear permissions and approvals, and the controls admins need to bring plugins to their organizations. We work closely with research to improve tool quality as models evolve.

About the Role

We’re looking for a product-minded Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction, build the systems behind plugins, and improve how models use them. Depending on your focus, you may scale generalist infrastructure and identity-related integrations across products, improve plugin quality at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, or work on the product experience itself to drive plugin usage. You’ll lead complex initiatives across teams and own problems from diagnosis and design through implementation and release.

You’ll remain hands-on while driving product and design decisions alongside Product, Design, Research, and engineering partners. You’ll help shape what we build and how it works, translate user and developer needs into clear priorities, and guide technical decisions that balance rapid iteration with long-term reliability and maintainability.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

  • Set technical direction and lead complex initiatives across the Plugin Ecosystem, aligning architecture and execution across teams.

  • Drive product and design decisions with cross-functional partners, helping define priorities and shape intuitive experiences for users and developers.

  • Build intuitive experiences that help users discover, install, and use plugins to get more done.

  • Make plugins easier to create, test, publish, update, and share.

  • Improve when and how models use plugins, from choosing the right plugin to completing a task. Work with Research to diagnose failures and measure improvements as models evolve.

  • Improve plugin reliability and interaction quality across ChatGPT and Codex, including interactive apps, with clear error messages and recovery paths.

  • Build consistent permissions, approvals, and admin controls that help individuals and organizations confidently adopt plugins.

  • Work with developers and partners to turn recurring problems into improvements to the platform, tooling, and documentation.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, power decisions on the battlefield, locate missing children, and more.
 

Applications for the January 2027 cohort are open now through December 11, 2026.

 
The Program
 
In the 20th century, America pioneered mass production. We built the Arsenal of Democracy and won the war. Then we left this mighty Arsenal to rust. Silicon Valley, a product of Heartland work ethic, turned its back on the American worker.

It's time to reawaken the giant.

The same spirit of practical innovation that enabled America to dominate the previous century lives on in every American factory, workshop, and garage today. Some fear the proliferation of Artificial Intelligence, but we see the opportunity for a technological and industrial renaissance.

Palantir is launching the American Tech Fellowship to arm Americans with the skills to deploy cutting-edge software in the workforce. You will have an opportunity to explore and build on Palantir's Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) and earn a professional certification in its use. Exceptional performers will earn an opportunity to interview for a role at Palantir or partner companies, where you can use your newfound skills to contribute to the revival of American industry.

This fellowship is about more than careers. It's about restoring the promise that hard work and determination can still change your life in America. It's an investment in American excellence, and evidence of our belief that America's greatest builders are still to be discovered.

The American worker, given the right tools and opportunity, remains our competitive advantage. It's time to prove it.
 
The Role
 
In this fellowship, you'll participate in a comprehensive training program with our partner, Ontologize, to level up your technical skills on Foundry and AIP. You'll learn how to deploy Palantir's advanced software to solve tough problems in enterprise settings and have the opportunity to engage directly with Palantir engineers and leadership.

The fellowship runs for 12 weeks, beginning on January 13, 2027. You are expected to attend live virtual sessions on two weeknights each week. We will also have optional sessions once a week and office hours throughout the duration of the program. Expect to spend 10 to 15 hours per week on instruction and project work throughout the fellowship.

This program provides valuable training to participants and is unpaid.

The window for submitting American Tech Fellowship applications is now through December 11, 2026.
 

What We’re Looking For

    We want builders: people who are hungry to learn whatever it takes to succeed and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves and make it happen.

    You might be that kind of person if you've taught yourself, or been the local go-to, in one or more of these areas:
  • Software, data, or automation
  • General-purpose programming languages such as Python, C/C++, C# / .NET, Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Data science applications such as SQL, MATLAB, Simulink, R, Julia, Excel + VBA
  • Process improvements like instrumenting, automating, or optimizing how things run
  • Prototyping—i.e., testing ideas iteratively instead of waiting for perfect specs

What We Value

    Show us where you've flexed that builder's mindset. That could look like:
  • Formal study in computer science, electrical/mechanical/control systems engineering, physics, applied math, data science, mechatronics, robotics, or a related field
  • Experience solving real problems in settings such as a factory floor, a warehouse or logistics hub, a hospital or clinic, a construction site, field service, energy or utility operations, the military, a small business, or a garage shop, especially if you automated, instrumented, or optimized a process
  • Startup, maker-space, or hackathon projects that blended hardware and software, such as retrofitting equipment, building a sensor network, or deploying an edge AI model
  • Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in software, data, automation, or related technical fields
    • If you've got the fire to learn and you've built something that moved the needle, you're the kind of American worker we designed this fellowship for.

    Backgrounds in skilled trades, manufacturing, and field work, as well as in clinical or business settings, are welcome.

What We Require

  • 2+ years of hands-on work experience in a technical setting or engaging in on-the-job technical processes
  • Backgrounds in computer science, data science, physics, and engineering domains are preferred, though no formal degree is required.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking an International Finance Program Manager to join our International Accounting team in Dublin at Anthropic. In this role, you will drive execution excellence across a diverse portfolio of international expansion initiatives, standing up new go-to-market and infrastructure entities. You will partner closely with the Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Payroll and Finance Systems leads, functional business owners, and cross-functional teams to ensure initiatives are well-governed, on track, and delivering measurable business value.

This role requires someone who can context-switch across multiple finance domains, establish lightweight but effective program management practices, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly. You will be instrumental in helping Anthropic scale its international footprint so that every new entity is ready to operate and meet its obligations from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Program Management: Manage a portfolio of international entity set-ups, ensuring clear prioritization, resource alignment, and delivery accountability across the Finance teams that own the deliverables

  • Governance & Process Design: Establish and maintain lightweight governance frameworks appropriate for a fast-paced, engineering-centric culture, including standardized project intake, status reporting, risk management, and decision escalation processes

  • Status Tracking & Reporting: Provide clear, consistent visibility into project health, milestones, dependencies, and risks through structured reporting to the Head of International Accounting, functional leads, and Finance leadership, and maintain the inventory of entities and the infrastructure expansion pipeline

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Lead cross-functional coordination across Finance Operations, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Payroll, Finance Systems, Legal and People Operations teams to drive alignment and remove blockers

  • Entity Set-up and Go-live Readiness: Track the finance set-up of each new entity (bank accounts, tax registrations, intercompany agreements, bank mandates, payroll, Workday and the accounting systems) and its go-live readiness, through the first payroll, first month-end close and first payroll tax or VAT filing, in support of the finance owner

  • Compliance Coordination: Partner with the Tax, Payroll and Accounting teams and local advisers to support the registrations, filings and compliance calendar of each new entity

  • Change Management: Drive user adoption for new entity processes and controls through structured change management, including training, communication plans, and post-go-live support

  • Vendor Management: Track and manage vendor delivery timelines, SOW commitments, and partner accountability across the banks and the payroll, tax and accounting providers in each country

  • AI Initiative Tracking: Coordinate AI automation initiatives within the international expansion portfolio, tracking progress on Claude-powered use cases and ensuring integration with broader Finance roadmap

Minimum Qualifications

  • Have 10+ years of experience in program management, project management, or PMO roles, with at least 3 years working in finance or accounting

  • Have hands-on experience managing complex entity set-ups, international expansion programs or multi-country roll-outs

  • Can manage multiple concurrent workstreams across different finance domains without losing sight of the details or the big picture

  • Are skilled at building trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders across Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal and People Operations teams

  • Have experience designing and implementing governance frameworks that provide accountability without excessive overhead, particularly in fast-paced, agile environments

  • Possess strong analytical skills and can synthesize complex project data into clear, executive-ready reporting

  • Are proficient with modern project management tools (Asana, Jira, or similar) and entity management tools and can quickly establish portfolio-level visibility and dashboards

  • Have excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex project information to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and can navigate ambiguity while maintaining focus on delivery and deadlines

  • Are passionate about building scalable processes that support rapid organizational growth

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in finance operations, accounting, or FP&A with understanding of month-end close, financial reporting, and compliance workflows

  • Experience with change management frameworks and methodologies

  • Experience working in high-growth technology companies

  • A professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent)

  • A project management qualification

  • Interest in or experience with AI-powered automation and its application to finance processes

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Anduril’s Technical Operations team supports deployed systems throughout their operational lifecycle.
