ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Fleet Sustainment Manager to own the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of the records and operational workflows supporting Anduril’s deployed assets. You will ensure that each deployed site is accurately represented in our internal systems, with current documentation, accountable inventory, and clearly tracked hardware and quality issues.

You will serve as a primary coordination partner for Technical Operations, helping field teams navigate internal systems, document issues, and engage the teams needed to resolve them. From identifying a discrepancy to coordinating corrective action, you will maintain ownership of follow-through and ensure records reflect the work completed in the field. 

This role requires strong attention to detail, practical problem-solving, and the ability to drive action across teams. The ideal candidate takes ownership of ambiguous problems, builds reliable processes, and understands how accurate operational data supports fleet readiness and mission success.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own deployed-site documentation. Maintain required records for each site, including asset configurations, installation documentation, maintenance history, and supporting operationalinformation. Ensure documentation is complete, current, and accessible throughout the site lifecycle.
  • Maintain accurate records across systems. Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure site status, hardware configurations, asset assignments, and service records consistently reflect actual field conditions. Identify discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the appropriate owners.
  • Ensure site inventory accuracy. Track deployed hardware, serialized assets, replacements, transfers, and returns. Reconcile system records with field activity and coordinate periodic inventory verification with Technical Operations and Logistics.
  • Support hardware and quality issue management. Work with Technical Operations to ensure hardware failures, defects, and other quality concerns are documented with the information needed for investigation and action. Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, and Logistics to establish ownership, track next steps, and facilitate resolution.
  • Drive issues through closure. Maintain visibility into open actions, dependencies, and overdue items. Escalate blockers, communicate progress, and verify that completed work is reflected in the appropriate site, asset, and issue records.
  • Resolve system and workflow obstacles. Serve as a coordination point when Technical Operations encounters problems with internal tools, data, or processes. Translate field feedback into actionable requirements and engage the appropriate teams to deliver solutions.
  • Coordinate updates throughout the asset lifecycle. Ensure installations, hardware swaps, repairs, configuration changes, and decommissions are captured accurately and consistently across relevant systems.
  • Improve processes and tools. Identify recurring documentation gaps, inventory discrepancies, and workflow inefficiencies. Develop practical standards, templates, and system improvements that reduce administrative burden and improve data reliability.
  • Provide clear fleet visibility. Maintain reporting on documentation completeness, inventory discrepancies, open hardware issues, and outstanding actions so stakeholders can prioritize work and address recurring problems.

  • 5+ years of experience in technical operations, asset management, logistics, fleet sustainment, or a related operational role.
  • Experience maintaining accurate asset, inventory, maintenance, or configuration records within enterprise systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate work across multiple teams and drive outstanding issues to resolution.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities across numerous deployed sites.
  • Ability to document technical issues clearly, establish actionable next steps, and communicate effectively with technical and operational stakeholders.
  • Experience using issue-tracking, inventory management, or enterprise resource planning tools.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting deployed hardware, distributed infrastructure, or complex technical systems.
  • Experience with serialized inventory, configuration management, hardware repair and return workflows, or quality issue tracking.
  • Demonstrated success improving operational processes, data quality, and system adoption.
  • Experience partnering directly with field service or Technical Operations teams.
  • Ability to turn recurring field issues into measurable improvements in tools, documentation, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Oracle/ERP systems, or comparable operational platforms.

This single source of truth produces any contractual deliverable format on demand (GEIA-STD-0007, Power Log-J, MIL-STD-1388, provisioning documentation)
  • Identify where AI and automation can accelerate sustainment analysis cycles, and build those capabilities into the toolchain

  • Define the target-state sustainment toolchain architecture and lead the transition from legacy point-tools to an integrated environment - making build vs. integrate vs. replace decisions for each capability
  • Drive feedback loops between field/depot operational data and sustainment planning models, ensuring estimates are continuously refined by reality rather than static assumptions
  • Represent sustainment data architecture in enterprise PLM/ERP governance and cross-functional digital infrastructure decisions

  • Demonstrated ability to structure and manage Logistics Product Data in accordance with the S-Series ILS framework (S1000D, S3000L) and GEIA-STD-0007, using standard logistics information systems (PowerLog-J, COMPASS, SLICwave, EAGLE, or equivalents)
  • Python or scripting proficiency - able to build data connectors, extend automation, and prototype integrations
  • Systems-level thinking in data models and architecture - can define how information flows between tools and organizations, not just how to use individual applications
  • Experience with Product Lifecycle Management systems (Teamcenter preferred) and understanding of how sustainment data integrates with ERP and configuration management
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
  • Ability to travel for on-site support, stakeholder engagement, and tool deployment

  • Proven ability to drive change against established legacy approaches in fast-paced environments
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Systems, Mechanical, Industrial, Aerospace) or Computer Science/Information Systems

Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Can you turn a great story into a cultural conversation?

When you watch an Indian blockbuster cross over to global audiences, do you find yourself dissecting how it got there — which story landed, which journalist broke it first, which moment made it cultural? When a campaign wraps, do you reflect on what you'd do differently? Do you read entertainment news not just as a fan but as a student of how stories travel? If so, we may have just the opportunity for you to join the Originals publicity team.

 

The Role:

 

Netflix is looking for a Publicity Manager to lead South title campaigns — Tamil, Telugu, and beyond. You will also end up working on a mix of other local and global titles. You'll own earned media strategy and execution for a slate of originals, working closely with filmmakers, talent, and a cross-functional team across content, marketing, and communications.

 

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the strategy and book the travel. You'll pitch a cover story and manage a talent handler on set. You will guide a team member and be willing to roll up your sleeves to do the work.

 

What you'll do:

  • Build and execute publicity campaigns for South originals from production through launch and beyond — announcements, junkets, press moments, and post-launch coverage
  • Work with partners to develop media strategy across broadcast, print, digital, and social — with a sharp instinct for what makes a story travel regionally and nationally
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for filmmakers, talent, and production partners throughout the campaign lifecycle
  • Pitch and secure media opportunities; cultivate journalists, critics, and influencers 
  • Integrate with marketing, social, content, awards, and festival teams to build campaigns that are greater than the sum of their parts
  • Manage agencies, vendors, and budgets; give leadership clear visibility into process and priorities
  • Stay ahead of shifts in the entertainment and cultural landscape — what audiences care about, what media is chasing, what's breaking next

What we're looking for:

  • Campaign thinker, not just executor. You have a point of view on how a campaign should be built — and you can articulate what you're trying to do and why. You think about earned media not in press releases but through narratives.
  • Deep regional expertise. You understand South Indian cinema, television, and the cultural currents that shape them. You know what makes a Tamil film travel differently from a Telugu one, and you know the media landscape intimately — who covers what, and why.
  • Exceptional media relationships. You have strong existing relationships with key journalists, editors, and influencers across key markets in the South, and a track record of securing meaningful coverage — not just volume, but the right story in the right outlet at the right moment.
  • You consume entertainment and culture voraciously — not just as a consumer but as an analyst. You notice what's breaking through and why.
  • Integrated mindset. You think across channels — earned, social, talent, experiential — and can connect the dots between a press strategy, a talent moment, and a marketing beat.
  • Strong communicator. Clear, direct, and effective with everyone from a journalist to a filmmaker to a Netflix executive. Fluent in English, Hindi, and can speak Tamil and/or Telugu. Candidates who have worked in the Tamil or Telugu entertainment industry are especially encouraged to apply. 

 

Qualifications:

  • 9-10 years of entertainment publicity experience — studio, OTT, network, agency, or journalism
  • Demonstrated experience running end-to-end campaigns for South Indian titles or talent
  • Comfort managing agencies, budgets, and cross-functional partners

NVIDIA is committed not only to delivering outstanding chip performance but also to continuously improving power efficiency across every product. Performance per watt is critical to our success.

The Power Analysis and Optimization team works closely with architecture, design, verification, and physical-design teams to define power targets for architectural changes and new features. We identify power-saving opportunities throughout the ASIC design process—from architecture definition through place and route—and resolve power issues that could affect functionality or performance.

Joining the team, you will contribute to ASIC power analysis, modeling, optimization, and flow automation. Your work will help make NVIDIA GPU and SoC products more energy-efficient and maintain their leadership in performance per watt.


What you’ll be doing

  • Develop IP-level power models to estimate the impact of architectural changes and new features.
  • Analyze power consumption across different workloads and application scenarios.
  • Collaborate with architects and design teams to define power targets and evaluate power, performance, and area tradeoffs.
  • Use internally developed flows and industry-standard tools to identify power inefficiencies and optimization opportunities.
  • Work with RTL and physical-design teams to implement and validate power optimizations.
  • Investigate power regressions and determine their architectural, RTL, workload, or physical-design root causes.
  • Develop scripts, automation flows, and AI-assisted solutions to improve the efficiency and scalability of power analysis.
  • Explore new methodologies for power modeling, analysis, attribution, and optimization.

What we need to see

  • Expected to graduate in 2027 with a MS or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of digital circuit design, computer architecture, or ASIC design methodology.
  • Understanding of power-consumption fundamentals and common low-power design techniques.
  • Programming or scripting experience in Python, C++, Tcl, or a similar language.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Ways to stand out from the crowd

  • Familiarity with ASIC power-analysis tools such as PrimeTime PX or PowerArtist.
  • Experience with power modeling, workload analysis, power attribution, or low-power design.
  • Experience analyzing power, performance, and area tradeoffs.
  • Experience developing or integrating AI agents, engineering skills, or AI-assisted automation workflows.

Microsoft Treasury supports the digital transformation journey of Microsoft’s customers, partners and vendors by providing competitive credit and payment solutions to support revenue growth while managing credit risk.

 

We are a compliance-first organization with customer obsession and deal economics focus. We support over $150B in trade and receivables and $11B in payment solutions per year in global markets. The team is also charged with managing over $130B of investment portfolio, currency risk, bank account infrastructure and business risk insurance.

 

As Safeguarding Payment Analyst, you will manage and execute the day-to-day management of daily safeguarding activities. You will also act as a key finance partner to the Head of Safeguarding, providing analysis, planning and broader financial management support while working closely with the Treasury Manager, Head of Safeguarding, Financial Manager and other key Treasury contacts.



Responsibilities

Daily Safeguarding Calculations and Reconciliations

  • Perform daily safeguarding calculations to identify client-fund liabilities using payment flows, settlement data and internal ledger records.
  • Reconcile calculated client-fund liabilities to internal ledgers, external bank statements and safeguarding account balances.
  • Verify that safeguarding account balances provide complete and adequate coverage of client funds in line with the approved methodology.
  • Complete daily activities within agreed cut-off times and retain clear evidence of preparation, review and completion.

 

Safeguarding Transfers and Account Monitoring

  • Prepare and support timely safeguarding transfers to ensure full coverage of client-fund liabilities.
  • Monitor balances and movements across safeguarding accounts, identifying unusual transactions, shortfalls or excess balances.
  • Support the coordination of settlements, funding movements and permitted intercompany transfers in line with approved authorities and segregation-of-duties requirements.

 

Break Investigation and Escalation

  • Investigate reconciliation breaks and data discrepancies promptly, documenting the cause, impact and corrective action.
  • Work with Finance, Treasury, IT, and banking partners to resolve outstanding items within agreed timelines.
  • Escalate safeguarding shortfalls, unexplained differences, missed deadlines and control failures promptly in accordance with governance procedures.
  • Track open breaks and remediation actions through to closure, providing clear status updates to relevant stakeholders.

 

Controls, Records and Reporting

  • Operate safeguarding controls accurately, including required checks, approvals and segregation of duties.
  • Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready records of calculations, reconciliations, transfers, approvals, investigations and remediation actions.
  • Prepare routine safeguarding reports and management information for the Head of Safeguarding and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Support internal and external audits, regulatory submissions and Central Bank of Ireland information requests by providing accurate records and explanations.

 

Process Support and Continuous Improvement

  • Follow documented safeguarding procedures and keep process notes, checklists and control evidence up to date.
  • Identify recurring breaks, manual inefficiencies and data-quality issues, and suggest practical improvements to processes and controls.
  • Support testing and implementation of system, data and process changes affecting safeguarding calculations or reconciliations.
  • Participate in cross-training, contingency arrangements and daily handovers to support continuity of safeguarding operations.


Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business OR equivalent experience.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to deadlines.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with senior stakeholders, auditors and cross-functional partners.

 

Preferred qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business, OR Master's Degree in Business Administration or Finance, OR equivalent experience.
  • Experience in payments, e-money, financial services, technology, cloud services or online platforms.
  • Experience operating in a regulated entity or supporting safeguarding or operational-resilience requirements.
  • Experience with treasury management systems, analytics, automation, modelling or large-scale cash and reconciliation environments.

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

 We are looking for a Sr SOC Verification Engineer to join the team to support our mission and culture. This key role will impact the organization by driving SoC verification strategy and execution for complex IP/SOC designs.

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities:

  • Become knowledgeable on the overall SoC architecture. 
  • Develop verification strategy, test plans, requirements, environments, tools, and methodologies.  
  • Apply your knowledge of SoC verification principles and techniques and your judgement to write test plans and implement them by developing tests, test generators, test benches, checkers, coverage, and other verification collateral.

  • Apply your growth mindset to learn and adapt in a complex and dynamic environment.

  • Embody our culture and values.

  • Candidate should have at least a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related degree     
  • 6+ years of verification experience working on SOC designs, with 2+ years PCIe/CXL/Data accelerator verification experience

Microsoft's Detection and Response Team (DART) is seeking a skilled and experienced Cybersecurity Lead Investigator to join the team in United Kingdom. DART is the first port of call for many customers during a security incident. This pivotal, customer-facing role calls for a technically deep and agile investigator who can lead complex, high-impact incident response across on-premises and cloud environments and turn incomplete evidence into clear, defensible response decisions.

You will lead the investigation, establish technical priorities and act as the primary technical point of contact for customers, including executive stakeholders. Working with threat hunters, reverse engineers, infrastructure engineers and incident coordinators, you will bring together investigative findings, and direct response recommendations, balancing investigation with rapid recovery and containment. Incident coordinators support staffing, scheduling and operational escalation; the Lead Investigator owns investigation direction and technical judgement within the agreed engagement scope.

As part of a globally distributed, mission-driven team, you will share research, mentor colleagues and help shape the future of Defender Experts Cybersecurity Incident Response. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Employees are expected to demonstrate a growth mindset, innovation, collaboration, respect, integrity, accountability, and inclusion.



Responsibilities

As a Lead Investigator, you will orchestrate evidence-driven investigations and technical incident response, align specialist workstreams and communicate clear findings, priorities and recommendations to customers.

  • Set investigation objectives, hypotheses, priorities and evidence requirements; lead hands-on analysis and specialist workstreams across enterprise on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Contextualise and prioritise findings, correlate disparate evidence and build cohesive incident timelines. Establish what is known, what remains uncertain and what additional collection or analysis is needed.
  • Assess adversary activity, compromise scope and potential data collection or exfiltration; validate key findings and explain the confidence and limitations of conclusions.
  • Direct technical response planning and recommendations to secure enterprise environments, balancing containment and recovery urgency with evidence preservation and customer business constraints. Coordinate execution with customer-authorised teams and relevant specialists.
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for complex investigations; brief technical teams, executives, legal, compliance, engineering and other stakeholders with clear objectives, findings and decision options.
  • Identify skill, access, telemetry and resource gaps early; work with incident coordinators and leadership to resolve dependencies, obtain specialist support and escalate delivery risks.
  • Maintain investigative documentation and clear follow-the-sun handovers covering evidence, hypotheses, decisions, risks and next actions; support final reporting and lessons learned.


Qualifications

Required / Minimum Qualifications

•    A relevant degree in Computer Science, Computer Security, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in cybersecurity, incident management or related operations, and industry experience.
•    Demonstrated hands-on experience leading large-scale, high-pressure cybersecurity incident response across on-premises and cloud environments, including setting investigation direction and guiding evidence-driven customer decisions.
•    Ability to correlate and assess evidence from multiple sources, reconstruct incident timelines, evaluate compromise scope and possible exfiltration, and clearly explain findings and uncertainty.
•    Experience directing response activities while balancing rapid recovery, technical dependencies and business impact.
•    Demonstrated ability to lead technical specialists and stakeholders, identify engagement gaps, request appropriate resources and manage investigations using a global follow-the-sun model.
•    Customer-facing written and verbal communication, including executive briefings.
•    Flexibility to work non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays.

 

Preferred Qualifications

•    Experience analysing nation-state or cybercrime activity and applying adversary knowledge to complex enterprise investigations.
•    Demonstrated research, analytical automation, data-quality improvement and technical mentoring that strengthen investigation capability.
•    Experience developing reviewed technical publications, presentations or other knowledge-sharing material while protecting sensitive information.

 

Security Clearance Requirements

The successful candidate should have or be able to obtain the Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV) clearance as issued by the United Kingdom Security Vetting Unit (UKSV). Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role.

We have an opportunity for a forward-thinking and unusually hardworking Wireless System Engineer. As a member of our multi-faceted group, you will have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers every single day.

Description

In this technical role, you will be part of a dynamic group and have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers. You will be responsible for System integration and characterization of state-of-the-art wireless SoC products, as well as bringup & integration of the PHY/Radio and executing the PHY and radio level characterization on internal silicon solution from chip back until shipping in your favorite Apple products. You will engage with the first silicon arrives to bringup, integrate, tune and debug the PHY and radio system operation and performance. You will use your understanding of communication theory and radio calibration algorithms to optimize performance and debug issues on the silicon. Your experience using and understanding the test equipment to identify and zero in on issues and your software skills to configure and probe the chip. As an owner of the silicon performance, you will be key in making sure Apple products exceed expectations.

Responsibilities

Bring up, integrate, and tune PHY and radio systems on first-silicon wireless SoCs.
Characterize and validate PHY/RF performance across operating modes and conditions.
Debug and root-cause system-level issues spanning PHY algorithms, RF circuits, firmware, and test setup.
Work closely with cross-functional teams—including PHY algorithm, RF design, digital, MAC, and firmware—to ensure seamless system integration and performance optimization.
Develop and automate test and characterization workflows to accelerate silicon evaluation and regression.
Analyze results to identify performance bottlenecks, drive improvements in calibration algorithms (e.g., IQ imbalance, LO leakage, TSSI, Power Control), and ensure robust performance across process and temperature corners.
Document findings, communicate results, and drive silicon maturity through iterative bring-up cycles until mass production readiness.

Minimum Qualifications

BS and a minimum of 3 years relevant industry experience
Experience in wireless system design, integration, or bring-up.

Preferred Qualifications

MSEE or PHD with relevant experience

Meta is looking for an experienced ASIC Package Engineer to join its ASIC Packaging team. This role owns the technology development and qualification readiness of the package-to-board attach process for Meta's custom AI/ML and networking silicon — the critical interface where a larger than reticle sized, large-body advanced package meets the motherboard Meta designs. The engineer will lead the development and optimization of package interaction with board attach processes. The Meta Infrastructure team designs, builds, brings up, tests, and integrates custom and general-purpose silicon-based hardware systems that power Meta's platforms, deployed in data centers worldwide. Designs are published through the Open Compute Project Foundation. We are building a deep competency in packaging technology to support the rapid development of custom silicon and to develop scalable packaging solutions that are optimal for our next-generation AI/ML products and system-level performance. As die sizes grow past 3.3x reticle and packages move to lidless/lidded and asymmetric stackups, board technology development for next gen ASIC is very important to achieve desired yield due to challenges with package warpage, thermo-mechanical stresses, and solder-joint reliability. The person in this role serves as the primary packaging expert for package to board technology development, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Product Quality Engineering (PQE), Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE), and module design teams to turn it into a fully qualified, statistically controlled, high-yield manufacturing process.

Responsibilities

  • Own package-to-board interaction technology development for Meta's large-body advanced packages — how the package, substrate, and PCB behave together through assembly and in the field
  • Characterize and mitigate package warpage and coplanarity across the reflow window for large-body and lidless packages
  • Drive board-level reliability (BLR) strategy for ASIC packages in partnership with quality teams — thermal cycling, drop/shock, bend, and vibration
  • Define and execute mechanical and electrical test vehicle (MTV/ETV) strategies to de-risk package-board interaction ahead of A0 silicon availability, including solder-joint evaluation by X-ray, cross-section, and dye-and-pry at the ODM
  • Represent package-board interaction and board-assembly constraints in silicon/package/PCB/system co-design and product design reviews
  • Collaborate with package design and module design teams to ensure design for manufacturability (DFM) considerations are incorporated into package and board development
  • Develop and implement package-board interaction process specifications, design rules, and manufacturing guidelines for new package technologies
  • Evaluate and qualify new package-board interaction equipment, materials, and processes to support technology roadmap requirements
  • Partner with PQE, SQE, and ARD teams to establish quality standards, qualification criteria, and reliability requirements for package-board interaction processes
  • Establish statistical process control (SPC) methodologies and yield improvement initiatives for package-board interaction assembly operations
  • Own package-board interaction content in FMEAs, control plans, and key-characteristic definitions; support ODM line qualification and control-run gates with PQE
  • Create, conduct, and analyze Designs of Experiments (DOE) for package-board interaction development and sustaining activities
  • Drive supplier engagement and qualification for package-board interaction-related materials and equipment

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Master's degree in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years of experience in semiconductor packaging with direct ownership of package-to-board assembly and reliability; package-board interaction process engineering or electronics manufacturing background
  • Experience with package board technology processes including solder paste printing, pick-and-place, reflow soldering, and inspection methods
  • Experience working with package assembly and ODM suppliers and driving process qualification and yield improvement programs
  • Experience with failure analysis techniques for solder joint reliability and package-board interaction-related defects
  • Experience collaborating with quality engineering teams (PQE/SQE) to establish process controls and qualification requirements
  • Experience with statistical process control, process capability analysis, and Design of Experiments
  • Willingness to travel internationally, typically once per quarter

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with reflow temperature profiling, solder alloy and paste material selection, and low-temperature solder processes
  • Experience with AI/HPC or networking hardware at data-center scale
  • Experience with high-temperature warpage characterization and thermo-mechanical or finite element modeling (FEM) of packages and solder joints
  • Hands-on experience with SPI, AOI, and X-ray inspection systems and associated data analysis
  • Experience with large-body FCBGA, flip-chip, and 2.5D/3D advanced packages and their interaction with board-assembly constraints
  • Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Knowledge of packaging and assembly industry standards
  • Experience with ODM, CM/EMS, OSAT, and substrate supplier engagement and audit

Our mission is to power small business prosperity and build solutions that serve the millions of small businesses across Meta. This leader will help small businesses turn Meta's products into practical business outcomes. They will translate customer needs into actionable recommendations for product teams, build repeatable enablement that helps businesses adopt and use our tools, and prioritize external partnerships that extend reach and accelerate adoption. The role connects four activities: understand the business, influence the product, enable successful use, and scale what works through partners. It is a hands-on, cross-functional leadership role to help further our small business strategy. Success means helping more small businesses use Meta's products and superintelligence to start, run, and grow their businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Translate small business needs into product priorities. Partner with Research, Data Science, Product, Marketing, Sales, and customer-facing teams to identify important jobs to be done and barriers to adoption. Synthesize existing evidence and targeted customer engagement into clear problem statements, recommendations, and pilot opportunities.
  • Partner with product teams from discovery through adoption. Bring the small business perspective to roadmap and launch discussions; help prioritize customer problems, define practical use cases, test solutions, and track how feedback changes decisions.
  • Build scaled, practical enablement. Develop reusable onboarding, guided workflows, demonstrations, playbooks, and train-the-trainer programs with relevant teams. Design for businesses with limited time, staff, and technical expertise, including those without a sales relationship. Reuse existing channels and programs before creating new ones.
  • Prioritize external partnership opportunities. Evaluate potential partners on customer relevance, incremental reach, adoption potential, implementation readiness, economics, and execution risk. Recommend a focused portfolio of opportunities, clear go/no-go decisions, and measurable pilot plans; partner with the designated relationship and deal owners on execution.
  • Connect enablement and partnerships to measurable outcomes. Define shared metrics and evaluation plans with Product and Data Science, including successful activation, repeat use, customer task completion, time saved, and cost-efficient distribution. Use evidence to scale, improve, or stop initiatives.
  • Lead cross-functional workstreams. Establish clear owners, milestones, dependencies, and decision forums across partner teams. Independently resolve ambiguity and alignment challenges; escalate material tradeoffs with a recommendation.
  • Inform strategy and executive decisions. Maintain a focused view of customer needs, competitive offerings, and ecosystem gaps. Provide concise recommendations to the team leader and senior leadership on where Meta should invest, partner, or simplify.
  • Build verified proof points. Work with measurement and communications partners to develop credible examples of small business impact, with appropriate validation and permission before external use.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in product strategy, business strategy, product marketing, customer education, go-to-market, or partnerships, with demonstrated ownership of complex initiatives and measurable customer outcomes
  • Experience translating customer needs into product or go-to-market decisions and improving adoption of technology products
  • Experience designing and scaling enablement, learning experiences, or customer programs beyond bespoke, one-to-one delivery
  • Proven ability to drive alignment and execution across a matrixed organization through influence rather than direct authority
  • Experience building new initiatives in ambiguous environments, including defining priorities, success measures, and operating models
  • Strong analytical judgment, prioritization, and executive communication skills
  • ability to move between strategic decisions and hands-on execution

Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in product strategy, business strategy, product marketing, customer education, go-to-market, or partnerships, with demonstrated ownership of complex initiatives and measurable customer outcomes
  • Experience translating customer needs into product or go-to-market decisions and improving adoption of technology products
  • Experience designing and scaling enablement, learning experiences, or customer programs beyond bespoke, one-to-one delivery
  • Proven ability to drive alignment and execution across a matrixed organization through influence rather than direct authority
  • Experience building new initiatives in ambiguous environments, including defining priorities, success measures, and operating models
  • Strong analytical judgment, prioritization, and executive communication skills ability to move between strategic decisions and hands-on execution
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Meta shows up at key moments in tech, culture, and entertainment through owned moments and GTM product launches, and this role owns how creative technology ideas translate into tangible, interactive activations across Meta's full portfolio. You will lead the Creative Technology Pod, driving the strategy, vision, and goals to build novel product experiences (0→1) and engineer the ones that make sense to deploy globally (1→Many) into reusable, cost-effective assets built in-house. As a hybrid creative-technical lead, you generate original concepts informed by technical depth. The mandate is to bring Meta's technology out of the digital world and into tangible, everyday experiences, meeting people where they are through personal, relatable connection, and creating reliable, technology-forward moments across Meta's tentpole events and brand activations. You will partner with the cross-functional working team to strategically prioritize new products and features along with key messaging, and align with key XFN leads on the overall narrative that guides the work. Above all, you make the idea buildable.

Responsibilities

  • Set the strategy for Creative Technology. Decide where we place our bets, which ideas are worth building, and what we are deliberately not doing each half
  • Narrow the focus on products. Decide which Meta products and features to build for, in partnership with Product leadership on priorities and roadmap
  • Own the prioritized slate of Creative Technology explorations, with intake running through you
  • Generate original ideas for what we could build that nobody has asked for yet. Bring the technically possible into the creative conversation early enough to change the idea
  • Co-create from the blank page, not after the idea is locked. Bring concepts of your own, shape the ones on the table, and protect the creative intent all the way through build, working directly with Product and Engineering
  • Build and prototype hands-on. Validate what is technically feasible early, and de-risk delivery before we commit to a show or launch date
  • Take experiences that work and make them scale. Document them well enough that another team can stage them, and keep them current as the products underneath them ship
  • Choose the external partners. Scout, evaluate, and select the studios, independent creative technologists, artists, and emerging-tech companies we build with
  • Set the craft and technical bar across builds, including privacy and security, and hold external partner builds to it
  • Direct the pod. Set priorities for Creative Technologists while managing shared services across production, fabrication, agency, measurement, and legal
  • Own the build budget and drive performance tracking through the pod scorecard: cost per activation, reuse rate, and downstream ROI
  • Serve as the primary XFN interface across Global Brand Experiences, Product, Product Marketing, Comms, Marketing Insights, Data Science, Legal, and Privacy
  • Hold a point of view on what is coming. Track emerging technology and the creative community around it, and tell us what we should be trying next year, not only this cycle

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years in creative technology, experiential production, or interactive design and development, including work delivered in live or public-facing environments
  • Portfolio showing creative craft and technical depth in equal measure, with clear evidence of what you personally built, which ideas were yours, and concepts that existed because you knew the technology was there
  • Hands-on experience with interactive and immersive technologies such as real-time engines (Unity/Unreal), AR/VR/MR and spatial computing, computer vision, generative AI models and APIs, creative coding, WebGL/three.js, and sensors and physical computing
  • Experience building demos or interactive experiences tied to a product launch, including work on unreleased or pre-announcement hardware or software
  • Demonstrated judgment about where to spend creative and technical effort: choosing a small number of the right bets
  • Experience owning a build budget and a portfolio of concurrent projects, including vendor evaluation, tooling decisions, and governance of a creative technology stack
  • Experience sourcing, selecting, and directing external creative partners (studios, independent creative technologists, artists, emerging-tech companies), including commercial and scoping conversations, and setting and holding the creative and technical bar on what they deliver
  • Experience collaborating with creators or artists on work that reached a public audience
  • Experience driving priorities and outcomes across teams you do not directly manage, and experience participating effectively in both creative reviews and technical design reviews
  • Experience building a multi-year roadmap or POV on emerging technology for a brand or product org, plus an existing network in the creative technology, new media art, or experiential community

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Experience inside an in-house brand, product marketing, or R&D group at a large technology company, or creative technology leadership at a leading agency
  • Smart glasses and AI experience
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Imaging team builds and fields state-of-the-art camera and sensor systems deployed to solve real security challenges for the United States and its allies. We work across the full stack, from bare-metal hardware and firmware to networked services and cloud integrations, and we own our systems all the way through to the field. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Mission Software Engineer to join the Imaging Interfaces team. This is not a pure product development role. You will spend meaningful time keeping fielded systems alive, triaging issues across the full stack, and serving as a technical representative for our products in integrations with external teams and customers.

The work is varied and sometimes ambiguous. You might spend a morning extending a gRPC service, an afternoon diagnosing a time sync issue on a deployed device over the phone with a field operator, and a week traveling to support a customer integration. You'll need to be comfortable with that range--and ideally energized by it.

If you want to own your software end-to-end in a fast-moving environment where the stakes are real, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

Own fielded system success. You are responsible for the health and uptime of deployed imaging systems. When issues arise--whether the root cause is in your code, the firmware, the network, or the hardware--you triage, diagnose, and drive resolution.

Build and maintain production services. You'll develop and extend modular software services that run on edge-compute devices in austere environments. These services need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable by engineers who didn't write them.

Support field operations. You'll work directly with field operators and non-technical users to diagnose and resolve issues on deployed hardware. Clear communication under pressure is part of the job.

Represent the team externally. You'll serve as a subject matter expert in integrations with other products and teams; sometimes remotely, sometimes on-site. You don't need to know everything, but you need to be able to speak credibly across the full system stack and know what you don't know.

Maintain end-to-end system understanding. Our devices sit at the intersection of hardware, firmware, networking, and software. You'll develop broad fluency across that stack over time, and apply it to optimize how our services interact and degrade gracefully when components fail.

Collaborate across teams. You'll plan, build, and test complex functionality alongside firmware, hardware, and platform engineers. You'll need to be effective working across team and organizational boundaries.

Travel expected approximately 25% of the time for field testing and customer integrations.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3+ years of software development with meaningful production ownership: not just shipping features, but owning systems after they ship (their health, uptime, and behavior once they are in users' hands).
  • Deep proficiency in at least one of C++, TypeScript(node.js/React), or Python, and the ability to work effectively across the stack boundary in a second language (reading, debugging, and modifying code outside your primary). Our work spans a large TypeScript/React operator-facing UI and a growing body of C++ services running on edge hardware, and C++ depth is increasingly central as we expand across our imaging product lines.
  • Comfort ramping quickly into unfamiliar languages, tools, and deployment systems. Our language and tooling mix varies by product and shifts over time; we value engineers who get productive in a new stack rather than staying in one lane.
  • 3+ years working in Linux-based environments, including hands-on work with bare-metal hardware.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve issues across system boundaries (networking, services, hardware interaction) without always having full visibility into every component.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems clearly to non-technical audiences, including operators in the field.
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance.

Preferred

  • Strength with performance-sensitive, real-time, or resource-constrained systems (edge or embedded).
  • Experience with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks.
  • Familiarity with systemd service management and observability practices on Linux.
  • Familiarity with Nix or NixOS: uncommon, but genuinely valuable, and something you will use daily on our stack.
  • Experience supporting fielded or deployed systems, not just development environments.
  • Experience with imaging, EO/IR, ISR, or command-and-control (C2) systems.

What Makes Someone Successful Here

The engineers who thrive in this role share a few traits that don't always show up on a resume:

They close loops. When they pick up a problem they own it until it's resolved, not until it's someone else's problem.

They communicate proactively. They don't wait to be asked for a status update. They document what they find, share what they learn, and keep the people who need to know informed.

They're comfortable with ambiguity at the stack boundary. When a device behaves unexpectedly in the field, the root cause could be anywhere. They have a methodology for narrowing it down systematically rather than guessing or waiting for someone else to have the answer.

They represent the team well externally. In customer integrations and partner engagements, they're the face of what we've built. They take that seriously.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world.   • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Anduril’s Space Manufacturing team is seeking a Lead Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Quality Inspector to join our rapidly growing team in Morrisville, North Carolina.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Inspecting: Visually, manually, and digitally examining products and raw materials to ensure they meet Anduril standards as described by engineering, both internal and external, as well as quality management system (QMS) requirements.
  • Measuring: Using calipers, gauges, micrometers, and/or metrology to measure product dimensions to verify they match the design.

  • Comparing: Comparing products to a model to ensure they meet high standards
  • Recording: Reporting inspection and test data, such as weights, temperatures, and quantities inspected
  • Adjusting: Recommending adjustments to the assembly or production process
  • Rejecting: Removing/Red tagging products and materials that don't meet specifications until the issue is resolved.
  • Communicating: Communicating product quality standards to Technicians, leads, and managers.

  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance
  • High School graduate or equivalent

  • 1-3 years of Composite Fabrication or aerospace equivalent experience
  • Experience collaborating cross functionally
  • Polished communication and presentation skills
  • A bias towards action, Quality, and Detail.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Camera Systems Engineer, you will be play a key role in the development of new infrared camera systems. A Camera Systems Engineer works with optical, mechanical and electrical engineers to bring together a single camera design. This role requires creative problem-solving to meet the customer specifications while balancing the complexity of the design. A camera systems engineer is responsible for understanding the various engineering aspects of the design and how they interact across domains (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical).

This role is heavily focused on prototype camera testing. The camera systems engineer will be responsible for modeling camera performance metrics (Responsivity, Operability, etc.) and then implementing the testing to verify. This typically involves writing engineering code (MATLAB, Python, etc.) to command/control the prototype cameras, infrared blackbody sources while sampling power supplies, temperature sensors and multimeters. The Camera Systems Engineer typically leads the image performance evaluation and testing. Often, the Camera Systems Engineer will be the one to uncover issues and therefore needs excellent communication skills to collaborating across teams to quickly and effectively resolve issues.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Works directly with all the engineering disciplines to drive the design to be compliant with the specifications.
  • Develop and maintain software for radiometric modeling, testing automation, data analytics, and report generation.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on prototype failures, develop troubleshooting guides, and collaborate with engineering teams on corrective actions and failure analysis.
  • Generate clear test work instructions for technicians and provide training on equipment usage.
  • Analyze test data, document findings, and generate detailed reports to identify defects, provide feedback for product enhancements, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute feedback to early-stage test design for new product introduction (NPI) processes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in a related technical field 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with numerical modeling, preferably with radiometry and/or optics.
  • Experience with data acquisition and processing with tools like MATLAB, Python, or other programming languages.
  • Familiarity with test automation and report generation concepts.
  • Foundational understanding of root cause analysis principles for hardware, software, and firmware, with a desire to develop these skills further.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience with camera assemblies and involving the integration of electrical, opto-mechanical, and software/firmware systems.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Masters in Physics, Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Knowledge of infrared systems, including their performance requirements and verification methodologies.
  • Experience with cryogenic testing equipment.
  • Familiarity with test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, thermal chambers, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.
  • Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc.

About the Team

The Human Data team turns human feedback into reliable signals for training and evaluation. We design and run end-to-end programs that capture the depth of human intent behind everyday and high-stakes uses of our models. Our remit spans bespoke data campaigns, scalable synthetic data generation, and product-embedded signals. We partner closely across all research teams to translate these signals into training datasets, novel evaluations, and feedback loops that push the frontier of our models and advance their applications.

About the Role

As a Data Program Manager in the Human Data team you will partner with our research teams, operations and engineering to execute complex programs for collecting high-quality data. You will be a key interface between our external vendors and AI trainers, ensuring human data campaigns are successfully completed. Your work will play a key role in enabling OpenAI to train safe models that will land in the real world

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ.

In this role, you will:

  • Work in a high velocity environment, where the outcome of your work will have a direct impact on the models that OpenAI deploy in the real world

  • Work closely with external vendors, trainers and internal researchers to collect, review, and deliver high-quality data

  • Gather requirements, write instructions, define success criteria, and calibrate the AI trainers

  • Use internal tooling to assess labeled data and provide feedback to AI trainers

  • Think critically and share recommendations on tooling and process improvements, optimizing for quality, throughput, and AI trainer experience

You’ll thrive in this role if:

  • You thrive in dynamic environments. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing shifting priorities, and adapting to fast-paced changes without missing a beat.

  • You’re curious about AI, LLMs, Agents. While not required, an interest or background in these areas will help you connect the dots in our broader mission.

  • You have a can-do attitude. You don’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves and tackling the "grunt work" with the same enthusiasm as high-visibility tasks.

  • You’re an excellent communicator. You love bringing people together, fostering collaboration, and providing clarity in complex situations. Your empathetic approach helps you understand different perspectives and build strong, trusting relationships.

  • You are resilient and flexible. Setbacks don’t rattle you. You bounce back quickly, adjust strategies as needed, and maintain a positive, solution-oriented mindset.

  • You’re super organized amidst chaos. Even when things are moving quickly, you keep track of details, manage competing demands, and bring structure to complexity.

  • You enjoy operational work. While you might have an interest in broader topics like safety, you find satisfaction in executing operational tasks efficiently and effectively.

  • You have a knack for data. You've gone beyond basic data annotation and have hands-on experience with data analytics, using insights to inform decisions and improve processes.

  • You’re energized by start-up environments. If you enjoy the hustle, resourcefulness, and rapid iteration typical of start-ups, you’ll feel right at home.

  • You have some relevant experience. Ideally, you have at least 1-2 years of relevant experience and are eager to grow within a role that challenges and develops your skills.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

What We're About
 
At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.

If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.
 
What We Do
 
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll tackle will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user empathy to ultimately empower our customers to make better decisions.

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

  • Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest pain points.
  • Identify relevant datasets through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline.
  • Work with the customer to build bespoke workflows for new user groups.
  • Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs, and to ensure it is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations.
  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives.
  • Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings.
  • Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers.
  • Scope out potential engagements in new industries and in increasingly expanding locations around the world.

What We Value

  • We value team members who aren’t satisfied with surface-level answers. We value the desire to dive into the details of the data because that’s the core of our work. And we value low ego because the outcome matters more than who gets the credit.
  • Extraordinary ability to take on open-ended problems in unstructured environments.
  • Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow.
  • Ability to travel 25 – 75% required. Varies by location and team.
  • Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) is a plus.

What We Require

  • Active Top Secret Clearance with eligibility and willingness to obtain SCI

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. Our Data Platform team provides centralized data platforms and tools for various business functions at Netflix, enabling them to utilize data to make critical, data-driven decisions. As the Data Platform charter grows, we are expanding our presence to Poland to further increase our impact. We are seeking Distributed Systems Engineers to help evolve and innovate our Product and Infrastructure. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that brings new perspectives as we address the next set of challenges.


Team Spotlights


Analytics Platform and Experience Team

This team owns the architecture and foundational systems of Netflix's Analytics Platform, a growing domain with an expanding charter as the platform scales to support critical initiatives like Live and Ads. The team currently owns automated Spark migration tooling and TableDiff, our in-house data validation tool used both as a critical enabler for migrations and as a widely adopted utility across the org. As the charter grows, the team will take on additional high-impact platform initiatives. This offers an excellent opportunity to shape foundational data infrastructure and deliver direct, high-leverage impact across Netflix


Data Movement Team

The Data Movement Connector EcoSystem at Netflix is a growing domain with an expanding charter to own high-leverage business-critical connectors across Netflix. The team currently offers Frameworks, Libraries, and Control Planes and supports a large set of streaming/incremental and batch/snapshot-based connectors. This offering evolves the next step is full ownership of the Mantis ecosystem. We believe having the Poland team build and own a set of connectors to move and integrate data across different business domains would be the fastest way to unlock business values. This offers an excellent opportunity to learn the technology stack and deliver direct, relevant impact across the organization.


Online Data Stores Team

This team takes end-to-end ownership of key parts of Netflix’s Online Data Stores (ODS) platform, the databases and data abstractions behind Netflix’s online services. Ownership covers everything from design and development to day-to-day operations and on-call. The team’s charter spans three core areas:

1. Relational databases (PostgreSQL on AWS Aurora)

Ownership of Netflix’s managed relational database platform, used by product teams across Netflix such as Games, Ads and Commerce. The goal is to turn it from “a database you get” into a true platform abstraction: one-click provisioning and lifecycle management, proactive capacity management and auto-scaling, a smarter data plane (connection pooling, read/write routing, query guardrails), fleet-wide observability with GenAI-assisted diagnosis, and safe, paved-path access to data for both developers and AI agents.

2. Document databases

Ownership of Netflix’s document data store domain. This includes running and supporting today’s document storage solution and its customers, and defining and building the next Netflix paved path for document databases, from engine evaluation and build-vs-buy decisions to production rollout and customer migrations.

3. Core data platform infrastructure

Ownership of critical foundational services such as ZooKeeper, ensuring their reliability, scalability and continued evolution, along with the self-service capabilities that let Netflix engineers provision, operate and reason about their datastores independently.

The mission is to boost Netflix engineers’ productivity and innovation through a robust, efficient and secure data platform, while working closely with partner teams across Data Platform in the US and Poland.

Experimentation Platform Team

This team owns the data infrastructure that makes A/B testing work at Netflix. Specifically, they build and maintain the systems that store and govern the record of who was in which experiment, across hundreds of concurrent tests running across streaming, ads, growth, and device platforms. They also own the semantic layer that ties every experiment metric at Netflix back to that allocation data, and the pipelines that keep the whole thing fresh and reliable. As the team matures, the scope grows to include self-service tooling for the teams running experiments and support for AI-driven monitoring and analysis workflows.
