Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. You will support technician performance, prioritizing technician tasks while monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).  This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, provide training to technicians, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays. 

Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties. 



Responsibilities

Datacenter Operations

Encourages the sharing of expertise in and provides guidance on standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and decommissioning IT datacenter technology(ies) and equipment. Encourages the sharing of expertise and provides guidance on the functions of, and interactions between cabling infrastructure, network, server, and storage equipment. Develops awareness of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation components: Incident Management and Change Management.
 
Provides guidance on, and holds a team of technicians accountable for compliance with Data Center business unit policies, procedures, and deadlines. Proactively reviews and provides feedback regarding Data Center business unit policies, procedures, and deadlines. Resolves issues related to compliance or operational assurance activities directly, or with assistance from compliance colleagues and/or business partners. Provides input on improvement plan components for service delivery gaps or challenges.
 
Ensures a team of technicians can complete assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type. Supports escalation of challenging or complex tickets to internal business partners and appropriately summarizes relevant issues for communication to direct-line management. Coordinates and assigns tasks to technicians, and/or provides input or coordination with appropriate program managers and direct-line management for ticket assignment automation to provide direction as needed, to ensure work is appropriately allocated to meet Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type. Monitors progress of tickets assigned to teams of technicians and adjusts where necessary, to meet established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type. Analyzes data related to technicians' performance on tickets and shares with direct-line management.
 
Advises on and reviews suggested modifications to process and procedures to manage changes and drive improvement in service quality and/or efficiency. Proactively investigates, evaluates, and analyzes changes. Reviews Process Change Notifications (PCNs) to evaluate impact on service execution and shares relevant information about change with stakeholders across functions and disciplines to mitigate the impact they may have on others. Encourages technicians to ask questions when they do not have required information, resolves others' questions in a timely manner, and may provide feedback on changes to processes to direct-line management, standards management teams, and/or project, program, or special initiative managers.

Datacenter Work Environment

Traveling up to 25% typically domestically to and from multiple locations during the workday, and occasionally domestically to other sites for overnight stays. May work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours such as evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
 
Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting up to 25lbs / 11kg without assistance. Occasional lifting 25-50lbs / 11-22.5kg with lift assistance. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.
 
Promotes a positive and effective team environment by modeling best practices, leading regular team meetings, cross-discipline collaborations, and monitoring the status of work across their team to understanding the impact on other shifts/technician teams, engineering groups or internal business partner needs and the overall business. Provides, responds to, and encourages providing feedback regarding on ways to work more effectively or enhance efficiency within their team and adopts best practices shared within-and-across shifts or technician teams.
 
Working for extended periods under elevated levels of ambient noise, heat, and light due to necessary equipment and ventilation systems.
 
Conducts daily safety briefings, ensuring their team members attend, and/or participates in onsite safety committees. Completes required Environmental & Health Safety (EHS) training, ensures technicians comply with EHS training completion requirements and are compliant with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use), Task Hazard Analysis (THAs) completion, and use of appropriate equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for assigned tasks. Adheres to and promotes a culture of safety, empowering technician teams to report and/or take proactive action regarding safety concerns, near-misses, and/or incidents. Participates in regular cadence proactive safety observation reporting processes and systems, and follows up with their team members as needed regarding actionable safety observations reported.
 
Completes required security and data management training, ensures technicians completion of applicable training, and maintains accountability for technician compliance with security and data management procedures/policies. Ensures that policies and procedures securing physical access to the data center or network site environment(s) are appropriately enforced. May escort third party vendors or IT support on-premises at data centers or network sites. Appropriately takes action and reports physical security access concerns and/or incidents, and gathers information about such events reported by their team to inform direct-line management and escalates to relevant stakeholders. Participates in identifying the root cause of any physical security access violations and manages corrective actions and escalations related to technician violations of physical security procedures or policies.

Managing Service

Exercises judgment and discretion to contribute to issue tracking related to follow-up and resolution to overall quality of service escalations and/or proactive initiatives. Maintains responsibility for client and technician team interactions for escalations and/or engagements between them and other internal business partners.
Partners with internal and external stakeholders to manage the removal of risks to personnel and/or resource availability, performance, and compliance.
 
Identifies and assigns required training as applicable across all technician job focus areas and workloads (i.e., Break fix, Deployment, Simple Change, Decommission, IT Critical Environment) along with Personnel Management training in a timely manner per direct-line management assignment(s) and validates completion of assigned training by team members. May complete additional or supplemental training to obtain or maintain relevant industry or technical certifications and advise their team on relevant certifications to obtain.
 
Collects and reviews appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for their team to support line of business (e.g. performance measures, long-term trends) and/or business intelligence analysis (e.g., service availability data, system health). Shares feedback from reviews with technicians to drive improvement in meeting KPI expectations and sharing learnings from reviews with direct-line management.

People Management

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Service Delivery

Follows procedures to immediately engage Designated Responsible Individuals (DRIs) for appropriate communication, reporting, and incident management of data center technical or safety related incidents with direct-line management, internal business partners, and impacted engineering group contacts. Participates in bridge calls to provide details on incident status and executes on-site follow-up actions as directed if necessary. May leverage learnings to contribute to the improvement of quality of service and support.
 
Coordinates training packages for technicians on procedures for installation, deployment, upgrade, refresh, simple change, decommission and/or replacement of infrastructure cabling, network, storage, or server equipment. Provides guidance to technicians for developing an effective execution order of assigned tasks and ensures technicians have access to tools and/or supplies required to perform work. Investigates root causes of issues that may have negatively impacted ticket Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) per task type, and takes proactive corrective action.
 
Verifies compliance with standards and procedure for data-bearing devices (DBDs) destruction and/or confirms any-and-all such devices (e.g. hard-drives, solid-state drives, flash cards, etc.) contained within network, storage, or server equipment has been identified for eradication or destruction. Creates schedules for shift-based technicians to ensure positioning and availability to execute work as defined by organizational standards, negotiates with internal team colleagues to organize project timelines, with guidance from direct-line management, and appropriate notification to stakeholders.
 
Manages assigned projects or programs to meet service delivery objectives. Participates in pilot programs or task forces to ensure smooth implementation for future service delivery as directed.
 
Proactively reviews schedules and avoids conflicts when possible. Identifies, coordinates, manages expectations, and offers alternatives when defining technical solutions in light of ongoing operations and procedures (e.g., schedule, technical feasibility, policy, procedure, tools).
 
Evaluates procedures for performing quality checks to ensure they align with compliance standards and process adherence, and takes responsibility for impact to Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) by task type of work performed by technicians. Performs post-execution verification of grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling as needed to ensure alignment with all safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Templates (NDTs), taking corrective action(s) to address any non-compliance, and validates post-execution quality or validation training has been completed by applicable technicians to enable them. Identifies errors in deployment standards or Network Design Templates (NDTs) and coordinates directly with internal business partners, technologists, or subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop corrections as needed.
 
Evaluates diagnostic and troubleshooting processes and suggests improvements. Maintains advanced awareness of conditions, circumstances, and scenarios which may reflect significant customer or business impact within the Data Center environment, and escalates observations of imminent incident risks or potential situations immediately to direct-line management.

Overview

The AI Infrastructure team is responsible for building and operating large-scale, highly reliable, and efficient GPU infrastructure that powers Microsoft’s AI ecosystem. We host the training and inference platforms behind many of Microsoft’s flagship AI offerings, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, and Azure AI Foundry’s inference and fine-tuning services for both OpenAI and open-source models. Our infrastructure enables AI innovation at hyperscale and supports some of the most demanding workloads across the company.

As a Software Engineer on the AI infrastructure team, you will work on cutting edge infrastructure and tools to support large scale model deployments, pre-training, post-training and fine-tuning on latest generation of NVIDIA and AMD GPUs in Azure and Microsoft partner clouds on some of the world’s largest AI Supercomputers.  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

As an engineer on the AI infrastructure team, your responsibilities include:

•    Design, develop, and maintain AI infrastructure services in Go, Rust, Python, C++, and C#, deployed on large-scale Kubernetes clusters to support inference, pre-training, and post-training workloads for state-of-the-art AI models.
•    Collaborate with engineers, researchers, and external partners to troubleshoot issues, improve reliability, and optimize the performance of large-scale AI training and inference systems.
•    Build and enhance distributed systems that deliver high reliability, low latency, operational efficiency, and strong security across Azure and partner cloud environments.
•    Develop automation and tooling to improve GPU capacity utilization, streamline fleet operations, and enable efficient scaling of AI infrastructure.
•    Provide operational support, technical leadership, and vision while contributing to the deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of engineering systems and practices.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

•    2+ years designing, developing, and shipping high quality software.  
•    2+ years of experience with distributed systems and cloud-based infrastructure. 
•    1+ year of experience with DevOps practices (CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, etc.).   
•    2+ years of software development experience in C#, C++, Python, or similar languages.  
•    2+ years of experience with containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
•    Knowledge and hands on experience with production ML systems, large-scale training infrastructure, NCCL, CUDA libraries and tools

Overview

Microsoft Security is building a world-class library of practical, actionable, practitioner-focused security guidance for the AI (Artificial Intelligence) era. We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Security to own that guidance as a product: from insight and intake, through co-creation and technical validation, to the reference architecture, labs, and walkthroughs practitioners use to put it into production.

You will orchestrate guidance for Zero Trust for AI and Security imperatives (Get Ready for AI, Secure AI, and Defend with AI). The audience is the security practitioner and architect doing the work.

In this role, you will work closely with engineering, product management, security architects, the Office of the CISO (Chief Information Security Officer), and other Product Marketing Managers to turn Microsoft Security innovation, Zero Trust principles, AI-era security learnings, and SFI (Secure Future Initiative) insights into clear, repeatable, implementable guidance that customers and partners can apply at scale.

You will partner closely with the Product Marketing Manager for the Security Practitioner Audience, who takes your guidance to market and measures its business impact, and alongside the Product Marketing Manager for the CISO audience, who leads the decision-maker narrative.

This is a technical product marketing role. You will be expected to understand architecture, review reference implementations, and communicate and support recommendations with security practitioners. It is a high-impact individual contributor position with broad visibility across Microsoft Security.

Audience

This role serves one connected audience set, and candidates with relevant experience supporting these audiences may bring experience in areas such as:

  • Security practitioners and architects implementing Zero Trust for AI, including securing models, agents, data boundaries, and the identity fabric around them.
  • Organizations getting ready for AI, who need a sequenced path from where they are today to a defensible AI deployment.
  • Technical decision makers who seek out practitioner-depth content to decide what to deploy and how. CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) and executive audiences are led by a partner PMM (Product Marketing Manager).


Responsibilities
  • Own and operationalize the guidance intake model, synthesizing product innovation, customer and field signals, practitioner audience insights, Zero Trust and Zero Trust for AI (Artificial Intelligence) guidance, AI safety and security learnings, and SFI (Secure Future Initiative) insights into a prioritized technical roadmap for each quarterly content wave.
  • Partner with engineering SMEs (Subject Matter Experts), PMs (Product Managers), security architects, CVC (Customer Value and Experience team), and the Office of the CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) to co-create prescriptive guidance using a consistent taxonomy: problem, solution, implementation guidance, and implications.
  • Build end-to-end guidance for each job to be done that follows the full sequence a practitioner executes across Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra, and Microsoft Purview, including the handoffs between products.
  • Develop hands-on labs, reference architectures, and walkthroughs that move guidance from what to how, including deployment sequencing, configuration, and validation steps a practitioner executes.
  • Own technical quality and product alignment: coordinate SME reviews for technical accuracy and practitioner relevance before every publication, and map guidance to in-product domains and maturity signals so its impact on deployment can be measured.
  • Serve as a technical resource for practitioners and architects: present technical sessions and demos at security events (e.g., RSA, Ignite, Build), facilitate workshops, gather direct customer feedback, and incorporate it into the guidance roadmap.


Qualifications
 

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Master's Degree in in Marketing, Computer Science, Business or related field AND 3+ years experience in business OR Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Business or related field AND 5+ years experience in business OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Business or related field AND 6+ years experience in business OR Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Business or related field AND 8+ years experience in business OR equivalent experience.
  • Hands-on technical experience in cybersecurity, including experience as a practitioner, security architect, security engineer, consultant, or technical product marketer.
  • Knowledge of AI (Artificial Intelligence) and agentic systems and the security considerations they raise, including model and agent identity, data boundaries, prompt and tool abuse, and AI risk governance.
  • Experience translating complex security architecture into clear, actionable guidance practitioners can implement.
  • Experience collaborating across functions, including partnership with engineering, product management, and other PMMs (Product Marketing Managers).
  • Experience with writing, content development, and editorial decision-making.

We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all-up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.     

The Microsoft Federal organization was established to address the unique mission, legal/regulatory requirements, and procurement rules and processes of the United States Government (USG). Microsoft Federal is committed to ensuring its resources – including appropriately qualified, experienced, and certified personnel (with necessary security clearances or otherwise) are available as needed to meet USG evolving needs. To that end, Microsoft embraces, as a mission-critical philosophy, flexibility in the recruiting, hiring, and workforce assignment of Microsoft Federal personnel. Microsoft Federal personnel can expect to serve in various roles in the Microsoft Federal organization during the course of their career to meet evolving USG needs, regardless of segment – Civilian, Defense, or Intelligence community.

This role allows for some remote work with frequent on-site support (3+ days/week) at the customer’s facility in Northern Virginia, and occasional travel (25%) to other customer locations.

As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will help to maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our datacenters up and running. This could be anything from performing basic monitoring and inspection, performing various types of maintenance, participating in equipment troubleshooting, enforcing all safety and security requirements, and developing methods of operating procedures (MOPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
 
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. 
 
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. 
 
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.  Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. 
 
In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

As Commercial Partner Lead for Enterprise Partner Sales (EPS) Austria, you will shape and drive Microsoft’s enterprise partner business in Austria, bringing together strategic partners, customers and Microsoft sales teams to accelerate growth, platform adoption and AI-led transformation.

As a member of the Austria Leadership Team, you will represent the enterprise partner ecosystem in the country’s commercial strategy and execution, ensuring partners are an integral part of how Microsoft creates customer impact and grows the business.You will provide commercial leadership and cross-functional direction across the Partner Development Managers (PDMs) and broader partner organization supporting Austria, aligning priorities, orchestrating resources and driving shared accountability around the customers and opportunities that matter most.

Success in this role requires leadership through influence. You will create clarity across organizational boundaries, mobilize teams behind common priorities, challenge the status quo and turn Microsoft’s partner ecosystem into a multiplier for customer transformation and sustainable growth.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realise our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 



Responsibilities

Lead the Enterprise Partner Business in Austria
- Own and drive the enterprise partner strategy and commercial priorities for Austria.
- Represent the partner ecosystem within the Austria Leadership Team, bringing the partner perspective into country strategy, planning and execution.
- Identify where partners can make the greatest impact across strategic customers, industries and transformation opportunities.
- Drive partner-led pipeline creation, co-sell, consumption, revenue and customer adoption.
- Establish clear priorities and a operating rhythm across partners, opportunities and investments.
- Ensure the partner ecosystem is embedded in the most strategic customer opportunities from the outset.

Lead Through Influence and Orchestration
- Provide commercial leadership and direction across the PDM community and broader partner organization supporting Austria.
- Create alignment across Enterprise Partner Sales, Account Teams, Solution Areas and other key stakeholders around shared customer and business priorities.
- Connect Austrian market opportunities with regional and global partner capabilities, resources and investments.
- Build commitment and shared accountability across organizational boundaries.
- Influence stakeholders and translate strategy into coordinated execution.
- Act as a connector and challenger, ensuring the right partners are engaged in the right opportunities at the right time.

Accelerate AI and Frontier Transformation
- Shape and mobilize the Austrian ecosystem around Microsoft’s AI, cloud and Frontier Transformation priorities.
- Work with strategic partners to develop differentiated AI, agentic, industry and transformation capabilities.
- Accelerate the journey from experimentation and pilots toward scalable enterprise transformation and measurable customer outcomes.
- Work with partners to build capabilities, services and solutions that differentiate Microsoft and its ecosystem in the market.
- Identify new opportunities where partners can unlock transformation beyond traditional technology implementation.

Drive Sales With and Through Partners
- Make partners a systematic part of Microsoft’s enterprise sales execution.
- Connect partner capabilities with customer demand and strategic opportunities.
- Build executive relationships across Global System Integrators, Enterprise System Integrators, Advisory and Consulting partners, ISVs and other strategic ecosystem players.
- Drive joint account planning, co-sell and go-to-market execution around priority customers and opportunities.
- Develop repeatable partner motions that create pipeline, accelerate transformation and scale across the Austrian market.
- Bring together Microsoft and partner executives when leadership engagement can unlock or accelerate strategic opportunities.

Drive Execution Excellence
- Establish disciplined business planning and governance across the partner portfolio.
- Focus resources, investments and leadership attention on the partners and opportunities with the greatest potential impact.
- Use business insights and data to identify opportunities, remove blockers and accelerate execution.
- Maintain proper alignment between Austrian market priorities and the broader Microsoft partner organization.
- Create transparency and accountability around pipeline, execution and business outcomes.Ensure partner investments translate into measurable customer and Microsoft impact.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Management, or related field AND extensive related experience, including coaching solution sales and account development strategies, exceeding quotas by leading sales teams along complex sales cycles through a partner ecosystem and centralized marketing engine, Global, Area-level Business Management as a leader of Sales, Customer, Partner teams selling technology solutions/practice development, cloud/Infrastructure technologies, and/or subscription services, sales leadership, or managing high performance sales and technical-sales teams
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Experience in developing commercial strategy and translate it into execution, pipeline and measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise customers, cloud, AI and digital transformation, and how technology and partner ecosystems can drive business value.
  • This role requires fluency in German and English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Global System Integrators, System Integrators, Advisory and Consulting firms, ISVs and other strategic enterprise partners.

Overview

AI Business Solutions (ABS) is where Microsoft's AI ambition meets real customer outcomes. How quickly the field can learn from those outcomes, prove them to the next customer, and repeat what works determines how fast the business scales. The AI Business Solutions team in Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions (MCAPS)-Core is hiring a leader accountable for that system: the voice of the customer, competitive intelligence, business value realization at scale, the external reference process, and the customer success stories that turn proven wins into new business. 

This capability does not exist in ABS today. Customer insight sits in individual conversations, competitive signal is gathered ad hoc, value realization is proven account by account, and our best customer proof lives in decks and inboxes the field cannot find. This role builds the engine that connects them, and is accountable for making customer evidence discoverable, reusable, and activated across every seller, delivery team, and leader in the business. 

The role reports to the ABS CVP and works directly with the ABS CVP and leadership team. Success is measured in field activation and business outcomes: adoption, deployment, usage, consumption, value realization, and revenue growth. 

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Voice of the Customer for the Field 

  • Build and own the voice of the customer system for ABS, capturing what customers are telling us across engagements, deployments, escalations, councils, and field conversations, and turning it into structured insight leadership and the field can act on. 

  • Establish the listening channels and feedback loops that bring customer reality back into ABS priorities, including recurring rhythms with sellers, delivery teams, and field leaders who sit closest to the customer. 

  • Synthesize customer signal into a clear point of view on what is working, what is blocking adoption, and what customers need next, and drive that view into planning, product feedback, and go-to-market decisions. 

  • Close the loop with the field so teams see how their input changed a decision, a message, or an investment. 

Competitive Intelligence 

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure competitive insight informs positioning, roadmap conversations, and executive messaging  

  • Maintain a current, credible view of why ABS wins and why ABS loses, and make that view visible to leadership on a predictable cadence. 

Business Value Realization at Scale 

  • Build the operating model that proves and scales business value realization across the ABS portfolio, moving value measurement from bespoke, account-level effort to a repeatable discipline the field can run. 

  • Codify the patterns behind successful deployments into best practices, playbooks, and reusable guidance, closing a long-standing gap in how the organization captures and shares what works. 

  • Partner with delivery, sales, and finance stakeholders to ensure value claims are defensible, consistently measured, and connected to renewal, expansion, and growth conversations. 

External Reference Process 

  • Design, stand up, and own the external customer reference process for ABS, including nomination, qualification, customer approval, legal and privacy review, refresh cycles, and retirement. 

  • Build and maintain a governed reference portfolio spanning industries, segments, geographies, and solution areas, so account teams can find a relevant, approved reference quickly. 

  • Manage reference demand and protect the customer relationship, balancing field requests against customer willingness and ensuring reference customers are treated as long-term partners rather than one-time assets. 

  • Partner with Marketing, Legal, Communications, and field leadership to ensure references meet Microsoft standards and are activated in campaigns, events, and executive engagements. 

Customer Success Stories & Evidence That Scales New Business 

  • Own the end-to-end process for identifying, curating, and publishing ABS customer success stories, converting wins, win wires, showcases, and demonstrations into evidence the field can use to open and advance the next opportunity. 

  • Prioritize stories against business strategy, targeting the industries, workloads, and motions where proof will unlock the most new business rather than publishing opportunistically. 

  • Ensure customer proof is discoverable, reusable, and measurable, with clear ownership for where evidence lives, how it is kept current, and how usage and impact are tracked. 

  • Activate evidence across sellers, delivery teams, partners, marketing, and executives, and hold the standard that every customer success strengthens Microsoft's ability to win the next opportunity. 

Narrative & Executive Communications 

  • Connect customer evidence, competitive insight, and value realization results into the ABS narrative, ensuring what we say externally is grounded in what customers have actually experienced. 

  • Support ABS CVP and leadership communications and signature moments with customer proof points, data, and stories that make the business case concrete for internal and external audiences. 

  • Ensure the field, partners, and customers encounter a consistent story across communications, engagements, events, and campaigns. 

Field Activation & Enablement 

  • Make the outputs of this function usable in the field, ensuring sellers, delivery teams, and field leaders know what exists, where to find it, and how to apply it in a live customer conversation. 

  • Partner with field leadership and enablement teams to embed customer evidence, competitive guidance, and value frameworks into existing sales and delivery motions rather than creating parallel processes. 

  • Track adoption and usage of these assets and improve them based on what the field actually uses and what drives results. 

Measurement & Business Impact 

  • Define the success criteria and metrics for this function, including reference coverage, evidence usage, competitive win rate, value realization attainment, and field satisfaction. 

  • Use AI-powered discovery, analytics, and customer intelligence to identify emerging customer successes, adoption opportunities, and market signals earlier than manual processes allow. 

  • Report to ABS leadership on what the customer, competitive, and value data indicate about the direction of the business, and use those insights to influence priorities and investment. 



Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in business consulting, sales, sales operations, information technology (IT), account management, business development, marketing, IT field sales, or a related field OR equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years experience in in Near Term Strategy (2 years out), Management Consulting, Sales, or Finance.

 

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration or related field AND 5+ years of marketing, strategy, sales, sales leadership, program management, project management, business planning, consulting, banking, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or related field AND 7+ years of marketing, strategy, sales, sales leadership, program management, project management, business planning, consulting, finance, economics, and/or partner organization experience OR equivalent experience.
  • Experience leading people or teams, including setting direction, coaching, and developing talent.
  • Experience building a customer reference, customer evidence, or voice of the customer program, including the process, governance, and systems behind it.
  • Experience standing up a function from the ground up, including defining the operating model, securing stakeholder adoption, and scaling it across a large field organization.
  • Experience in business value realization, value engineering, or customer success measurement, including defining metrics and frameworks used to quantify customer outcomes.
  • Experience in competitive intelligence, including producing field-ready battlecards, win and loss analysis, and differentiation guidance for sellers.
  • Experience managing external customer references at scale, including customer approvals, legal and privacy review, and governance of a reference portfolio.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior executives at the CVP level and above, with the judgment and credibility to influence at that level.
  • Experience in cloud, AI, or enterprise technology, with an understanding of how sellers and delivery teams work and what they need to advance an opportunity.
  • Proficient analytical skills, including the ability to work with adoption, consumption, and business performance data and translate it into a clear point of view.
  • Proficient writing and editing skills, including the ability to turn a complex customer engagement into a clear, credible story with limited direction.
  • Experience using AI as a discovery, creative, and analytical tool, and fluency with Microsoft 365 applications and reporting platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity, exercise sound judgment, and move quickly while maintaining quality, stakeholder trust, and strategic clarity.

  • Complies with Data Center business unit policies, procedures, and deadlines with guidance from experienced technicians and/or direct-line management. Escalates issues related to compliance or operational assurance activities to direct-line management.

Datacenter Work Environment

  • Completes required security and data management training while complying with security and data management procedures/policies with guidance from other technicians.   • Participates in daily safety briefings. Completes required Environmental & Health Safety (EHS) training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use), completes required Task Hazard Analysis (THAs), and uses appropriate equipment and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for assigned tasks. Adheres to and promotes a culture of safety, taking proactive action to alert others of safety concerns, near-misses, and/or incidents. Participates in regular cadence proactive safety observation reporting processes and systems.
  • Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting up to 25lbs / 11kg without assistance. Occasional lifting 25-50lbs / 11-22.5kg with lift assistance. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.
  • Traveling up to 25% typically domestically to and from multiple locations during the workday, and occasionally domestically to other sites for overnight stays. Encourages providing and responding to feedback received on ways to work more effectively or enhance efficiency within their team and adopts best practices shared within-and-across shifts or technician teams

Managing Service

Observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training (OJT). May complete additional or supplemental training to obtain or maintain relevant industry or technical certifications.
  • Maintains an awareness of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through reporting dashboards, systems, for personal monthly performance discussions as needed.
  • Escalates and/or seeks guidance from experienced technicians or direct-line management regarding client interactions.

Service Delivery

  • Performs basic diagnostics and troubleshooting with guidance from experienced technicians and/or via standard procedures to identify the cause(s) of technical issues and replace faulty components in network, storage, or server equipment with zero-to-minimal customer and/or business disruption. Develops awareness of conditions, circumstances, and scenarios which may reflect significant customer or business impact within the Data Center environment.
  • Learns about post-execution verification of grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling to align with all safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Templates (NDTs). Learns about errors in deployment standards or Network Design Templates (NDTs) and escalates to relevant technicians or specialists to coordinate corrections as needed.
  • Develops an understanding of effective execution order strategy(ies) for assigned tasks with assistance from experienced technicians or direct-line management. Prepares, stages, sets up, and performs basic startups and shutdowns for hardware (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches) according to specific written instructions provided via checklists, guides, standard processes, emails, guidance from other technicians, and/or direction from management. May perform tasks in tandem with other technicians to comply with procedures and safety requirements.
  • Follows procedures to immediately communicate, report, and escalate data center technical or safety related incidents to direct-line management. May participate in bridge calls to provide details on incident status and executes on-site follow-up actions as directed if necessary.
  • Directly performs decommissions, simple changes (e.g., memory upgrades, OS rebuilds) and refreshes of infrastructure cabling, network, storage, and server equipment, following standard procedures whilst seeking clarification and guidance from more experienced technicians as needed. Overview
 

What happens when AI agents can rewrite millions of lines of code orders of magnitude faster than humans can review them? That question drives the Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in Microsoft's CoreAI division. We build AI agents that transform some of the world's largest codebases, including Windows and Azure. Generating code is becoming the easy part; knowing whether to trust it is the real challenge. 

We combine AI agents with static analysis, testing, and formal verification to make large-scale software transformation practical and trustworthy, and we design tools that spend scarce human attention where it matters most. The team began in Microsoft Research and moved to CoreAI in 2025, and we continue to collaborate closely with Microsoft Research, so research depth meets production stakes every day.  

Here are the main problems we are currently working on:  

Migration at scale: We work on migrating hundreds of millions of lines of code, across Windows, Azure, Office, and other products, to work with new versions of dependent packages, new compilers and new platforms. Examples include increasing language-standards conformance of code, remediating CodeQL and other static analysis findings, and retargeting services from x86 to ARM. 

Language modernization:  We move legacy C/C++ (and C#) codebases to Rust, with validation gates at every step. Differential testing against the original, held-out tests, and specification extraction with formal verification (such as Verus proofs) mean each migration is backed by evidence, not optimism. 

Specification-driven development: We help brownfield codebases adopt specification-driven development by inferring formal specifications for existing code. The specifications are grounded using execution traces and then used to generate concurrency and fault-tolerance tests, find subtle bugs, and ultimately create a validation guardrail for future AI-driven code changes. We are working with formal tools such as TLA+, F*, Lean and Verus in this work.  

You will be onsite at least three days a week and learn and grow through working with talented colleagues.  



Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship agentic tools and infrastructure for one or more of our problem areas (such as migration at scale, language modernization, or specification-driven development). 

  • Build the tool layers agents depend on (context, analysis, and validation) and the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether they work. 

  • Integrate static analysis, testing, and verification into agent loops so every change arrives with evidence. 

  • Work directly with engineering teams across Microsoft, such as Windows and Azure, to land changes at production quality. 

  • Instrument and measure quality, including acceptance rate and correctness, and iterate from user feedback. 

  • Contribute to design reviews and mentor other engineers. 

 



Qualifications

Required qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related areas and 6+ years of experience. Or a Master’s degree with 4+ years of experience. Or a PhD in computer science or related areas. 

  • Experience coding in languages such as C, C++, C#, or Rust.  

  • Experience building developer tools using LLM-based agents. 

  • Experience with compilers and program analysis.  

  • Excellent technical design, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, customer obsession, and a passion for shipping high-quality products. 

Preferred qualifications 

  • Experience with Rust and C/C++ interop and memory safety. 

  • Experience testing at scale, such as differential testing, property-based testing, or fuzzing. 

  • Experience with formal methods such as TLA+, model checking, F*, Lean, Verus, Dafny, or similar. 

  • Experience working with very large codebases and build systems. 

  • Interest or experience in human-AI interaction and developer experience design. 

  • Publications or open-source contributions are a plus. 

Why join us 

  • Work on the hardest problems in agentic software engineering, at real scale. 

  • Join a small team with outsized leverage, where a handful of experts steer changes across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 

  • Blend research and engineering: ideas here ship to tools used by Windows, Azure, and other large teams. 

  • Build on, and contribute back to, the research community around TLA+, F*, Lean, Verus, etc.

Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world.

As the Technical Program Manager for Government Partnerships, you'll own Anthropic's day-to-day operational engagement with NIST’s US Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (NIST CAISSI), the UK AI Security Institute (AISI), and other key government partners. These institutions evaluate our models, collaborate with our researchers, and are essential partners in advancing the safety and security of AI. You'll run what makes that work possible.

This role will require extensive collaboration both with our government partners and with many teams across Anthropic notably our teams involved in policy, safeguards, model launches, and research on areas such as alignment, monitorability, cybersecurity, and biosecurity.

  • Own the day-to-day relationship - Serve as the primary operational contact for all interactions between Anthropic and these government partners. Run regular meetings with our partners, triage every request, build the trackers and playbooks that let the work scale both for consistency with these partners and where valuable to more government partners.

  • Manage model access end to end - Ensure each partner has the access they need, under the right agreement, at the right time for the duration of time they need the access.

  • Coordinate legal agreements - Work with Legal to negotiate, amend, and maintain MOUs, evaluation plans, research plans, NDAs, and data-sharing agreements that govern the work.

Get findings to the researchers who need them in time to use them. Bring a point of view on how to align partner testing to impact within Anthropic and provide input where requested by partners on the research and evaluation directions which are uniquely valuable to Anthropic. 

  • Coordinate research collaborations - Identify opportunities to connect government researchers with Anthropic researchers where there is mutual interest. Scope the work, keep it moving, and align government partner research efforts to where their work has the most impact.

  • Build trust quickly and know what can be shared, with whom, and through which channel.

  • Are mid-career to senior and work independently. From government, that is roughly a GS-14 or GS-15, a UK Grade 6 or Grade 7, or equivalent.

  • Can work across US and UK time zones, travel regularly, and cover early or late hours around launches.

  • Care about Anthropic's mission and about building government capacity on frontier AI.

  • Bring existing working relationships at these organizations.

  • Have hands-on experience with AI evaluations, cybersecurity, or biosecurity.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a world-class Demand & Supply Planner to join our team. The Demand & Supply Planner has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrate ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage day-to-day demand signaling, ordering, and inventory for various product lines.
  • Identify and resolve supply issues by collaborating with Engineering, Purchasing, and Manufacturing teams.
  • Lead Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions for Supply Planning on designated product lines.
  • Work with Business Development and Growth teams to align forecasts with actual demand plans.
  • Report on and analyze supply and material health to inform key decisions for Engineering, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and Business Development.
  • Develop and maintain processes within MRP systems and associated master data.
  • Drive strategic initiatives towards best practices, including demand shaping, advanced modeling, and inventory optimization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (i.e. manufacturing, engineering, analytics, computer science, etc.) or business field (i.e. finance, economics, supply chain management, business administration, marketing, etc.)
  • 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or production role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment dealing with complex assemblies.
  • Complete ownership of a complex value chain, coordinating between multiple, high volume of departments and teams to ensure on-time deliveries and adherence to quality standards.
  • Technical expertise including ability to read technical documentation and understanding hardware manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree or other higher education.
  • Strong experience with SQL databases, including building custom queries for production and inventory metrics.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlikview.
  • Knowledge of supply chain planning systems like Blue Yonder and best practices in demand planning, inventory management, and S&OP.
  • Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, six sigma principles, and big data evaluation techniques.
  • Proactive, able to take substantial responsibility across various functions, with a focus on speed and accuracy.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance.

Anduril is seeking an experienced Principal Power Controls Engineer (acting SME) to develop and implement advanced control algorithms for high-performance power electronic systems. We're looking for someone with deep expertise in control system modeling and simulation — particularly in Simulink and PLECS — who can take a controls concept from simulation through hardware validation. This individual will own the control architecture for DC/DC converters, inverters, and motor drives built around discrete SiC and GaN power stages, and will work closely with power hardware and firmware engineers to deliver tightly integrated, high-reliability systems for defense and aerospace applications.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Design, simulate, and validate closed-loop control algorithms for switch-mode power converters and inverters using Simulink and/or PLECS.
  • Controls for 3-phase AC systems, with and without a switched Neutral
  • Develop plant models and controller architectures (voltage-mode, current-mode, sensorless FOC, etc.) for multi-kW power stages utilizing discrete SiC and GaN FETs.
  • Perform stability analysis, loop shaping, and compensator design to meet transient response, efficiency, and EMI targets.
  • Collaborate with power hardware engineers on gate drive tuning, dead-time optimization, and switching-loss characterization of wide-bandgap devices.
  • Support model-based code generation workflows and work with firmware engineers to translate control designs into embedded implementations.
  • Define and execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and power-hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) test plans to validate control performance against system requirements.
  • Contribute to trade studies on converter topology, modulation strategy, and control bandwidth as they relate to size, weight, power, and thermal constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 15+ years of experience designing and tuning digital control loops for power electronic converters (DC/DC, DC/AC, or motor drives).
  • Proficiency in Simulink and/or PLECS for control system modeling, simulation, and analysis.
  • Strong foundation in control theory — z-domain and s-domain design, bode analysis, state-space methods, and discrete-time implementation considerations.
  • Hands-on experience with discrete SiC and/or GaN FET-based power stages in the multi-kW range.
  • Familiarity with military or aerospace environments and standards such as MIL-STD-461, 464, 810, or DO-160.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MS/PhD with a focus in power electronics controls or control systems.
  • Experience writing embedded firmware (C/C++) for microcontrollers or DSPs used in power converter control (e.g., TI C2000, STM32).
  • Familiarity with auto-code generation from Simulink (Embedded Coder) or similar model-based design toolchains.
  • Experience with real-time HIL platforms (e.g., Typhoon HIL, dSPACE, OPAL-RT).
  • Knowledge of advanced modulation techniques (SVM, DPWM) and their impact on switching losses in wide-bandgap devices.
  • Design-for-Reliability practices including DFMEA.
  • Experience with EMI mitigation strategies at the controls and layout level.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is seeking a Product Data Engineer to join our Configuration Management team. As a Product Data Engineer you will work closely with the leaders of critical Anduril programs to manage a highly dynamic and fast-paced design, engineering, and manufacturing environment. The Product Data Engineer will have a massive impact on capturing and defining the baseline for a program’s requirements, design, testing, manufacturing, and sustainment data structures (requirements baseline, EBOM, MBOM, SOM, BOP).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be a partner to Product and Program teams by:
  • Working with Anduril system, design, and manufacturing engineers to generate, populate and submit configuration item change requests.
  • Preparing critical analyses to support change requests while maintaining configuration integrity and traceability (item dependency analyses, test analyses, effectivity plans, inventory disposition analyses etc.)
  • Supporting the execution and implementation of change notices across system engineering, design engineering, manufacturing engineering, and supply chain domains.
  • Identifying and executing continuous improvement opportunities by building data-driven perspectives of the full product configuration landscape.
  • Be the leader of critical configuration management activities and forums by:
  • Supporting configuration managers in managing critical program technical forums (Test Review Board, Change Control Board etc.).
  • Working with program teams to prepare for critical technical forums (the Change Review Board, the Change Control Board) including preparing of business cases, test data, effectivity plans, inventory disposition plans, etc.
  • Documenting and distributing conclusions, decisions emerging from configuration management forums.
  • Conduct periodic product configuration record audits by:
  • Supporting configuration management reviews and audits, including FCA/PCA and providing direction before, during and after the events to prevent or resolve issues.
  • Reconciling released bills of materials against baseline bills of materials by confirming all variances have signed-off change notices.
  • Reconciling product as-built-records against released bills of materials by confirming all variances have quality deviations.
  • Identifying, analyzing resolving non-conformances; finding and resolving root-causing failure modes.
  • Be an expert resource for the Product Teams for Engineering Release and Change Management processes and standards by:
  • Using Teamcenter software to manage Engineering changes, including part revisions, EBOM/MBOM/SBOM updates, documentation modifications, and associated workflows.
  • Providing guidance and support to Engineering teams in configuring the Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service Bills of Materials (EBOM, MBOM, SBOM)
  • Supporting Configuration Managers and Engineers in defining and maintaining configurable product data sets (i.e., 150% BOMs, product variant dictionaries and schema).
  • Being a Teamcenter super-user and able to train product team users on workflows.
  • Be part of the team defining the future of digital engineering at Anduril by:
  • Partnering with engineering teams to set requirements and identify improvement opportunities in existing ways of working by creating tools or enhancing existing workflows.
  • Building an end-to-end digital thread that maintains an accurate product definition, system by system, from the definition of requirements to the as maintained record.
  • Identifying and piloting opportunities to leverage Anduril’s AI capabilities tools to unlock increased speed, accuracy, and efficiency within Anduril’s configuration management activities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of configuration analysis or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of demonstrated experience working in high complexity and high-rate production environments (aerospace, automotive, security systems, medical devices, nuclear).
  • Familiar with configuration management principles and practices (EIA649/C, MIL-HDBK-61B).
  • Experience with product lifecycle management (PLM) and/or data management toolsets for configuration management of complex products
  • Possess high attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills – you must have an ability to synthesize complex quantitative data into clear decision statements.
  • BA/BS degree.
  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to our inclusive culture.
  • Is able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven experience in aerospace industry.
  • Proficient in technical writing of processes and procedures.
  • Experience with Teamcenter, Teamcenter Requirements, Teamcenter Quality, Confluence & JIRA.
  • Certification in CM2 or equivalent configuration management certification.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will provide essential project management and content generation skills, expertly navigating the dynamic environment of a hyper-growth company and managing competing priorities with overlapping schedules. You will learn to craft compelling material to inform our customers’ market research and acquisition strategies, write technical narratives on cutting edge capabilities, build and implement pricing strategies, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to close deals.   • Ability to synthesize large amounts of information into a coherent and convincing narrative.

ABOUT THE ROLE


We are looking for a Senior Systems Administrator to independently administer, troubleshoot, maintain, and secure enterprise Windows and Linux systems in classified environments. Senior Systems Administrators are expected to perform nearly all routine and advanced administration with little to no assistance, serve as a technical escalation point, mentor other administrators, and lead operational work. Assistance should generally be limited to unfamiliar technologies, high-risk changes, architecture decisions, or issues requiring specialized engineering expertise.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Independently administer and troubleshoot Windows Server/desktop and Linux systems, Active Directory, enterprise authentication, permissions, services, applications, and domain-connected systems.
  • Administer and troubleshoot enterprise Windows services including Group Policy (GPO), WSUS/patch management, DNS, DHCP, file services, certificates/PKI dependencies, and related system components.
  • Create, modify, test, validate, and troubleshoot GPOs, including inheritance, precedence, OU targeting, security filtering, gpresult, and Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP).
  • Administer WSUS or equivalent patching solutions, including synchronization, targeting, approvals, deployment status, failed updates, reporting, and patch-compliance remediation.
  • Interpret DISA STIG requirements; use applicable STIG tools/checklists; implement and validate remediations, including GPO-based security configurations; document findings; and troubleshoot operational impacts.
  • Independently administer and troubleshoot existing VMware, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization environments and virtual machines.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across operating systems, identity, applications, virtualization, storage, certificates, and network dependencies using logs and diagnostic tooling.
  • Use PowerShell, Bash, and other scripting/automation methods for administration, bulk changes, data collection, troubleshooting, and repeatable tasks.
  • Research and resolve unfamiliar issues using vendor documentation, technical references, logs, DISA guidance, and available tooling before requiring escalation.
  • Plan and lead system changes, maintenance, upgrades, and migrations with implementation, validation, rollback, documentation, and change-control considerations.
  • Serve as an escalation point and mentor for Junior Systems Administrators and Systems Administrators; provide peer review and technical guidance.
  • Identify recurring problems, technical debt, security/configuration gaps, and process deficiencies and lead practical improvements within established architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance.
  • Active CompTIA Security+ certification or higher DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.
  • Strong hands-on Windows and Linux systems administration experience with demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Hands-on experience with Active Directory, GPO administration/troubleshooting, enterprise patch management/WSUS, and domain-connected systems.
  • Experience interpreting and remediating DISA STIG findings within secure or regulated environments.
  • Working knowledge of VMware, Hyper-V, or comparable virtualization technologies.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, subnetting, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or similar administrative scripting.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently research and resolve complex technical problems, lead technical work, mentor others, and produce effective documentation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced Microsoft, Linux, VMware, networking, or cybersecurity certifications.
  • Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, or specialized technical applications.
  • Experience leading infrastructure upgrades, migrations, maintenance events, or cross-functional technical efforts.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a world-class S&OP Planning Analyst (internally known at Anduril as Demand & Supply Planner) to join our team. The Demand & Supply Planner has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrate ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage day-to-day demand signaling, ordering, and inventory for various product lines.
  • Identify and resolve supply issues by collaborating with Engineering, Purchasing, and Manufacturing teams.
  • Lead Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions for Supply Planning on designated product lines.
  • Work with Business Development and Growth teams to align forecasts with actual demand plans.
  • Report on and analyze supply and material health to inform key decisions for Engineering, Purchasing, Manufacturing, and Business Development.
  • Develop and maintain processes within MRP systems and associated master data.
  • Drive strategic initiatives towards best practices, including demand shaping, advanced modeling, and inventory optimization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (i.e. manufacturing, engineering, analytics, computer science, etc.) or business field (i.e. finance, economics, supply chain management, business administration, marketing, etc.)
  • 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or production role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment dealing with complex assemblies.
  • Complete ownership of a complex value chain, coordinating between multiple, high volume of departments and teams to ensure on-time deliveries and adherence to quality standards.
  • Technical expertise including ability to read technical documentation and understanding hardware manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree or other higher education.
  • Strong experience with SQL databases, including building custom queries for production and inventory metrics.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlikview.
  • Knowledge of supply chain planning systems like Blue Yonder and best practices in demand planning, inventory management, and S&OP.
  • Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, six sigma principles, and big data evaluation techniques.
  • Proactive, able to take substantial responsibility across various functions, with a focus on speed and accuracy.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Warfighter Systems division is building the next generation of counter-UAS engagement systems. We are developing an anti-UAV kinetic response system that fuses real-time computer vision, sensor data, and onboard processing to dramatically increase first-round effectiveness against hostile drones. By pushing advanced CV algorithms into ultra-constrained compute environments, we are delivering a decisive edge at the tactical level. This team operates at the intersection of robotics, embedded systems, optics, and counter-UAS effectors — building technology that saves lives.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're seeking a dynamic Staff Systems Engineer who can break the mold and redefine how we develop mission-critical counter-UAS systems at the tactical edge. This project is a complex, multi-domain product — tightly coupling precision optics, computer vision, embedded compute, actuators, laser subsystems, and kinetic effector integration into a single warfighter-portable anti-UAV system. We need a systems thinker who can serve as the technical "glue" that transforms separate components into a cohesive, production-ready product.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of multiple technical domains, embraces end-to-end ownership, possesses a bias for action, and wants to create groundbreaking solutions rather than follow conventional playbooks. You'll operate as a driving force behind critical product decisions, balancing technical tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, power, size, weight, and ruggedization — all while maintaining system integrity under the demands of combat use.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Systems Architecture & Innovation

  • Serve as the technical authority spanning optics, computer vision, electro-mechanical actuation, laser subsystems, embedded compute, and counter-UAS effector integration — translating mission-level outcomes into coherent system architectures
  • Lead cross-functional integration between mechanical, electrical, firmware, computer vision, and manufacturing teams, acting as the technical glue that transforms separate components into a cohesive anti-UAV system
  • Reimagine system requirements through first-principles thinking, challenging traditional counter-UAS approaches to create more robust, adaptable solutions
  • Identify critical warfighter needs and translate them into technical specifications that outperform legacy counter-UAS and air defense systems
  • Create systems architecture diagrams that bridge mechanical, electrical, optical, and software interfaces — aligning cross-domain teams on a single source of truth

Technical Leadership & Execution

  • Lead design reviews ensuring rigor from requirements definition through verification and validation

  • Own verification and validation plans and execution — including lab, benchtop, and live-engagement test campaigns against representative UAS threats

  • Build the digital backbone that enables rapid iteration and continuous improvement of DEADSHOT and follow-on products
  • Create user documentation that enables warfighters to autonomously operate and sustain the product in the field

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver against aggressive schedules
  • Hands-on prototyping, troubleshooting, and integration experience — comfortable moving between CAD, lab bench, and field test
  • Experience owning verification and validation across the full product lifecycle, including environmental qualification (shock, vibration, thermal, sealing)
